title: Table: The table below shows the percentage of employers in various sectors having diff...
description: The table below shows the percentage of employers in various sectors having difficulty in finding staff in 2003 and 2004. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Difficulty in finding staff (4 sectors, 2003–2004)

1. Giải thích đề

Bảng cho thấy tỷ lệ (%) doanh nghiệp gặp khó khăn trong tuyển dụng ở 4 ngành, theo 3 nhóm:

  • skilled workers
  • unskilled workers
  • technical/managerial staff

→ So sánh giữa 2003 và 2004

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

  • Giữ: percentage – difficulty in recruiting staff – sectors – years
  • Dùng:
  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • finding → recruiting / hiring

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Skilled workers khó tuyển nhất trong mọi ngành
  • Technical/managerial thấp nhất
  • Hầu hết số liệu tăng nhẹ từ 2003 → 2004

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Skilled workers (main pattern)
  • Manufacturing: cao nhất (45 → 51)
  • Commerce: giảm (47 → 41)
  • Building & Services: tăng nhẹ

→ Ý: nhóm skilled luôn cao nhất nhưng không đồng đều

BODY 2 – Unskilled \+ Technical
  • Unskilled: tăng ở hầu hết ngành (đặc biệt Services: 20 → 29)
  • Technical: rất thấp, đa số giảm
  • Commerce: gần như 0
  • Manufacturing/Building: giảm

→ Ý: unskilled tăng, technical vẫn ít khó khăn

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • recruitment difficulties → khó khăn tuyển dụng
  • experienced staff → lao động có kỹ năng
  • low proportion → tỷ lệ thấp
  • increase slightly → tăng nhẹ
  • remain minimal → duy trì ở mức rất thấp

Ví dụ:

  • Skilled workers posed the greatest recruitment challenges.
  • The proportion for technical staff remained minimal.
  • There was a slight increase in most sectors.

The table compares the percentage of employers reporting difficulty in finding skilled, unskilled, and technical/managerial staff across four sectors in 2003 and 2004.

Overall, difficulties in recruiting skilled workers were consistently the highest across all sectors, while shortages of technical and managerial staff were relatively low and generally declined. In addition, problems in hiring unskilled workers tended to increase in most sectors.

In terms of skilled labour, manufacturing recorded the highest figures, rising from 45% in 2003 to 51% in 2004. Building and services also saw increases, from 42% to 45% and from 41% to 45% respectively. In contrast, commerce was the only sector to experience a decline, falling from 47% to 41%.

For unskilled workers, most sectors reported growing difficulties. Manufacturing rose slightly from 26% to 28%, while building increased from 21% to 23%. The most notable rise occurred in services, which climbed from 20% to 29%. By contrast, commerce saw a decrease from 22% to 19%.

Regarding technical and managerial staff, the percentages were much lower overall and declined in every sector. Manufacturing dropped from 8% to 6%, building from 14% to 10%, services from 5% to 2%, and commerce from 2% to zero, indicating that this category posed the least recruitment challenge.

* The difficulty in finding skilled workers was generally high across all sectors in both years, with Manufacturing showing the highest difficulty in 2004 (51%).
* The difficulty in finding unskilled workers was lower than for skilled workers across all sectors, with Services experiencing the largest increase from 2003 to 2004 (20% to 29%).
* The difficulty in finding technical and managerial staff was consistently the lowest across all categories and sectors.
* Commerce experienced a significant decrease in difficulty for finding technical and managerial staff, dropping to 0% in 2004.
* Most sectors saw an increase in difficulty in finding skilled workers from 2003 to 2004, except for Commerce.
* The difficulty in finding technical and managerial staff decreased in all sectors from 2003 to 2004.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Life Expectancy (Men vs Women)

1. Giải thích đề

Bảng cho biết tuổi thọ trung bình (năm \+ tháng) của nam và nữ ở 6 quốc gia.

Trọng tâm: so sánh giữa nam – nữ và giữa các quốc gia.

2. Định hướng viết Introduction

  • Paraphrase với 4 ý: tuổi thọ – nam và nữ – 6 quốc gia – đơn vị năm/tháng
  • Đổi từ:
  • table → shows / compares
  • life expectancy → giữ nguyên
  • Viết 1 câu, không số liệu

3. Định hướng viết Overview

  • Nữ luôn sống lâu hơn nam ở tất cả quốc gia
  • Korea và Japan cao nhất, trong khi France và Italy thấp hơn

4. Phân chia BODY rõ ràng

BODY 1 – Men
  • Cao nhất: Korea (68), Japan (67)
  • Trung bình: US (65), Australia (64)
  • Thấp nhất: Italy (58), France (57)

→ Nhấn mạnh: chênh lệch rõ giữa các nước

BODY 2 – Women
  • Cao nhất: Korea (67), Japan (66)
  • Trung bình: US (64), Australia (63)
  • Thấp nhất: Italy (57), France (56)

→ Nhấn mạnh: pattern giống nam nhưng luôn cao hơn

5. Gợi ý Paraphrasing

  • life expectancy → average lifespan
  • higher → longer
  • lower → shorter
  • slightly → marginally

Ví dụ:

  • sống lâu hơn → have a longer life expectancy
  • cao hơn một chút → slightly higher

The table compares life expectancy for men and women in six countries, measured in years and months.

Overall, females live slightly longer than males in all countries, while Korea and Japan record the highest life expectancy and France and Italy the lowest.

In detail, Korea has the highest figures, with men living 68 years and 8 months and women 67 years and 2 months. Japan follows closely, at 67 years and 4 months for males and 66 years and 9 months for females. The United States and Australia show similar patterns, with male life expectancy at around 64–65 years and females slightly lower in months.

By contrast, Italy and France have the lowest life expectancy, with men living 58 years and 2 months and 57 years and 4 months respectively, while women reach 57 years and 3 months in Italy and 56 years and 9 months in France.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT NHANH

1. Hiểu đề

Bảng cho thấy số người (triệu) tham gia 5 hoạt động thể chất ở Úc (running; aerobics; tennis; cycling; swimming) qua 3 năm: 2001; 2005; 2009 → dạng: change over time \+ so sánh

2. Introduction

The table shows the number of people participating in five physical activities in Australia in 2001, 2005 and 2009.

3. Overview

Running; aerobics; tennis tăng; cycling và swimming giảm tổng thể; cycling luôn phổ biến nhất; running tăng mạnh nhất

4. Body

Body 1 (nhóm tăng):

2001: aerobics cao nhất (1.5) \> running (1.4) \> tennis (1.0); running tăng mạnh lên 2.2 vào 2009; aerobics và tennis tăng nhẹ, lần lượt đạt 1.7 và 1.2

Body 2 (nhóm giảm):

2001: cycling cao nhất (4.5), sau đó là swimming (3.7); cycling giảm xuống 3.1 rồi hồi nhẹ 3.6; swimming tăng nhẹ lên 3.8 rồi giảm còn 3.3

5. Key phrases

increase steadily; rise significantly; decline overall; remain the most popular; show a slight growth

The table shows the number of people (in millions) participating in five physical activities in Australia in 2001, 2005 and 2009, along with the percentage change.

Overall, running experienced the most significant growth, while cycling and swimming declined over the period. Cycling remained the most popular activity despite a decrease.

In 2001, cycling was the leading activity at 4.5 million, followed by swimming (3.7 million). By contrast, running and tennis were the least popular, at 1.4 and 1.0 million, respectively. Over time, participation in running rose steadily to 2.2 million in 2009, representing the largest increase (56%). Aerobics and tennis also grew slightly, reaching 1.7 and 1.2 million.

In contrast, cycling dropped from 4.5 million in 2001 to 3.6 million in 2009, a decline of 20%. Swimming followed a similar pattern, falling from 3.7 to 3.3 million (\-10%), although it remained the second most popular activity.

title: Table: The table below shows the information about the posts held by women in parliamen...

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Women in Government & Management (2000)

1. Giải thích đề

Bảng cho biết tỷ lệ phụ nữ trong quốc hội và vị trí quản lý ở 5 quốc gia trong năm 2000.

Trọng tâm: so sánh giữa 2 lĩnh vực \+ giữa các quốc gia.

2. Định hướng viết Introduction

  • Paraphrase với 4 ý: phụ nữ – vị trí (quốc hội & quản lý) – 5 quốc gia – 1 năm
  • Đổi từ:
  • table → shows / compares
  • positions → roles / representation
  • Viết 1 câu, không số

3. Định hướng viết Overview

  • Tỷ lệ phụ nữ trong quản lý luôn cao hơn quốc hội ở tất cả quốc gia
  • Norway và Italy nổi bật cao, trong khi Uruguay thấp nhất (quốc hội)

4. Phân chia BODY rõ ràng

BODY 1 – Parliament (quốc hội)
  • Norway cao nhất (36%), tiếp theo Canada (28%)
  • Tobago and Trinidad trung bình (19%)
  • Italy (10%) và Uruguay thấp nhất (8%)

→ Nhấn mạnh: chênh lệch lớn giữa các quốc gia

BODY 2 – Management (quản lý)
  • Italy cao nhất (54%), Norway (52%)
  • Tobago and Trinidad (40%)
  • Canada và Uruguay bằng nhau (37%)

→ Nhấn mạnh: mức cao hơn rõ so với quốc hội

5. Gợi ý Paraphrasing

  • percentage → proportion
  • women → female representation
  • high → higher / highest
  • low → lower / lowest

Ví dụ:

  • tỷ lệ cao → a higher proportion of women
  • thấp nhất → the lowest figure

The table compares the proportions of women in parliamentary positions and management roles in five countries in 2000.

Overall, women were better represented in management than in parliament in all countries, with Norway and Italy recording the highest figures in each category respectively.

In detail, Norway had the highest proportion of female parliamentarians at 36%, followed by Canada at 28%, while the figures were much lower in Tobago and Trinidad (19%), Italy (10%) and Uruguay (8%). In terms of management roles, Italy ranked first with 54%, closely followed by Norway at 52%. Canada and Uruguay had identical figures of 37%, while Tobago and Trinidad stood at 40%.

Notably, the gap between the two sectors was particularly large in countries such as Italy and Uruguay, where female representation in management far exceeded that in parliament.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Expenditure vs Participation

1. Giải thích đề

Bảng so sánh tỷ lệ chi tiêu và tỷ lệ tham gia ở 5 quốc gia.

Trọng tâm: so sánh giữa 2 chỉ số và giữa các quốc gia.

2. Định hướng viết Introduction

  • Paraphrase với 4 ý: chi tiêu – tham gia – 5 quốc gia – dạng tỷ lệ
  • Đổi từ:
  • table → compares / shows
  • rate → proportion / percentage
  • Viết 1 câu, không số

3. Định hướng viết Overview

  • Slovenia cao nhất về chi tiêu, trong khi Poland thấp nhất
  • Poland có participation cao nhất, còn Romania thấp nhất

4. Phân chia BODY rõ ràng

BODY 1 – Expenditure rate
  • Slovenia cao nhất (25%)
  • Hungary (13%), Romania (10%), Czech (9%)
  • Poland thấp nhất (5%)

→ Nhấn mạnh: chênh lệch rõ giữa các nước

BODY 2 – Participation rate
  • Poland cao nhất (44%), tiếp theo Slovenia (40%)
  • Hungary trung bình (34%)
  • Czech (27%) và Romania thấp nhất (23%)

→ Nhấn mạnh: không hoàn toàn tỷ lệ thuận với chi tiêu

5. Gợi ý Paraphrasing

  • rate → proportion / percentage
  • high → higher / highest
  • low → lower / lowest
  • similar → comparable

Ví dụ:

  • cao nhất → recorded the highest proportion
  • thấp nhất → had the lowest figure

The table compares five countries in terms of expenditure rates and participation rates.

Overall, higher spending does not consistently lead to higher participation, although Slovenia records both the highest expenditure and a relatively high participation rate. Poland, despite the lowest spending, shows the highest participation.

In detail, Slovenia allocates the largest share at 25%, followed by Hungary at 13%, while Romania, the Czech Republic and Poland spend 10%, 9% and 5% respectively. However, Poland leads in participation at 44%, slightly ahead of Slovenia at 40%. Hungary also records a moderate figure of 34%, whereas the Czech Republic and Romania have lower participation rates at 27% and 23% respectively.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Employment by Gender (1993 vs 2003)

1. Giải thích đề

Bảng cho biết tỷ lệ nam và nữ làm việc trong 6 ngành ở 2 năm: 1993 và 2003.

Trọng tâm: so sánh theo giới \+ thay đổi theo thời gian.

2. Định hướng viết Introduction

  • Paraphrase với 4 ý: tỷ lệ lao động – nam & nữ – 6 ngành – 2 năm
  • Đổi từ:
  • table → compares / shows
  • employment → employment / workforce
  • Viết 1 câu, không số

3. Định hướng viết Overview

  • Nam chiếm ưu thế ở Manufacturing, Building, IT, Farming
  • Nữ chiếm ưu thế ở Services và Commerce
  • Xu hướng chung: nam giảm nhẹ ở nhiều ngành, nữ tăng ở một số lĩnh vực

4. Phân chia BODY rõ ràng

BODY 1 – Male
  • Giảm: Manufacturing (55 → 52), Building (68 → 60), IT (80 → 70), Farming (75 → 65)
  • Tăng: Commerce (45 → 50), Services tăng mạnh (14 → 40)

→ Nhấn mạnh: giảm ở ngành truyền thống, tăng ở dịch vụ

BODY 2 – Female
  • Tăng: Manufacturing (45 → 48), Building (32 → 40), IT (20 → 30), Farming (25 → 35)
  • Giảm: Services (86 → 60), Commerce giảm nhẹ (55 → 50)

→ Nhấn mạnh: dịch chuyển khỏi services sang các ngành khác

5. Gợi ý Paraphrasing

  • percentage → proportion
  • increase → rise
  • decrease → decline
  • dominate → account for the majority

Ví dụ:

  • chiếm ưu thế → accounted for a higher proportion
  • tăng đáng kể → rose significantly

The table compares the percentages of men and women working in six sectors in 1993 and 2003.

Overall, men dominated manufacturing, building, IT and farming, while women were more prevalent in services and initially in commerce. Over time, gender gaps narrowed in several sectors, particularly services and building.

In 1993, male participation was highest in IT (80%) and farming (75%), followed by building (68%) and manufacturing (55%). By contrast, women were heavily concentrated in services at 86%, while their shares in building (32%) and IT (20%) were much lower. Commerce was the only sector where women outnumbered men, at 55% compared to 45%.

By 2003, male proportions declined in most traditionally male-dominated sectors, including building (60%), IT (70%) and farming (65%), while women’s participation increased in these areas, notably in building (40%) and farming (35%). In services, the gender gap narrowed significantly as the figure for women fell to 60% while the male share rose sharply to 40%. In commerce, both genders reached an equal level of 50%, and manufacturing showed only minor changes for both groups.

* Women's participation increased in Manufacturing, Building, Services, IT, and Farming, but decreased in Commerce.
* Commerce was the only sector where the percentages for men and women were equal in 2003 (50% each).

title: Process: The three pictures show the position of a volcano, and a village before and afte...
description: The three pictures show the position of a volcano, and a village before and after volcanic eruption. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main points and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Village before & after volcanic eruption

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy vị trí của một ngọn núi lửa và sự thay đổi của một ngôi làng trước và sau khi núi lửa phun trào.

→ Dạng: map \+ process (before–after change)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • village – volcanic eruption

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / depicts
  • before and after → prior to and following

Ví dụ:

The diagrams illustrate the position of a volcano and how a nearby village changed before and after a volcanic eruption.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Trước khi phun trào:

→ làng yên bình với nhiều nhà và cây cối

  • Sau khi phun trào:

→ dung nham lan rộng, phá hủy phần lớn khu vực

→ cảnh quan trở nên khô cằn, nhiều nhà bị ảnh hưởng

→ Thay đổi chính: từ khu dân cư xanh → khu bị tàn phá bởi dung nham

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Trước khi phun trào

  • Ngọn núi lửa nằm ở phía bên trái của hòn đảo
  • Khu làng:
  • gồm một số ngôi nhà nhỏ
  • phân bố rải rác quanh khu vực trung tâm
  • Có:
  • nhiều cây cọ
  • một con đường nhỏ chạy qua làng
  • Tổng thể:

→ môi trường xanh, yên bình và có tổ chức

BODY 2 – Sau khi phun trào

  • Núi lửa:
  • phun trào mạnh, tạo ra dòng dung nham
  • Dung nham:
  • chảy từ núi xuống
  • lan qua khu trung tâm của làng
  • kéo dài ra phía bờ biển
  • Kết quả:
  • nhiều ngôi nhà bị phá hủy hoặc ảnh hưởng
  • mặt đất trở nên xám, khô và trơ trụi
  • cây cối giảm đáng kể
  • Một số nhà:
  • vẫn còn nhưng nằm gần khu vực bị dung nham bao quanh

→ Ý: thiệt hại lớn về cảnh quan và cơ sở hạ tầng

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • be located → nằm ở
  • be surrounded by → được bao quanh bởi
  • be destroyed → bị phá hủy
  • be covered by → bị bao phủ bởi
  • lava flow → dòng dung nham
  • volcanic eruption → sự phun trào núi lửa
  • devastated → bị tàn phá

The diagrams illustrate the position of a volcano and the changes to a nearby village before and after a volcanic eruption.

Overall, the eruption had a significant impact on the village, particularly due to the flow of lava, which altered the landscape and affected several houses.

Initially, the volcano was located on a small island surrounded by the sea. Before the eruption, the nearby village consisted of several houses scattered across a green area with palm trees and a winding path. The volcano appeared inactive, and the environment was largely undisturbed.

After the eruption, the situation changed considerably. Lava flowed from the volcano across the island, covering a large section of land and turning the previously green area into a grey, barren surface. The lava stream passed through the village, destroying or severely damaging some houses located along its path. Although a few buildings remained intact, the overall environment became much less habitable due to the widespread impact of volcanic activity.

title: Table: The table below shows the percentage use of four different fuel types to generat...
description: The table below shows the percentage use of four different fuel types to generate electricity in five Asian countries in 2005. Summarise the information by selecting, reporting the main features, and make comparison where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Fuel types used to generate electricity (5 Asian countries, 2005)

1. Giải thích đề

Bảng cho thấy tỷ lệ (%) sử dụng 4 loại nhiên liệu để sản xuất điện ở 5 quốc gia châu Á năm 2005.

→ Dạng: so sánh giữa các quốc gia \+ nhiều categories

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

  • Giữ đủ: percentage – fuel types – generate electricity – five Asian countries – 2005
  • Dùng từ:
  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • use → consumption / usage

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Không có 1 loại nhiên liệu thống trị tất cả quốc gia
  • Coal chiếm ưu thế ở Malaysia & Singapore
  • Nuclear nổi bật ở Japan & South Korea
  • Thailand phụ thuộc nhiều vào petroleum & other sources

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Nhóm dùng Coal/Nuclear nhiều
  • Malaysia: coal cao nhất (61%)
  • Singapore: coal cao (42%), other cũng cao
  • Japan: nuclear cao nhất (49%)
  • South Korea: hydro \+ nuclear cao

→ Ý: các nước phát triển dùng coal/nuclear nhiều

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại / khác biệt
  • Thailand: không dùng nuclear (0%)
  • Petroleum cao nhất ở Thailand (36%)
  • Hydro cao nhất ở South Korea (48%)
  • Other cao ở Thailand & Singapore

→ Ý: Thailand khác biệt nhất (phụ thuộc nhiên liệu khác)

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • account for → chiếm
  • dominate → chiếm ưu thế
  • rely on → phụ thuộc vào
  • make up → tạo thành
  • proportion → tỷ lệ

Ví dụ:

  • Coal accounts for the largest proportion in Malaysia.
  • Thailand relies heavily on petroleum and other sources.

The table compares the proportions of electricity generated from four fuel types in five Asian countries in 2005.

Overall, coal and lignite dominated electricity production in Malaysia and Singapore, while nuclear power was the main source in Japan and South Korea. By contrast, Thailand relied heavily on petroleum products and other sources, with no use of nuclear energy.

In Malaysia, coal and lignite accounted for the majority at 61%, followed by nuclear energy at 19%, while the remaining sources made relatively small contributions. A similar pattern can be seen in Singapore, where coal (42%) was the largest source, although a substantial share also came from other sources (39%). In contrast, Japan depended primarily on nuclear power, which made up 49% of electricity generation, with other sources contributing 39%, while coal, petroleum and hydro played only minor roles.

South Korea also relied heavily on nuclear energy (33%) and hydro and wind (48%), with very limited use of coal and petroleum. Thailand showed a markedly different profile, as it generated most of its electricity from other sources (42%) and petroleum products (36%), alongside a notable proportion from hydro and wind (19%), but no nuclear power at all.

DATA:

* Coal and Lignite was the dominant fuel source in Malaysia (61%) and Singapore (42%).
* Nuclear power was the largest source of electricity in Japan (49%) and a significant source in South Korea (33%).
* Thailand relied heavily on 'Other' sources (42%) and Petroleum Products (36%), with no nuclear power.
* Hydro and Wind power was most prominent in South Korea (48%).
* Petroleum Products contributed a small percentage (2-3%) in most countries, except for Thailand (36%).
* 'Other' sources were a substantial contributor in Thailand (42%), Singapore (39%), and Japan (39%).

title: Table: The table below shows the population ratio of males per 100 females in six diffe...
description: The table below shows the population ratio of males per 100 females in six different areas in 1955 and 2005. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Male per 100 females (1955 & 2005)

1. Giải thích đề

Bảng cho thấy tỷ lệ nam trên 100 nữ ở 6 khu vực trong 2 năm: 1955 và 2005.

→ Dạng: so sánh theo thời gian \+ giữa các khu vực

2. Định hướng viết Introduction

  • Paraphrase đủ 4 ý: ratio – males per 100 females – 6 regions – 2 years
  • Dùng từ:
  • shows → compares / illustrates
  • areas → regions
  • Viết 1 câu, không số liệu

3. Định hướng viết Overview

  • Asia luôn cao nhất (\>100)
  • Hầu hết khu vực giảm nhẹ theo thời gian
  • Europe luôn thấp nhất

4. Phân chia BODY

BODY 1 – Nhóm trên 100 / cao
  • Asia: cao nhất, giảm nhẹ (105 → 104)
  • Oceania: \>100 rồi giảm xuống \<100
  • North America & South/Central: quanh 100 → giảm

→ Ý chính: các khu vực từng có nhiều nam hơn nữ đều giảm

BODY 2 – Nhóm dưới 100 / thấp
  • Europe: thấp nhất nhưng tăng nhẹ (89 → 92)
  • Africa: tăng nhẹ (97 → 99)

→ Ý chính: nhóm thấp có xu hướng tăng nhưng vẫn dưới 100

5. Gợi ý Paraphrasing

  • ratio → proportion
  • decrease → decline / fall
  • increase → rise / edge up
  • slightly → marginally
  • remain → remain stable / remain the lowest

Ví dụ:

  • giảm nhẹ → declined slightly
  • tăng nhẹ → rose marginally

The table compares the number of males per 100 females in six regions in 1955 and 2005.

Overall, Asia consistently recorded the highest male-to-female ratio, while Europe had the lowest figures in both years. Most regions showed slight declines over time, although Africa and Europe experienced modest increases.

In 1955, Asia had by far the highest ratio at 105.3 males per 100 females, followed by Oceania (103.9) and North America (100.1), while South and Central America stood at exactly 100. Africa was slightly below parity at 97.8, and Europe recorded the lowest figure at 89.4. By 2005, Asia remained the highest despite a marginal decline to 104.9. In contrast, Europe rose slightly to 92.8, and Africa also increased to 99.2, bringing it closer to balance.

Other regions experienced downward trends. North America fell from 100.1 to 96.9, South and Central America decreased from 100 to 97.5, and Oceania dropped more noticeably from 103.9 to 99.8, indicating a general shift towards more balanced gender ratios in these areas.

title: Process: The diagram below shows how chipboards are created from wood and then used to ma...
description: The diagram below shows how chipboards are created from wood and then used to make furniture. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

How chipboard is created and used to make furniture

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy quy trình sản xuất chipboard từ gỗ và cách vật liệu này được sử dụng để làm đồ nội thất.

→ Dạng: process (linear process, nhiều bước)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • chipboard – wood – furniture

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / outlines
  • how → the process by which

Ví dụ:

The diagram illustrates the process by which chipboard is produced from wood and subsequently used to manufacture furniture.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm 2 giai đoạn chính:

1. Chuẩn bị nguyên liệu (gỗ → wood chips)

2. Sản xuất chipboard và tạo đồ nội thất

  • Đặc điểm:

→ nhiều bước liên tiếp, từ cắt gỗ → ép thành tấm → làm sản phẩm hoàn chỉnh

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Giai đoạn chuẩn bị

  • Đầu tiên:

→ cây được chặt (cutting)

  • Sau đó:

→ thân cây được cắt tỉa thành logs (trimming)

  • Tiếp theo:

→ logs được nghiền thành wood chips

  • Wood chips:

→ được sấy khô bằng không khí nóng (drying) trong khoảng 24 giờ

  • Sau đó:

→ được lưu trữ (storing) từ 1–2 tuần

BODY 2 – Giai đoạn sản xuất

  • Wood chips:

→ được trộn với glue và wax (mixing)

  • Hỗn hợp:

→ được đổ vào khuôn (shaping)

  • Tiếp theo:

→ được ép dưới áp suất cao (pressing) để tạo thành chipboard

  • Cuối cùng:

→ chipboard được sử dụng để sản xuất đồ nội thất như bàn và ghế

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • be cut down → bị chặt
  • be trimmed → được cắt tỉa
  • be processed into → được xử lý thành
  • be dried → được làm khô
  • be stored → được lưu trữ
  • be mixed with → được trộn với
  • be pressed into shape → được ép thành hình
  • final product → sản phẩm cuối cùng

The diagram illustrates the process by which chipboard is produced from wood and subsequently used to manufacture furniture.

Overall, the procedure involves two main stages: preparation, in which raw wood is converted into wood chips, and production, where these chips are processed, shaped, and pressed into chipboard before being made into furniture.

In the first stage, trees are initially cut down and trimmed into logs. These logs are then fed into a machine to produce wood chips. Following this, the chips are dried using hot air for approximately 24 hours and then stored for a period of one to two weeks.

The second stage begins with mixing the dried wood chips with glue and wax. The resulting mixture is then placed into a mould to form the desired shape. After shaping, the material is compressed under high pressure to create solid chipboard sheets. Finally, these boards are used as raw material to produce furniture such as tables and chairs.

* The process of creating chipboard and furniture from wood involves two main stages: preparation and production.
* The preparation stage begins with cutting trees and ends with storing dried wood chips.
* The production stage starts with mixing the wood chips and concludes with making furniture.
* Drying the wood chips is a time-consuming step, taking 24 hours, followed by a storage period of 1-2 weeks.
* Glue and wax are added to the wood chips before shaping and pressing to form the final chipboard.

title: Process: The diagram shows the process for recycling plastic bottles. Summarise the infor...
description: The diagram shows the process for recycling plastic bottles. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ mô tả quy trình tái chế chai nhựa thành các sản phẩm mới.

→ Dạng: process (linear, multi-stage)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

The diagram illustrates how plastic bottles are recycled to produce new products.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm 9 bước, bắt đầu từ thu gom và kết thúc ở sản phẩm mới
  • Có thể chia thành 3 giai đoạn:

→ collection & sorting → processing → manufacturing new products

  • Điểm nổi bật:

→ chai nhựa được biến thành pellets, sau đó tạo thành raw material

4. Body chia logic

BODY 1 – Collection \+ sorting

  • Ban đầu:

→ used plastic bottles are placed in recycling bins

  • Sau đó:

→ được collected by trucks

  • Tại trung tâm tái chế:

→ chai được sorted manually

BODY 2 – Processing (mechanical treatment)

  • Tiếp theo:

→ chai được compressed into blocks

  • Sau đó:

→ được crushed into small pieces

  • Các mảnh này:

→ được washed to remove impurities

BODY 3 – Conversion into new materials \+ products

  • Sau khi làm sạch:

→ nhựa được processed into plastic pellets

  • Các pellets:

→ được heated to form raw material

  • Cuối cùng:

→ nguyên liệu này được used to manufacture new products

(e.g. bottles, T-shirts, bags, pencils)

5. Từ vựng ăn điểm

  • recycling bin → thùng tái chế
  • sorting → phân loại
  • compress → nén
  • crush → nghiền
  • wash → rửa
  • pellet → hạt nhựa
  • raw material → nguyên liệu thô
  • manufacture → sản xuất
  • end products → sản phẩm cuối

The diagram illustrates how plastic bottles are recycled into new products.

Overall, it is a nine-stage process that begins with the collection of used bottles and ends with the production of new items. The procedure involves sorting, compressing, cleaning, and transforming the material into reusable raw plastic.

Initially, discarded plastic bottles are placed in recycling bins and collected by trucks, which transport them to a recycling centre. At the facility, the bottles are sorted to remove unsuitable items. The selected bottles are then compressed into large blocks to facilitate handling and transportation.

Next, these blocks are crushed into small pieces, which are subsequently washed to eliminate impurities. The clean fragments are processed into plastic pellets, which are then heated to form raw plastic material.

In the final stages, this raw material is used to manufacture a variety of end products, such as new bottles, clothing, shopping bags, and stationery items.
chart_description:
TYPE: process diagram
TITLE: How plastic bottles are recycled
UNITS/AXES: Not applicable
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Not applicable
DATA:
Stage 1: Plastic bottles are placed in a recycling bin.
Stage 2: A garbage truck collects the plastic bottles.
Stage 3: At a recycling centre, the bottles are sorted.
Stage 4: The sorted bottles are compressed into blocks.
Stage 5: The blocks are crushed.
Stage 6: The crushed material undergoes washing, then is processed to produce plastic pellets.
Stage 7: The plastic pellets are heated to form raw material.
Stage 8: The raw material is prepared.
Stage 9: End products are produced from the raw material (e.g., new bottles, bags, t-shirts, pencils).
KEY FEATURES:
* The process begins with consumers disposing of plastic bottles in recycling bins.
* Collection and sorting at a recycling centre are initial steps.
* The plastic bottles are then compressed, crushed, and washed.
* The material is transformed into plastic pellets and then raw material through heating.
* The final stage involves producing various new products from the recycled plastic.

title: Process: The diagrams below give information about the manufacture of frozen fish pies. S...
description: The diagrams below give information about the manufacture of frozen fish pies. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Fish pie production line

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy các thành phần của một chiếc fish pie và quy trình sản xuất sản phẩm này trên dây chuyền công nghiệp.

→ Dạng: process (manufacturing process – nhiều nguyên liệu song song)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • fish pie – production

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / outlines
  • how → the process by which

Ví dụ:

The diagram illustrates the process by which fish pie is produced, along with its main ingredients.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Fish pie gồm các thành phần chính:

→ fish, peas, sauce và potato

  • Quy trình sản xuất gồm:

→ xử lý khoai tây và cá hồi riêng biệt

→ sau đó kết hợp tất cả nguyên liệu, đóng gói và đông lạnh

→ Đặc điểm:

  • có 2 dòng nguyên liệu song song
  • kết thúc bằng đóng gói và bảo quản lạnh

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Xử lý khoai tây

  • Khoai tây được vận chuyển đến nhà máy
  • Sau đó:

→ được rửa (clean)

→ gọt vỏ (peel)

→ cắt lát (slice)

  • Tiếp theo:

→ được luộc (boil)

  • Sau đó:

→ làm lạnh (chill)

→ và lưu trữ (store)

BODY 2 – Xử lý cá và lắp ráp sản phẩm

  • Cá hồi tươi:

→ được giao đến và xử lý trong vòng 12 giờ

  • Sau đó:

→ thêm lemon juice và muối

→ được hấp (steam oven)

  • Tiếp theo:

→ loại bỏ da và xương

→ kiểm tra chất lượng (inspect)

  • Sau đó:

→ kết hợp với:

  • đậu Hà Lan (peas)
  • nước sốt (sauce)
  • khoai tây đã chuẩn bị
  • Cuối cùng:

→ sản phẩm được đóng gói (wrap)

→ đông lạnh (freeze)

→ và lưu trữ hoặc phân phối (store/dispatch)

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • be delivered → được vận chuyển
  • be processed → được xử lý
  • be peeled / sliced → được gọt / cắt
  • be boiled → được luộc
  • be chilled → được làm lạnh
  • be seasoned → được nêm
  • be steamed → được hấp
  • be combined with → được kết hợp với
  • be packaged → được đóng gói
  • be frozen → được đông lạnh

The diagrams illustrate the ingredients of a fish pie and the industrial process used to produce it.

Overall, the dish consists of fish, peas, sauce and potato layered in a container, while the production line involves two parallel preparation streams—one for potatoes and one for fish—before final assembly, freezing and distribution.

In terms of ingredients, a fish pie is made by combining pieces of fish with peas and sauce, topped with sliced potatoes, all placed in a microwavable container.

Regarding the production process, potatoes are first delivered and can be stored for up to one month. They are then cleaned, peeled and sliced before being boiled, chilled and stored. In parallel, fresh salmon is delivered and processed within 12 hours. It is seasoned with lemon juice and salt, then cooked in a steam oven. After cooking, the skin and bones are removed, and the fish is inspected. Any waste generated during both streams is disposed of appropriately.

Finally, the prepared ingredients—including peas, sauce and potatoes—are assembled into containers. The finished pies are then wrapped, frozen, and stored or dispatched for distribution.

TITLE: A fish pie; Fish pie production line
UNITS/AXES: Up to one month; 12 hours or less
SERIES/CATEGORIES: N/A
DATA:
Stage 1: Deliver (potatoes)
Stage 2: Potatoes
Stage 3: Clean (potatoes)
Stage 4: Peel (potatoes), with waste disposal
Stage 5: Slide (potatoes)
Stage 6: Boil (potatoes)
Stage 7: Chill (potatoes)
Stage 8: Store (potatoes)
Stage 9: Deliver (fresh salmon)
Stage 10: Fresh salmon
Stage 11: Lemon juice
Stage 12: Salt
Stage 13: Steam oven (for salmon)
Stage 14: Remove skin and bones (from salmon)
Stage 15: Inspect (salmon)
Stage 16: Prepared peas
Stage 17: Prepared sauce
Stage 18: Potato (mashed)
Stage 19: Waste disposal (from salmon processing)
Stage 20: Wrap (fish pies)
Stage 21: Freeze (fish pies)
Stage 22: Store/dispatch (fish pies)
KEY FEATURES:
* The process describes the production of a fish pie, starting from raw ingredients and ending with a frozen product ready for dispatch.
* The production line is divided into two main streams: one for potatoes and one for fish and other ingredients.
* Potatoes undergo cleaning, peeling, boiling, chilling, and storage, with a shelf life of up to one month.
* Fresh salmon is processed within 12 hours or less, involving steaming, skin and bone removal, inspection, and combining with other ingredients like peas, sauce, and mashed potato.
* Waste disposal occurs at multiple stages, specifically during potato peeling and salmon processing.
* The final stages involve wrapping, freezing, and then storing or dispatching the finished fish pies.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Manufacturing instant noodles

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ minh họa quy trình sản xuất mì ăn liền.

→ Dạng: process (man-made)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • manufacturing instant noodles

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / outlines
  • process → procedure

Ví dụ:

The diagram illustrates the process of manufacturing instant noodles.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm 8 giai đoạn chính
  • Bắt đầu từ lưu trữ nguyên liệu
  • Kết thúc bằng đóng gói và dán nhãn

→ Key idea:

  • Quy trình tuyến tính (linear)
  • Bao gồm các bước:

→ trộn → tạo hình → nấu → đóng gói

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Giai đoạn đầu (tạo bột & tạo hình)

  • Bước 1:

→ nguyên liệu được lưu trữ trong storage silos

  • Bước 2:

→ bột được trộn với nước và dầu trong mixer

  • Bước 3:

→ hỗn hợp được cán thành dough sheets bằng rollers

  • Bước 4:

→ cắt thành dough strips

  • Bước 5:

→ tạo thành noodle discs

BODY 2 – Giai đoạn nấu & đóng gói

  • Bước 6:

→ mì được nấu trong dầu và sấy khô

  • Bước 7:

→ cho vào cups cùng với vegetables and spices

  • Bước 8:

→ labelling and sealing

→ hoàn thiện sản phẩm

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • be stored → được lưu trữ
  • be mixed with → được trộn với
  • be rolled into → được cán thành
  • be cut into → được cắt thành
  • be shaped into → được tạo hình thành
  • be cooked and dried → được nấu và sấy
  • be packaged in → được đóng gói trong
  • final product → sản phẩm cuối

The diagram illustrates the process of manufacturing instant noodles.

Overall, it is a linear, eight-stage process that begins with storing raw materials and ends with the labelling and sealing of the final product in cups.

Initially, flour is kept in storage silos before being transferred to a mixer, where it is combined with water and oil to form dough. This dough is then passed through rollers to produce thin sheets, which are subsequently cut into strips. These strips are shaped into noodle discs.

Next, the noodle discs are cooked in oil and then dried to remove moisture. After that, the dried noodles are placed into cups, where vegetables and spices are added. In the final stage, the cups are labelled and sealed, ready for distribution.
chart_description:
TYPE: process diagram
TITLE: Manufacturing Instant Noodles
UNITS/AXES: Not applicable
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Not applicable
DATA:
Stage 1: Storage silos
Stage 2: Mixer (Water + oil)
Stage 3: Dough sheets (produced from mixer, passed through rollers)
Stage 4: Dough strips (produced from dough sheets)
Stage 5: Noodle discs (produced from dough strips)
Stage 6: Cooking (oil) + drying (applied to noodle discs)
Stage 7: Vegetables + spices (added to cups)
Stage 8: Labelling + sealing (applied to cups with labels)
KEY FEATURES:
* The process begins with ingredients stored in silos, which are then transported to a mixer.
* Dough is formed, rolled into sheets, and then cut into strips and noodle discs.
* The noodle discs undergo cooking and drying before being prepared for packaging.
* Cups are filled with vegetables and spices, and then the cooked noodles are added.
* The final stage involves labelling and sealing the instant noodle cups.

title: Process: The diagram below describes the structure of a home smokery and how it works. Su...
description: The diagram below describes the structure of a home smokery and how it works. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

A home smokery

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ mô tả cách một hệ thống hun khói tại nhà hoạt động để làm chín/thơm cá.

→ Dạng: process (linear process)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

  • shows → illustrates / explains
  • how → the process by which

Ví dụ:

The diagram illustrates the process by which a home smokery is used to smoke fish.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm 3 giai đoạn chính
  • Không có vòng lặp → linear process

Key idea:

  • Không khí đi vào → tạo lửa → khói di chuyển → làm chín cá

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Air intake \+ fire creation

  • Ở giai đoạn đầu:

→ fresh air enters hệ thống qua một hố có nắp

  • Không khí:

→ đi xuống và di chuyển sang buồng thứ hai

  • Tại đây:

→ fire is produced (đốt gỗ)

→ Vai trò:

  • tạo ra smoke

BODY 2 – Smoke transfer \+ fish smoking

  • Khói từ buồng lửa:

→ đi qua a pipe

  • Sau đó:

→ được dẫn vào a box located above ground level

  • Trong hộp:

→ cá được treo (hung)

  • Cuối cùng:

→ cá được smoked by the rising smoke

5. Từ vựng ăn điểm

  • smokery → lò hun khói
  • fresh air intake → luồng khí vào
  • lid → nắp
  • chamber → buồng
  • firewood → củi
  • pipe → đường ống
  • smoke → khói
  • hang fish → treo cá
  • above ground level → trên mặt đất

The diagram illustrates how a home smokery is constructed and used to smoke food, particularly fish.

Overall, the system consists of three main parts: an air intake chamber, a fire chamber, and a smoking box. Fresh air is drawn in, heated by a fire, and then the resulting smoke is directed through a pipe to preserve food in a separate container.

Initially, fresh air enters the first chamber through an opening with a lid. This air then moves downward and passes into the second chamber, where a fire is burning. The heat from the fire generates smoke, which accumulates in this section.

Next, the smoke travels through a connecting pipe that leads to a third, enclosed box positioned at ground level. Inside this box, fish are suspended from the top. As the smoke enters and circulates within the box, it surrounds the fish, allowing them to be smoked and preserved.
chart_description:
TYPE: process diagram
TITLE: A home smokery
UNITS/AXES: Not applicable
SERIES/CATEGORIES:
Stage 1: Fresh air intake
Stage 2: Fire chamber
Stage 3: Smoking box
DATA:
Stage 1: Fresh air enters an underground chamber through an opening covered by a lid. The air flows downwards and then horizontally towards Stage 2.
Stage 2: Air from Stage 1 reaches a second underground chamber where a fire is burning on a bed of logs. This chamber is also covered by a lid. Smoke from the fire is directed through a pipe.
Stage 3: The pipe carries smoke upwards into an above-ground box. Inside the box, three fish are hanging from a rod. This box is situated above ground level.
KEY FEATURES:
* The process involves three main stages: air intake, fire generation, and smoking.
* The system is largely underground, with only the smoking box extending above ground level.
* Fresh air is drawn in, passes over a fire, and the resulting smoke is channeled to the smoking box.
* Lids are used to cover the air intake and fire chambers.
* Fish are suspended inside the smoking box to be smoked.

title: Process: The diagram below shows how geothermal energy is used to produce electricity. Su...
description: The diagram below shows how geothermal energy is used to produce electricity. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Geothermal Power Plant

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ minh họa cách một nhà máy điện địa nhiệt hoạt động để sản xuất điện.

→ Dạng: process (natural \+ man-made system)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • geothermal power plant – electricity

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / explains
  • how → the process by which

Ví dụ:

The diagram illustrates the process by which electricity is generated in a geothermal power plant.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm 5 giai đoạn chính
  • Bắt đầu từ việc bơm nước lạnh xuống lòng đất
  • Nước được làm nóng bởi đá nóng (geothermal zone)
  • Sau đó biến thành hơi nước → quay turbine → tạo điện

→ Key idea:

  • Chu trình khép kín (circular process)
  • Kết hợp giữa tự nhiên (heat from rocks) và máy móc (turbine, generator)

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Giai đoạn dưới lòng đất

  • Ban đầu:

→ nước lạnh (cold water) được bơm xuống khoảng 4.5 km dưới mặt đất

  • Sau đó:

→ đi qua injection well

  • Tiếp theo:

→ nước đi vào geothermal zone (hot rocks)

→ và được làm nóng

  • Sau đó:

→ nước nóng được đẩy lên (pumped up) qua production well

BODY 2 – Giai đoạn trên mặt đất

  • Nước nóng:

→ đi vào condenser

→ được chuyển thành hơi nước (steam)

  • Hơi nước:

→ làm quay turbine

  • Turbine:

→ vận hành generator

  • Cuối cùng:

→ điện (electricity) được tạo ra và truyền đi

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • be pumped down/up → được bơm xuống / lên
  • pass through → đi qua
  • be heated by → được làm nóng bởi
  • be converted into steam → được chuyển thành hơi nước
  • drive a turbine → làm quay turbine
  • generate electricity → tạo ra điện
  • underground / surface → dưới lòng đất / trên mặt đất

The diagram illustrates how a geothermal power plant generates electricity using heat from beneath the Earth’s surface.

Overall, the process involves five main stages, beginning with the injection of cold water deep underground and ending with electricity production through a turbine and generator system.

Initially, cold water is pumped down approximately 4.5 kilometres into the ground via an injection well. This water then enters a geothermal zone, where it is heated by hot rocks. As a result, the water temperature rises significantly.

Next, the heated water is forced back to the surface through a separate production well. Upon reaching the surface, it enters a condenser, where it is converted into steam. This steam is then directed towards a turbine, causing it to spin.

Finally, the rotating turbine powers a generator, which produces electricity that can be supplied to the grid.
chart_description:
TYPE: process diagram
TITLE: Geothermal Power Plant
UNITS/AXES: Depth: 4.5 km
SERIES/CATEGORIES:
1. Cold water
2. The injection well
3. The production well
4. Condenser
5. Turbine
Generator
Geothermal zone (hot rocks)
DATA:
Stage 1: Cold water is introduced.
Stage 2: Cold water is pumped down 4.5 km into "The injection well" to the "Geothermal zone (hot rocks)".
Stage 3: Hot water is pumped up from the "Geothermal zone (hot rocks)" through "The production well".
Stage 4: Hot water goes to the "Condenser".
Stage 5: Steam from the condenser powers the "Turbine". The turbine powers the "Generator", which produces electricity.
KEY FEATURES:
* The process begins with cold water being injected deep underground.
* The water is heated by hot rocks in the geothermal zone.
* Hot water is then pumped up to the surface.
* The hot water (or steam derived from it) drives a turbine.
* The turbine powers a generator to produce electricity.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ mô tả quy trình tái chế giấy từ giấy đã qua sử dụng thành giấy mới.

→ Dạng: process (linear, industrial process)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

The diagram illustrates how used paper is recycled to produce new paper.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm 4 giai đoạn chính:

→ making pulp → filtering → cleaning → forming recycled paper

  • Điểm nổi bật:

→ giấy được biến thành pulp, sau đó loại mực và tạp chất, rồi ép và sấy thành giấy mới

4. Body chia logic

BODY 1 – Pulp production \+ filtering

  • Ban đầu:

→ used paper is transported along a conveyor belt

  • Sau đó:

→ được trộn với water and chemicals

→ tạo thành:

  • pulp (bột giấy)
  • Tiếp theo:

→ pulp được filtered để loại bỏ tạp chất lớn

BODY 2 – Cleaning (de-inking process)

  • Ở giai đoạn này:

→ water and soap are added

  • Đồng thời:

→ air is pumped into the mixture

→ Kết quả:

  • ink is removed (nổi lên trên và tách ra)

→ tạo ra:

  • clean pulp

BODY 3 – Forming recycled paper

  • Sau khi làm sạch:

→ pulp được đưa qua heated rollers

  • Tại đây:

→ nước bị removed (evaporated/pressed out)

  • Cuối cùng:

→ pulp được formed into rolls of recycled paper

5. Từ vựng ăn điểm

  • conveyor belt → băng chuyền
  • pulp → bột giấy
  • filter → lọc
  • impurity → tạp chất
  • de-inking → tẩy mực
  • air pump → máy bơm khí
  • heated rollers → trục lăn nhiệt
  • evaporate → bay hơi
  • recycled paper → giấy tái chế

The diagram illustrates the process of recycling waste paper into new paper products.

Overall, the procedure consists of four main stages: making pulp, filtering, cleaning, and forming recycled paper. Throughout the process, water and various chemicals are added, while impurities such as ink are removed.

Initially, used paper is fed into a machine where it is mixed with water and chemicals to produce pulp. This pulp is then transferred through pipes to a filtering stage, where larger unwanted materials are removed, resulting in filtered pulp.

Next, the filtered pulp undergoes a cleaning process. Water and soap are added, and an air pump helps separate ink from the pulp, which rises to the surface and is removed. This stage produces clean pulp free from contaminants.

Finally, the clean pulp is passed through a paper-making machine, where it is pressed and dried using heated rollers. Excess water is removed during this stage, and the material is formed into rolls of recycled paper ready for use.

HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Water-filter Assembly

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ mô tả cấu tạo và cách hoạt động của một hệ thống lọc nước.

Giữ:

  • water filter – assembly

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / depicts
  • system → device / structure

Ví dụ:

The diagram illustrates the structure and operation of a water filtration system.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Hệ thống gồm hai thùng chính:
  • thùng lọc (trên)
  • thùng chứa (dưới/bên cạnh)
  • Nước được lọc qua nhiều lớp vật liệu (gravel, charcoal, sand)
  • Sau đó được dẫn sang thùng chứa và lấy ra để sử dụng

→ Quy trình đơn giản, dựa trên lọc cơ học nhiều lớp

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Cấu tạo hệ thống

  • Hệ thống gồm:
  • plastic barrel (thùng lọc) có nắp
  • storage drum (thùng chứa nước sạch)
  • Bên trong thùng lọc có 3 lớp:
  • sand (trên)
  • charcoal (giữa)
  • gravel (dưới)
  • Hai thùng được nối với nhau bằng ống dẫn nước

→ Ý: thiết kế lọc nhiều tầng

BODY 2 – Quy trình hoạt động

  • Nước được đổ vào thùng lọc từ phía trên
  • Sau đó:
  • đi qua lớp sand → charcoal → gravel
  • Trong quá trình này:
  • các tạp chất được loại bỏ dần
  • Nước sau lọc:
  • chảy qua ống nối sang thùng chứa
  • Cuối cùng:
  • nước sạch được lấy ra qua vòi để uống

→ Ý: dòng chảy từ trên xuống \+ lọc từng lớp

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • filtration system → hệ thống lọc
  • layer → lớp
  • pass through → đi qua
  • remove impurities → loại bỏ tạp chất
  • be stored → được lưu trữ
  • outlet / tap → vòi nước

The diagram illustrates how a water filter system is assembled and how it works to produce drinking water.

Overall, the system consists of two main containers: a filtering unit and a storage drum. Water is purified as it passes through several layers of materials before being collected for use.

Initially, water is poured into a plastic barrel with a lid. Inside this container, the water flows downward through three filtering layers. The top layer is sand, followed by charcoal in the middle, and gravel at the bottom. These materials remove impurities as the water passes through them.

After filtration, the clean water exits the first barrel through a pipe and is transferred into a second container, known as the storage drum. Finally, the filtered water is released from a tap at the bottom of this drum and can be used as drinking water.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Hydroelectric Power Station

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ minh họa cách một nhà máy thủy điện hoạt động vào ban ngày và ban đêm.

→ Dạng: process (cyclical process \+ comparison day/night)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • hydroelectric power station

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / explains
  • how → the process by which

Ví dụ:

The diagram illustrates how a hydroelectric power station generates electricity during the day and operates at night.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm 2 giai đoạn chính:

→ ban ngày (generate electricity)

→ ban đêm (pump water back)

  • Nước di chuyển giữa:

→ high-level reservoir và low-level reservoir

→ Key idea:

  • Đây là chu trình khép kín (cyclical process)
  • Ban ngày tạo điện, ban đêm tái sử dụng nước

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Ban ngày (electricity generation)

  • Ban ngày:

→ intake mở

  • Nước từ high-level reservoir:

→ chảy xuống qua đường ống

  • Sau đó:

→ làm quay reversible turbines

  • Turbines:

→ vận hành generator

  • Kết quả:

→ electricity được truyền qua power lines đến national grid

  • Cuối cùng:

→ nước chảy vào low-level reservoir

BODY 2 – Ban đêm (water pumping)

  • Ban đêm:

→ intake đóng

  • Hệ thống hoạt động ngược lại:

→ turbines hoạt động như máy bơm

  • Nước từ low-level reservoir:

→ được bơm ngược lên high-level reservoir

→ Ý:

  • Chuẩn bị cho chu kỳ tiếp theo

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • reservoir → hồ chứa
  • dam → đập nước
  • intake → cửa lấy nước
  • flow → dòng chảy
  • generate electricity → tạo điện
  • reversible turbines → tua-bin hai chiều
  • pump water back → bơm nước ngược lại
  • national grid → lưới điện quốc gia
  • operate → vận hành

The diagram illustrates how a hydroelectric power station operates, showing the different processes that occur during the day and at night.

Overall, electricity is generated in the daytime by releasing water from a high-level reservoir to drive turbines, whereas at night the process is reversed, with water being pumped back up for reuse.

During the day, water stored behind a dam in a high-level reservoir is released through an intake, which is open at this time. The water flows downhill through a pipe and spins reversible turbines located in the power station. These turbines drive a generator, producing electricity that is transmitted via power lines to the national grid. After passing through the turbines, the water is discharged into a low-level reservoir.

At night, when electricity demand is lower, the intake is closed and the turbines operate in reverse. Using electricity from the grid, they pump water from the low-level reservoir back up to the high-level reservoir through the same pipe. This allows the water to be stored and reused for electricity generation the following day.
chart_description:
TYPE: process diagram
TITLE: Hydroelectric Power Station
UNITS/AXES: Not applicable
SERIES/CATEGORIES:
High-level reservoir
Dam
Intake (Day: open, Night: closed)
Flow of water to generate electricity (Day)
Flow of water to pumping (Night)
Power Station
Generator
Reversible turbines (Day: operate generator, Night: pump water into high-level reservoir)
Power lines
National grid
Low-level reservoir
DATA:
1. River feeds into High-level reservoir.
2. High-level reservoir is held by a Dam.
3. Intake (Day: open, Night: closed) controls water flow from High-level reservoir.
4. During the Day: Flow of water to generate electricity (Day) moves from High-level reservoir, through the Intake, to the Reversible turbines.
5. Reversible turbines (Day: operate generator) are connected to a Generator within the Power Station.
6. Generator produces electricity which goes to Power lines.
7. Power lines lead to National grid.
8. During the Day: Water flows from Reversible turbines to Low-level reservoir.
9. During the Night: Flow of water to pumping (Night) moves from Low-level reservoir to Reversible turbines.
10. Reversible turbines (Night: pump water into high-level reservoir) pump water from Low-level reservoir back to High-level reservoir.
KEY FEATURES:
* The hydroelectric power station utilizes a high-level and a low-level reservoir.
* During the day, water flows from the high-level reservoir through reversible turbines to generate electricity.
* The reversible turbines operate as generators during the day, converting water flow into electricity.
* Electricity generated is transmitted via power lines to the national grid.
* At night, when demand for electricity is lower, water is pumped from the low-level reservoir back to the high-level reservoir using the reversible turbines.
* The intake gate is open during the day for electricity generation and closed at night for pumping.

HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ mô tả quy trình sản xuất nước uống sử dụng năng lượng mặt trời.

→ Dạng: process (linear, man-made system)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

The diagram illustrates how drinking water is produced using solar energy.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm 3 giai đoạn chính:

(1) tạo điện → (2) bơm nước → (3) lọc & sử dụng

  • Điểm nổi bật:

→ sử dụng solar energy thay vì điện truyền thống

→ nước được filtered before consumption

4. Body chia logic

BODY 1 – Electricity generation \+ pumping

  • Ban đầu:

→ sunlight is absorbed by a solar panel

  • Sau đó:

→ điện được tạo ra qua a converter

  • Nguồn điện này:

→ powers a pump

  • Kết quả:

→ nước được pumped from an underground well

BODY 2 – Storage \+ filtration \+ usage

  • Nước sau khi bơm:

→ được đưa vào a water tank placed on a wooden platform

  • Tiếp theo:

→ nước đi qua a water filter

  • Cuối cùng:

→ drinking water flows through a tap

→ và được chứa trong a movable container

5. Từ vựng ăn điểm

  • tap → vòi nước
  • container → bình chứa

The diagram illustrates how drinking water is produced using a solar-powered system.

Overall, the process involves extracting water from an underground well, pumping it into a storage tank, filtering it, and finally delivering it through a tap for use. Notably, the entire system is powered by solar energy.

Initially, sunlight is captured by a solar panel, which converts it into electricity. This electricity is then processed through a converter and used to operate a pump. The pump draws water from an underground well and transfers it through a pipe to a water tank positioned on a wooden platform.

Next, the water stored in the tank passes through a built-in filter to remove impurities. Once filtered, the clean drinking water flows out through a tap and can be collected in a movable container for consumption.

title: Process: The diagram below shows how one type of coal is used to produce electricity. Sum...
description: The diagram below shows how one type of coal is used to produce electricity. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Producing electricity from coal

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ mô tả quy trình sản xuất điện từ than đá.

→ Dạng: process (quy trình)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ:

  • electricity – coal

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / depicts
  • process → procedure

Ví dụ:

The diagram illustrates the process of producing electricity from coal.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Quy trình gồm nhiều giai đoạn từ khai thác đến sản xuất điện
  • Than được xử lý, chuyển hóa thành khí và làm sạch trước khi tạo điện
  • Điện được cung cấp cho nhà ở và công trình, đồng thời sinh ra waste heat

→ Quy trình có tính liên kết và tuần hoàn năng lượng (heat, gas)

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Giai đoạn đầu (khai thác → xử lý than)

  • Than được khai thác từ mine
  • Sau đó:
  • được đưa vào crusher để nghiền nhỏ
  • Than nghiền được:
  • vận chuyển bằng truck
  • đưa tới gasifier
  • Tại đây:
  • than được đun nóng (heat)
  • chuyển thành gas

→ Ý: biến than rắn → khí

BODY 2 – Giai đoạn sau (xử lý khí → sản xuất điện)

  • Gas đi vào hệ thống:
  • cooling (làm mát)
  • sau đó cleaning (làm sạch)
  • Khí sạch được đưa vào:
  • gas power plant

→ tại đây:

  • điện được sản xuất và:
  • cung cấp cho buildings và houses
  • Đồng thời:
  • sinh ra waste heat ở nhiều giai đoạn
  • một phần nhiệt được tái sử dụng trong hệ thống

→ Ý: chuyển gas → electricity \+ heat by-products

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • be extracted → được khai thác
  • be crushed → được nghiền
  • be transported → được vận chuyển
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • undergo cooling/cleaning → trải qua quá trình làm mát/làm sạch
  • generate electricity → tạo ra điện
  • by-product → sản phẩm phụ

The diagram illustrates how electricity is produced from coal.

Overall, the process involves several stages, beginning with coal extraction and ending with electricity generation. Coal is first processed into gas, which is then cleaned and used in a power plant, while some waste heat is produced at different stages.

Initially, coal is mined and then crushed into smaller pieces. After that, it is transported by truck to a gasifier, where heat is applied to convert it into gas. This gas is then transferred to a cooling system, during which some waste heat is released.

Next, the cooled gas undergoes a cleaning process to remove impurities. The cleaned gas is subsequently sent to a gas power plant, where it is used to generate electricity. Finally, the electricity is distributed to buildings and households, although additional waste heat is also produced as a by-product of this stage.
chart_description:
TYPE: process diagram
TITLE: Producing electricity from coal
UNITS/AXES: Not applicable
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Not applicable
DATA:
1. Mine (input: coal)
2. Coal (output: coal)
3. Crusher (input: coal, output: crushed coal)
4. Transport by truck (input: crushed coal)
5. Gasifier (input: crushed coal, heat; output: gas, waste heat)
6. Cooling (input: gas from gasifier; output: gas, waste heat)
7. Cleaning (input: gas from cooling; output: cleaned gas)
8. Gas power plant (input: cleaned gas; output: electricity, waste heat)
9. Electricity distribution to buildings (input: electricity from gas power plant)
10. Electricity distribution to house (input: electricity from gas power plant)
KEY FEATURES:
* The process begins with coal extraction from a mine.
* Coal undergoes crushing and is then transported to a gasifier.
* The gasifier produces gas and waste heat, with the gas then being cooled and cleaned.
* The cleaned gas fuels a gas power plant, which generates electricity.
* The gas power plant also produces waste heat as a byproduct.
* Electricity is distributed from the power plant to both buildings and individual houses.

1. Giải thích đề

3. Overview (ý chính)

Insurance increased steadily over the period.

Spending on furniture and equipment fluctuated significantly.

Other workers’ salaries showed a gradual decline.

The three pie charts illustrate how total school spending was allocated across five categories—insurance, teachers’ salaries, furniture and equipment, resources, and other workers’ salaries—in 1981, 1991, and 2001.

Overall, teachers’ salaries consistently accounted for the largest share of expenditure in all three years. In contrast, spending on insurance remained the smallest proportion, although it increased over time. Other categories showed noticeable fluctuations.

In 1981, teachers’ salaries dominated at 40%, followed by other workers’ salaries at 28%. Furniture and equipment and resources each accounted for 15%, while insurance represented only 2%. By 1991, the proportion spent on teachers’ salaries had risen significantly to 50%, whereas spending on furniture and equipment dropped sharply to just 5%. Meanwhile, resources increased slightly to 20%, and other workers’ salaries declined to 22%, with insurance edging up to 3%.

By 2001, teachers’ salaries decreased slightly to 45% but remained the largest category. Spending on furniture and equipment rebounded markedly to 23%, becoming the second-largest expense. In contrast, resources fell to 9%, and other workers’ salaries dropped further to 15%. Insurance, although still the smallest category, increased notably to 8%.

→ giấy không phù hợp bị loại bỏ

  • Bước 3:

→ giấy được vận chuyển (transported) đến paper mill

BODY 2 – Giai đoạn xử lý & sản xuất

  • Bước 4:

→ giấy được làm sạch và nghiền (cleaning & pulping)

→ loại bỏ tạp chất như staplers

  • Bước 5:

→ de-inking

→ mực và keo được loại bỏ

  • Bước 6:

→ đưa vào paper making machine

→ sản xuất giấy mới có thể sử dụng

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • be collected → được thu gom
  • be sorted by hand → được phân loại thủ công
  • be transported to → được vận chuyển đến
  • be cleaned / pulped → được làm sạch / nghiền
  • impurities → tạp chất
  • be removed → được loại bỏ
  • be processed into → được xử lý thành
  • manufacture usable paper → sản xuất giấy sử dụng được

The diagram illustrates the process of recycling waste paper into new, usable paper.

Overall, the procedure consists of six main stages, beginning with the collection of waste paper and ending with the production of new paper through a machine-based process.

Initially, waste paper is collected from public paper banks as well as businesses. It is then sorted by hand, during which it is graded and any unsuitable materials are removed. After sorting, the selected paper is transported to a paper mill.

At the mill, the paper undergoes cleaning, where it is pulped and contaminants such as staples are removed. This is followed by a de-inking stage, in which inks and adhesives are eliminated from the pulp. Finally, the cleaned material is processed in a paper-making machine to produce new sheets of paper.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Pie charts: Range of books and non-print materials (Undergraduate vs Postgraduate)

1. Giải thích đề

Bộ 4 biểu đồ tròn cho thấy mức độ đánh giá (very good, satisfaction, not good) của sinh viên đại học và sau đại học đối với hai loại tài liệu: books và non-print materials.

→ Dạng: multiple pie charts (so sánh giữa 2 nhóm \+ 2 loại tài liệu)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ các từ khóa:

range of books

non-print materials

undergraduate / postgraduate

ratings

Có thể dùng:

shows → illustrates / compares

opinions → evaluations

Mẫu:

The pie charts illustrate the evaluations of books and non-print materials by undergraduate and postgraduate students.

3. Overview (ý chính)

Undergraduates đánh giá books tích cực hơn non-print materials

Postgraduates không hài lòng với books nhưng đánh giá cao non-print materials

“Not good” cao nhất ở postgraduate – non-print materials

→ sự khác biệt rõ giữa hai nhóm sinh viên

Từ khóa nên dùng:

showed contrasting patterns

were more satisfied with

recorded the highest proportion

were less positive about

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Books (Undergraduate vs Postgraduate)

Undergraduate (Books):

very good: 37%

satisfaction: 35%

not good: 28%

→ đánh giá khá tích cực

Postgraduate (Books):

not good: 50% (cao nhất)

satisfaction: 28%

very good: 22%

→ đánh giá tiêu cực hơn

Ý chính: sinh viên đại học hài lòng hơn với books, trong khi sau đại học có xu hướng không hài lòng

BODY 2 – Non-print materials

Undergraduate:

very good: 68% (áp đảo)

satisfaction: 20%

not good: 12%

→ đánh giá rất cao

Postgraduate:

not good: 62% (cao nhất)

satisfaction: 22%

very good: 12%

→ đánh giá thấp

Ý chính: undergraduate đánh giá non-print materials rất tích cực, trái ngược hoàn toàn với postgraduate

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

account for

make up

represent

the largest proportion

be satisfied with

be dissatisfied with

show a contrast

Ví dụ:

Among undergraduates, “very good” accounted for the largest proportion in non-print materials.

Postgraduates were less satisfied with books, with “not good” making up half of the responses.

There is a clear contrast between the two groups in their evaluation of non-print materials.

The charts illustrate how undergraduate and postgraduate students evaluated the range of books and non-print materials, using three categories: very good, satisfactory, and not good.

Overall, undergraduates expressed considerably more positive views than postgraduates across both types of resources. While books received relatively balanced feedback from undergraduates, postgraduate students were more critical, particularly of non-print materials, which attracted predominantly negative ratings.

In terms of books, undergraduate responses were generally favourable, with 37% rating the range as very good and 35% as satisfactory, leaving 28% dissatisfied. By contrast, postgraduate students showed a clear tendency towards negative evaluation, as half of them (50%) considered the book range not good, compared to only 22% who rated it very good and 28% who were satisfied.

A similar but more pronounced disparity can be observed for non-print materials. Among undergraduates, a substantial majority of 68% gave a very good rating, while 20% were satisfied and just 12% expressed dissatisfaction. In contrast, postgraduate students displayed the opposite pattern, with 62% rating these resources as not good. Only 22% reported satisfaction, and a mere 12% considered them very good.
