- Picnic Area (east, with two picnic tables and trees)

KEY FEATURES:
- The "African animals" enclosure moved from the west to the central-right area.
- The "Birds" and "Chimpanzees" enclosures were removed.
- A new "Wild animals" enclosure was added in the west.
- Two "Entrance" points were added, one in the south-west and one in the north-east.
- A "Ferry" service and a "Cable car" system were introduced.
- The "Harbour", "Australian animals" enclosure, "Gift shop", "Seal Show", and "Picnic Area" remained in similar locations, though the "Seal Show" shifted slightly south-east.

title: Map: The maps showed the changes in a city centre from the year 2000 to the present day
description: The maps showed the changes in a city centre from the year 2000 to the present day. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Nelson City (2000 vs Now)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi của thành phố Nelson từ năm 2000 đến hiện tại.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time (urban development)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: Nelson city – 2000 – now

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • now → at present / currently
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Thành phố được hiện đại hoá và phát triển mạnh về thương mại & dịch vụ
  • Xuất hiện nhiều công trình mới như shopping centre, residence, restaurants
  • Trung tâm thành phố trở thành khu dành cho người đi bộ
  • Giao thông và tiện ích công cộng được cải thiện rõ rệt
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu trung tâm & giao thông
2000:
  • City centre khá đơn giản
  • Có đường cho xe chạy qua
  • Train station nằm tách biệt
  • Old market ở phía tây
Now:
  • City centre → pedestrian-only area
  • Thêm bike rental scheme
  • Train station → new train station (hiện đại hơn)
  • Xuất hiện new covered market

→ Ý: trung tâm chuyển sang thân thiện với người đi bộ và hiện đại hơn

BODY 2 – Cơ sở hạ tầng & tiện ích mới
2000:
  • Có university, old market, port
  • Ít tiện ích giải trí / thương mại
Now:
  • Thêm:
  • Hall of residence
  • New shopping centre
  • Restaurants, bars and clubs
  • New shop
  • Port: giữ nguyên
  • University: không thay đổi đáng kể

→ Ý: thành phố phát triển theo hướng dịch vụ – thương mại – giải trí

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be transformed into → được chuyển đổi thành
  • be upgraded → được nâng cấp
  • pedestrian-only area → khu chỉ dành cho người đi bộ
  • urban development → phát triển đô thị
  • modern facilities → cơ sở hiện đại
  • commercial expansion → mở rộng thương mại

The maps compare Nelson city in 2000 with its current layout.

Overall, the city has undergone substantial modernisation, with significant additions to transport, commercial, and leisure facilities. The road system has also been adapted to prioritise pedestrians, while the city centre has become more service-oriented.

In 2000, Nelson had a relatively simple structure. A university was located in the north, with a train station to the west. The city centre occupied the middle area, while an old market was situated to the southwest. A main road ran horizontally across the city, allowing vehicle access, and a port was located in the south.

At present, several new developments can be observed. The original train station has been replaced by a new one closer to the centre, and student accommodation in the form of a hall of residence has been added near the university. A large shopping centre has been constructed in the northeast.

Within the city centre, a bike rental scheme has been introduced, and the main road has been converted into a pedestrian-only zone. Commercial activity has expanded, with the addition of a new shop and a covered market. In the southern area, new leisure facilities such as a restaurant, bars, and clubs have been developed near the port.

title: Map: A school in 1985 and the school now
description: The map below shows a school in 1985 and the school now. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

School (1985 vs Now)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi của một trường học từ năm 1985 đến hiện tại, bao gồm cả quy mô học sinh.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: school – 1985 – now

Dùng:

  • show → illustrate / compare
  • now → at present / currently
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Quy mô trường mở rộng đáng kể (1500 → 2300 học sinh)
  • Số lượng và quy mô phòng học tăng mạnh
  • Xuất hiện nhiều cơ sở mới (fitness centre, pool, learning resources centre)
  • Bãi đỗ xe và bố cục tổng thể được tái thiết kế
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu trung tâm & học tập
  • Năm 1985:
  • Có office và library ở bên trái
  • Một khu classrooms nhỏ và một classroom block (2 storeys) bên phải
  • Hiện tại:
  • Library → replaced by Learning Resources Centre (có computer room)
  • Số lượng phòng học tăng lên rõ rệt
  • Classroom block được mở rộng lên 3 tầng
  • Thêm nhiều classrooms mới ở cả hai phía

→ Ý: tập trung nâng cấp cơ sở học tập, phục vụ nhiều học sinh hơn

BODY 2 – Khu ngoài trời & tiện ích
  • Năm 1985:
  • Có 2 car parks (một lớn phía trên, một nhỏ ở giữa)
  • Playing fields chiếm phần lớn phía dưới
  • Hiện tại:
  • Car park được mở rộng và gộp thành khu lớn duy nhất
  • Xuất hiện:
  • Pool
  • Fitness centre
  • Thêm trees ở khu trung tâm
  • Playing fields vẫn giữ nhưng bị thu hẹp nhẹ

→ Ý: tăng tiện ích và tối ưu không gian

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be upgraded → được nâng cấp
  • be reorganised → được tái bố trí
  • additional facilities → tiện ích bổ sung
  • accommodate more students → đáp ứng nhiều học sinh hơn

The diagrams compare the layout of a school in 1985 and at present.

Overall, the school has been significantly expanded to accommodate a larger student population, with more facilities added and existing buildings upgraded.

In 1985, the school had a relatively simple layout. The office and library were located on the left, while classrooms were spread across the centre and a two-storey classroom block stood on the right. There were two car parks near the entrance, and large playing fields occupied the southern part of the site.

At present, the school has been modernised and enlarged. The library has been replaced by a learning resources centre with a computer room, and additional classrooms have been built. The classroom block on the right has been extended to three storeys. New facilities, including a swimming pool and a fitness centre, have been added in the southwest. The car park has been redesigned into a larger central area, and trees have been introduced along the main road.

title: Map: The diagrams below compare the layout of a typical Japanese office and a typical A...
description: The diagrams below compare the layout of a typical Japanese office and a typical American office. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Japanese office vs American office
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ so sánh bố cục của một văn phòng điển hình ở Nhật Bản và Mỹ.

→ Dạng: map – comparison (không có thời gian)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: office layouts – Japanese – American

Dùng:

  • show → illustrate / compare
  • typical → typical / standard
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Văn phòng Nhật: bố cục mở, phân cấp rõ ràng, ít phòng riêng
  • Văn phòng Mỹ: chia nhiều phòng chức năng, riêng tư hơn
  • Cách sắp xếp phản ánh:

→ Nhật: tập trung vào làm việc nhóm & giám sát

→ Mỹ: ưu tiên sự riêng tư & chức năng chuyên biệt

4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Japanese office
  • Department manager ngồi ở phía trước, gần cửa sổ
  • Hai bên là section managers
  • Nhân viên ngồi thành các cụm bàn lớn (open-plan)
  • Không có phòng riêng hay khu chức năng riêng biệt

→ Ý:

  • Cấu trúc phân cấp (hierarchical) rõ ràng
  • Dễ quan sát và quản lý nhân viên
BODY 2 – American office
  • Không gian được chia thành nhiều phòng riêng biệt:
  • Copy room
  • Storage
  • Conference rooms
  • Department manager có phòng riêng lớn
  • Section managers cũng có không gian riêng
  • Nhân viên làm việc tại các cubicles nhỏ

→ Ý:

  • Tăng tính riêng tư (privacy)
  • Mỗi khu vực có chức năng cụ thể
5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • open-plan layout → bố cục mở
  • partitioned office → văn phòng chia khu
  • be arranged in clusters → được bố trí theo cụm
  • private office → phòng riêng
  • hierarchical structure → cấu trúc phân cấp
  • functional areas → khu chức năng

The diagrams compare the layouts of a typical Japanese office and a typical American office.

Overall, the Japanese office is more open and hierarchical, with managers positioned among employees, whereas the American office is more segmented, with separate rooms for different functions and greater privacy.

In the Japanese office, the department manager sits at the front facing the staff, while two section managers are placed among groups of employees. Workers are seated in clusters in an open-plan arrangement, and there are no separate rooms, creating a more collective working environment.

In contrast, the American office is divided into distinct areas. Shared facilities such as a copy room, storage, and conference rooms are located on one side, while managers have their own private offices on the other. Employees sit in small workstation groups in the centre, separated by partitions. This layout emphasises individual space and clearly defined roles compared to the more integrated Japanese design.
chart_description:
TYPE: map/plan
TITLE: Typical Japanese office; Typical American office
UNITS/AXES: Compass rose (N, W, E, S)
SERIES/CATEGORIES:
Typical Japanese office: Windows, Department manager, Section manager, Chair

DATA:
Typical Japanese office:
- Department manager: located at the top center, facing south, with windows behind.
- Section manager (left): located below and to the left of the Department manager, facing south.
- Section manager (right): located below and to the right of the Department manager, facing south.
- Employee desks (left block): 3 rows of 2 desks each, arranged in a block below the left Section manager. Each desk has a chair facing north.
- Employee desks (right block): 3 rows of 2 desks each, arranged in a block below the right Section manager. Each desk has a chair facing north.

Typical American office:
- Windows: located on the left side.
- Copy room: top left, next to windows.
- Storage: second from top left, next to windows.
- Conference room (top): third from top left, next to windows.
- Conference room (bottom): bottom left, next to windows.
- Employee workstations (left column): 4 L-shaped workstations, each with a chair, arranged in a column.
- Employee workstations (right column): 4 L-shaped workstations, each with a chair, arranged in a column.
- Section manager (top right): top right corner.
- Section manager (middle right): second from top right.
- Department manager: bottom right corner.
KEY FEATURES:
- The Japanese office has an open-plan layout with managers facing their teams.
- The American office has a more compartmentalized layout with private offices and dedicated rooms.
- Windows are located at the top in the Japanese office and on the left in the American office.
- Managers in the Japanese office are positioned centrally, while in the American office, they are along one side.
- The Japanese office features rows of individual desks, while the American office uses L-shaped workstations.
- The American office includes dedicated rooms like copy rooms, storage, and conference rooms, which are not explicitly shown in the Japanese office layout.

title: Map: The diagrams below show the development of a town called Brindell and the local ar...
description: The diagrams below show the development of a town called Brindell and the local areas in 1800, 1900 and 2000. Summarize the information and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Brindell area (1800 → 1900 → 2000\)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự phát triển của khu vực Brindell trong ba mốc thời gian: 1800, 1900 và 2000\.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time (3 stages)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: Brindell – 1800 / 1900 / 2000

Dùng:

  • show → illustrate / compare
  • over time → over a 200-year period
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Khu vực chuyển từ nông nghiệp → công nghiệp và đô thị hóa
  • Xuất hiện industry và khu dân cư (Bun Hill) từ năm 1900
  • Đến năm 2000:
  • Công nghiệp mở rộng đáng kể
  • Một phần woodland được chuyển thành công viên (Bun Hill Park)
  • Sông và một số khu đất giữ nguyên tương đối
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Giai đoạn 1800 → 1900
  • Năm 1800:
  • Chủ yếu là:
  • Farm land (crops & animals)
  • Woodland
  • Chưa có khu dân cư hay công nghiệp
  • Năm 1900:
  • Khu đất nuôi động vật → converted into industry
  • Xuất hiện:
  • Bun Hill (village for workers)
  • Các khu khác (crops, woodland, river) hầu như không đổi

→ Ý: bắt đầu công nghiệp hoá

BODY 2 – Giai đoạn 1900 → 2000
  • Industry mở rộng đáng kể (tăng số lượng nhà máy)
  • Bun Hill vẫn giữ nguyên vị trí
  • Woodland:
  • Một phần → converted into Bun Hill Park
  • Các khu khác:
  • Farm land (crops) và River Stour gần như không thay đổi

→ Ý: phát triển mạnh nhưng có yếu tố cải thiện môi trường (park)

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be transformed into → được chuyển đổi thành
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • remain unchanged → giữ nguyên
  • industrial development → sự phát triển công nghiệp
  • urbanisation → đô thị hoá

The maps illustrate changes in the area around the River Stour between 1800 and 2000\.

Overall, the area underwent gradual industrialisation and development, with farmland for animals replaced by industry and a workers’ village, while a new park was later created and woodland expanded.

In 1800, the landscape was largely rural. Farmland for crops was located in the northwest, while woodland occupied the northeast. In the southeast, land was used for animals, and the settlement of Brindell lay in the southwest. The River Stour ran through the centre of the area.

By 1900, significant changes had occurred in the southeast, where the animal farmland had been replaced by an industrial zone. A village named Bun Hill was also established nearby to accommodate workers. However, the farmland for crops, woodland, and Brindell remained largely unchanged.

In 2000, further development took place. The industrial area expanded considerably, and Bun Hill remained in place. A large park, Bun Hill Park, was created in the northeast, replacing part of the woodland. Meanwhile, the farmland for crops and the settlement of Brindell continued to exist with little change.

1800:

- Brindell: South-West

- Farm land (crops) and Brindell remained unchanged throughout the period.
- Farm land (animals) was replaced by Bun Hill and Industry by 1900.
- Woodland area decreased significantly by 2000, with part of it becoming Bun Hill Park.
- Industry expanded considerably between 1900 and 2000.
- Bun Hill (village for workers) was established by 1900 and slightly expanded by 2000.

title: Map: The plans below show a public park when it first opened in 1920 and the same park ...
description: The plans below show a public park when it first opened in 1920 and the same park today. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Grange Park (1920 vs Today)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi của Grange Park từ năm 1920 đến hiện tại.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: Grange Park – 1920 – today

Dùng:

  • show → illustrate / compare
  • today → at present / currently
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Công viên được hiện đại hoá đáng kể
  • Một số hạng mục cũ bị thay thế hoàn toàn (stage, glasshouse, pond)
  • Thêm nhiều tiện ích mới: café, children’s play area, amphitheatre, underground car park
  • Bố cục trở nên tập trung và có tổ chức hơn
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu trung tâm
  • Năm 1920:
  • Có fountain ở trung tâm
  • Stage for musicians nằm bên trái
  • Hiện tại:
  • Fountain → replaced by a rose garden (ở trung tâm)
  • Stage → converted into an amphitheatre for concerts

→ Ý: chuyển từ không gian đơn giản → không gian phục vụ giải trí quy mô hơn

BODY 2 – Khu xung quanh & tiện ích
  • Bị loại bỏ:
  • Glasshouse (góc dưới phải)
  • Pond for water plants (góc trên phải)
  • Được thay thế / bổ sung:
  • Water feature (thay pond)
  • Café \+ children’s play area (góc trên phải)
  • Underground car park entrance (góc dưới phải)
  • Giữ lại:
  • Rose gardens (nhưng bố trí lại)
  • Seats (phân bố xung quanh)

→ Ý: tăng tiện ích cho người dùng hiện đại

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be removed → bị loại bỏ
  • be introduced → được thêm vào
  • recreational facilities → tiện ích giải trí
  • modernised layout → bố cục hiện đại hoá

The maps compare the layout of Grange Park in 1920 and at present.

Overall, the park has been significantly modernised, with the addition of recreational and commercial facilities, while some original features have been removed or relocated.

In 1920, the park was relatively traditional in design. There were rose gardens in three corners, along with a stage for musicians on the left and a central fountain. A pond for water plants was located on the right, and a glasshouse occupied the bottom-right corner. Seating areas were distributed around the park, and there were two entrances from Arnold Avenue and Eldon Street.

Today, the layout is more diverse and functional. The stage has been replaced by an amphitheatre for concerts on the left. The central fountain has been removed and replaced by a large circular rose garden surrounded by seating. On the right-hand side, the pond has been redeveloped into a water feature, while a café and a children’s play area have been added in the upper-right area. The glasshouse has been removed to make way for an underground car park, with its entrance located in the bottom-right corner.

*   **South-East corner:** Entrance underground car park
*   **Eldon Street (South side):** Entrance

KEY FEATURES:

*   The "Stage for musicians" and "Fountain" in the center have been replaced by a circular "Rose garden" with surrounding seats.
*   The "Pond for water plant" and "Glasshouse" have been removed, replaced by a "Café", "Children's play area", and a "Water feature".

title: Map: The plans below show a student room for two people and a student room for one pers...
description: The plans below show a student room for two people and a student room for one person at an Australian university. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Student room (one person vs two people)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ so sánh bố trí của phòng sinh viên dành cho một người và hai người.

→ Dạng: map / layout comparison

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: student room – one person – two people

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • for → designed for / intended for
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Phòng cho 2 người rộng hơn đáng kể
  • Bố trí phức tạp hơn với nhiều nội thất hơn
  • Phòng 1 người đơn giản, tối ưu không gian cá nhân
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Phòng 2 người (chi tiết chính)
  • Kích thước: lớn hơn (6m × 4m)
  • Có 2 giường \+ 2 bàn học
  • Có thêm:
  • bàn ăn (table & chairs)
  • nhiều không gian sinh hoạt hơn
  • Bathroom: giữ ở góc trên bên trái
  • Có khu bếp (sink, stove, microwave)

→ Ý: không gian đa chức năng, dùng chung

BODY 2 – Phòng 1 người
  • Kích thước nhỏ hơn (6m × 2.5m)
  • Chỉ có:
  • 1 giường
  • 1 bàn học
  • Không có bàn ăn
  • Ít nội thất hơn → bố trí đơn giản hơn nhiều
  • Kitchen area: vẫn có nhưng gọn hơn
  • Bathroom: giữ nguyên vị trí tương tự

→ Ý: thiết kế tối giản, tập trung cá nhân

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be designed for → được thiết kế cho
  • be equipped with → được trang bị
  • be located in → nằm ở
  • be larger / smaller than → lớn hơn / nhỏ hơn
  • a shared space → không gian dùng chung
  • a compact layout → bố trí nhỏ gọn
Ví dụ
  • The larger room is designed for two occupants.
  • It is equipped with two beds and two study desks.
  • The single room has a more compact layout.
  • Fewer facilities are provided in the smaller room.
  • Both rooms include a bathroom in a similar position.

The diagrams compare the layout of a student room designed for two people and one designed for a single occupant, along with their respective weekly costs.

Overall, the room for two people is larger and contains more furniture and facilities, while the single room is more compact and simpler in design. Despite the higher total cost, the shared room appears more cost-effective per person.

The room for two people measures 6 metres by 4 metres and costs $350 per week. It includes two beds positioned on the right side, separated by a cupboard. Each occupant has a study desk, one near the top and the other near the bottom. A bathroom is located in the top-left corner, and the central area contains a table and chairs. Additional facilities such as a television, microwave, sink, and stove are arranged along the left wall.

In contrast, the single room is smaller, measuring 6 metres by 2.5 metres, and costs $200 per week. It contains only one bed and one study desk, both placed on the right side. The bathroom remains in a similar position, but the central space is more limited and does not include a table and chairs. The kitchen facilities are still present along the left wall, although arranged more compactly.

title: Map: The plans below show the layout of the ground floor of a museum in 1990 and 2010
description: The plans below show the layout of the ground floor of a museum in 1990 and 2010. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Ground floor of museum (1990 vs 2010\)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi ở tầng trệt của một bảo tàng từ năm 1990 đến 2010\.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: ground floor – museum – 1990 – 2010

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • changes → developments / alterations
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Bảo tàng được hiện đại hóa và đa dạng hóa chức năng
  • Thêm khu cho trẻ em, khu trưng bày mới và tiện ích (café, lift)
  • Một số khu cũ bị thay thế hoặc bố trí lại (archaeology gallery biến mất)
  • Không gian trở nên hướng đến trải nghiệm khách tham quan hơn
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu trung tâm & bên phải
  • Năm 1990:
  • Archaeology gallery chiếm toàn bộ phía phải
  • Local history room ở góc dưới bên phải
  • Năm 2010:
  • Archaeology gallery bị loại bỏ
  • Thay bằng:
  • Children’s interactive zone (góc trên phải)
  • Poster display area (trung tâm phải)
  • Local history room vẫn giữ nhưng dịch chuyển vị trí nhẹ

→ Ý: chuyển từ trưng bày học thuật → trải nghiệm tương tác

BODY 2 – Khu bên trái & tiện ích
  • Gift shop → café and gift shop (mở rộng chức năng)
  • Thêm lift gần khu này
  • Natural history room gần như giữ nguyên vị trí
  • Museum office vẫn giữ nhưng bố cục điều chỉnh nhẹ
  • Reception counter vẫn ở trung tâm nhưng dịch chuyển vị trí
  • Khu trung tâm trở nên thoáng và đa chức năng hơn
5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be replaced by → được thay thế bởi
  • be introduced → được thêm vào
  • be relocated → được di dời
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • visitor-oriented → hướng tới khách tham quan

The diagrams compare the layout of the ground floor of a museum in 1990 and 2010\.

Overall, the museum was significantly modernised over the period, with new facilities added for visitors and a reorganisation of exhibition spaces. Notably, a children’s area and a café were introduced, while the archaeology gallery was removed.

In 1990, the entrance was located at the bottom centre, leading to a reception counter slightly to the left. On the left side of the building, there was a gift shop at the top and a natural history room below it, while the museum office occupied the bottom-left corner. On the right-hand side, the archaeology gallery took up most of the space, with a local history room positioned in the lower-right corner. A statue stood near the centre, and stairs were located at the top of the layout.

By 2010, several changes had been made. The gift shop was combined with a café and remained in the upper-left area, and a lift was added nearby to improve accessibility. The archaeology gallery was replaced by a children’s interactive zone in the top-right corner, and a poster display area was introduced in the centre-right. The local history room was relocated to the bottom-right corner, while the natural history room remained on the left but was slightly repositioned. The reception counter was moved more towards the centre, and the central statue was retained.

title: Map: The plans below show a traditional and modern two-storey Japanese house
description: The plans below show a traditional and modern two-storey Japanese house. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Traditional vs Modern Japanese House
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ so sánh cấu trúc của một ngôi nhà Nhật Bản truyền thống và hiện đại, bao gồm cả tầng trệt và tầng trên.

→ Dạng: map/diagram – comparison (2 layouts)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: traditional – modern – Japanese house – upstairs/downstairs

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • modern → contemporary
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Nhà hiện đại có bố cục rõ ràng và chức năng chuyên biệt hơn
  • Không gian truyền thống linh hoạt (tatami, futon) → bị thay bằng phòng cố định (bedrooms)
  • Số lượng phòng ngủ và phòng tắm tăng lên đáng kể
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Downstairs (tầng trệt)
Traditional:
  • Có kitchen \+ bathroom riêng biệt
  • Một phòng đa năng (Room 1\) dùng ngủ bằng futon
  • Không có phòng khách rõ ràng
  • Không gian tương đối đóng và chia nhỏ
Modern:
  • Xuất hiện living/dining area (không gian sinh hoạt chung lớn)
  • Kitchen vẫn giữ nhưng tích hợp tốt hơn
  • Khu tatami bị thu hẹp
  • Bố cục trở nên mở và tiện nghi hơn

→ Ý: chuyển từ không gian linh hoạt → không gian sinh hoạt cố định, hiện đại

BODY 2 – Upstairs (tầng trên)
Traditional:
  • Chỉ có 2 phòng (Room 2 & Room 3\)
  • Không có phòng tắm
  • Không gian vẫn mang tính đa chức năng
Modern:
  • Chia thành:
  • Main bedroom
  • Bedroom 2 & 3
  • Thêm bathroom (thậm chí 2 phòng tắm)
  • Các phòng được phân chia rõ ràng theo chức năng

→ Ý: tầng trên được chuyên môn hoá và tiện nghi hơn

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • multifunctional space → không gian đa chức năng
  • dedicated rooms → phòng chức năng riêng
  • open-plan layout → thiết kế không gian mở
  • be partitioned into → được chia thành

The diagrams compare the layout of a traditional Japanese house with that of a modern Japanese house, showing both downstairs and upstairs areas.

Overall, the modern house has been redesigned to provide more permanent and specialised rooms, replacing the flexible, multi-purpose spaces of the traditional layout. There is also a clearer separation of functions, particularly with the addition of multiple bedrooms and bathrooms.

In the traditional house, the ground floor consisted mainly of a kitchen and a bathroom, alongside a tatami room (Room 1\) that served as a sleeping area at night using futons stored in a cupboard. Upstairs, there were two similar tatami rooms (Rooms 2 and 3), both used flexibly for sleeping and living purposes, with storage spaces provided by cupboards.

In contrast, the modern house has a more structured design. On the ground floor, the main living area has been converted into a combined living and dining space, while the kitchen remains in a similar position. The use of tatami flooring and futons is reduced, reflecting a shift towards Western-style living.

Upstairs, the modern layout includes three separate bedrooms, including a main bedroom and two smaller bedrooms. Additionally, two bathrooms have been installed, significantly increasing convenience compared to the single bathroom in the traditional house. Overall, the changes highlight a move from flexible, minimalistic living to a more compartmentalised and comfort-oriented design.

title: Map: The village park, now and 10 years ago
description: The map shows the village park, now and 10 years ago. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Village park (10 years ago vs now)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi của một công viên làng trong vòng 10 năm.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: village park – 10 years ago – now

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • now → at present / currently
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Công viên được hiện đại hoá và bổ sung nhiều tiện ích
  • Các yếu tố tự nhiên (pond, woods) biến mất
  • Xuất hiện thêm khu vui chơi, cafe và đường đi xe đạp
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu trung tâm & thể thao
  • Tennis courts:
  • 2 → 4 (mở rộng)
  • Football pitch: giữ nhưng thay đổi vị trí nhẹ
  • Pond \+ woods → bị loại bỏ
  • Thêm picnic area

→ Ý: chuyển từ không gian tự nhiên sang khu giải trí có tổ chức

BODY 2 – Khu tiện ích & dịch vụ
  • Car park:
  • 20 → 50 cars (mở rộng đáng kể)
  • Children’s play area:
  • được giữ và mở rộng
  • thêm soft play area
  • Thêm:
  • Toilets
  • Cafe
  • Cycle path (xung quanh công viên)

→ Ý: tăng mạnh dịch vụ phục vụ người dùng

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be removed → bị loại bỏ
  • be introduced → được bổ sung
  • recreational facilities → tiện ích giải trí
  • natural features → yếu tố tự nhiên

The diagrams compare the layout of a village park now with its design 10 years ago.

Overall, the park has undergone substantial redevelopment, with more recreational facilities added and existing ones expanded. Natural features such as the pond and woods have been removed, while new amenities including a café, toilets, and a picnic area have been introduced.

Ten years ago, the park contained relatively basic facilities. In the centre was a football pitch, with two tennis courts located to the north. To the east, there was a children’s play area, while a small car park for 20 vehicles lay to the west. In the southern part, a pond was surrounded by a wooded area.

At present, the park is more developed and better equipped. The number of tennis courts has doubled to four and remains in the northern section. The car park has been expanded significantly to accommodate 50 cars near the entrance. The children’s play area has been upgraded and divided into two zones: a standard play area and a soft play area, with toilets added nearby.

In the southern half, the pond and woods have been replaced by a large picnic area, and a café has been built in the southeast corner. A cycle path now runs along the bottom of the park, further improving accessibility.

title: Map: The plans below show a small theatre in 2010, and the same theatre in 2012
description: The plans below show a small theatre in 2010, and the same theatre in 2012. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

A small theatre (2010 vs 2012\)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi trong bố trí của một nhà hát nhỏ giữa năm 2010 và 2012\.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

The diagrams illustrate the changes in the layout of a small theatre between 2010 and 2012.

3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Nhà hát được hiện đại hoá với nhiều tiện ích mới
  • Khu vực phía trước chuyển từ cafe → restaurant
  • Không gian phía sau được tái bố trí (coordination room, showers)
  • Auditorium và stage: hầu như giữ nguyên
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu phía trên & trung tâm
  • Stage và auditorium: không thay đổi đáng kể
  • Dressing room: thu nhỏ và chuyển sang bên trái
  • Storage (bên trái) → bị thay bằng showers
  • Xuất hiện:
  • Coordination room (ở phía trên)
  • Admin office (góc trên bên phải)

→ Ý: khu hậu trường được tổ chức lại chuyên nghiệp hơn

BODY 2 – Khu phía dưới (front area)
  • Cafe → được thay bằng restaurant lớn hơn
  • Ticket office: chuyển sang bên phải
  • Admin office (bên trái dưới) → bị loại bỏ
  • Storage mới: xuất hiện gần khu restaurant
  • Main entrance: giữ nguyên vị trí

→ Ý: khu đón khách được mở rộng và nâng cấp dịch vụ

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be relocated → được di dời
  • be removed → bị loại bỏ
  • be introduced → được bổ sung
  • be reorganised → được tái bố trí
Ví dụ
  • The cafe was converted into a larger restaurant.
  • The ticket office was relocated to the opposite side.
  • A coordination room was introduced above the stage.
  • The dressing room was reduced in size.
  • The main entrance remained unchanged.

The diagrams illustrate the layout of a small theatre in 2010 and after redevelopment in 2012\.

Overall, the theatre was significantly modernised, with new facilities added and several areas reorganised. While the stage and auditorium remained central features, supporting spaces were relocated or expanded to improve functionality and visitor experience.

In 2010, the theatre had a relatively simple structure. The stage was positioned centrally, with a dressing room directly above it and a storage area to the left. The auditorium occupied the largest space below the stage. On the lower-left side, there was an admin office above a ticket office, while a café was located on the lower-right side near the main entrance.

By 2012, several notable changes had taken place. The dressing room was moved to the upper-left corner and reduced in size, while a new coordination area replaced the previous dressing room space. An admin office was relocated to the top-right corner. In addition, showers were introduced next to the dressing room.

At the bottom of the theatre, the café was replaced by a restaurant, and the ticket office was moved to the lower-right corner. A new storage area was added near the restaurant, replacing the original storage position. Overall, the redesign reflects a shift towards improved facilities for both staff and visitors.

TYPE: map/plan
TITLE: A small theatre in 2010 and in 2012

title: Map: The maps below show the centre of a small town called Islip as it is now, and plan...
description: The maps below show the centre of a small town called Islip as it is now, and plans for its development. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Islip town centre (now vs planned development)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy hiện trạng và kế hoạch phát triển của trung tâm thị trấn Islip.

→ Dạng: map – future changes

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: Islip town centre – now – planned development

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • planned development → proposed changes / future development
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Khu trung tâm sẽ được tái phát triển toàn diện
  • Thêm vành đai đường (dual carriageway) bao quanh
  • Khu trung tâm chuyển thành khu đi bộ (pedestrian-only area)
  • Xuất hiện nhiều tiện ích mới (bus station, shopping centre, car park, new housing)
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Hệ thống giao thông & bố cục
  • Hiện tại:
  • Một tuyến đường chính chạy ngang qua khu shops
  • Không có đường bao quanh
  • Tương lai:
  • Xây dual carriageway bao quanh toàn bộ khu trung tâm
  • Đường bên trong trở thành pedestrian-only zone
  • Giao thông được tách biệt rõ ràng

→ Ý: chuyển từ xe cộ → ưu tiên người đi bộ

BODY 2 – Khu chức năng & sử dụng đất
  • Khu phía Bắc:
  • Shops hiện tại → vẫn giữ
  • Thêm:
  • Bus station
  • Shopping centre
  • Car park
  • New housing
  • Khu phía Nam:
  • Housing → mở rộng thêm new housing
  • Park giữ nguyên vị trí
  • School: hầu như không thay đổi

→ Ý: tăng mật độ đô thị \+ bổ sung tiện ích hiện đại

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be redeveloped → được tái phát triển
  • be surrounded by → được bao quanh bởi
  • pedestrian-only area → khu dành riêng cho người đi bộ
  • transport infrastructure → cơ sở hạ tầng giao thông
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • new facilities are proposed → đề xuất thêm tiện ích

The maps show the current layout of Islip town centre and its planned redevelopment.

Overall, the town will undergo major changes, with a new ring road, additional facilities, and expanded housing, while the central shopping area will be reorganised into a pedestrian zone.

At present, shops are concentrated along a main road running east–west, with countryside to the north and housing to the south. A school lies in the southwest, and a park is located to the southeast, connected by a minor road.

In the proposed plan, a dual carriageway will form a loop around the centre, improving traffic flow. Inside this ring road, the central street will become pedestrian-only, with shops retained but reorganised. New facilities, including a bus station, shopping centre, and car park, will be added to the north, replacing the countryside. Housing will be expanded, particularly to the south and east, while the park will remain in the southeast. The school, however, will stay in its original location.

- A bus station, shopping centre, and car park are introduced in the northern part of the town centre.
- An area designated for "Pedestrians only" is created.
- New housing is added within the new road layout.

title: Map: The map of a University Sports Centre in 2007 and at present
description: The picture shows the map of a University Sports Centre in 2007 and at present. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

University sports centre (2007 vs present day)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi của trung tâm thể thao đại học từ năm 2007 đến hiện tại.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: university sports centre – 2007 – present day

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • present day → currently / at present
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Trung tâm được mở rộng đáng kể và hiện đại hoá
  • Số lượng cơ sở đào tạo và y tế tăng mạnh
  • Khu thể thao được nâng cấp (football pitch, thêm running track)
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu phía trên (sports area)
  • Football pitch:
  • grass → all-weather surface
  • Thêm running track xung quanh

→ Ý: nâng cấp chất lượng cơ sở thể thao chính

BODY 2 – Khu trung tâm
  • Swimming pool: giữ nguyên
  • Tennis court → được thay bằng squash court
  • Teaching facility:
  • 20 → 47 (tăng mạnh)

→ Ý: tăng cường cơ sở đào tạo & đa dạng môn thể thao

BODY 3 – Khu phía dưới (new facilities)
  • Temporary huts → bị loại bỏ hoàn toàn
  • Xuất hiện:
  • First aid room
  • Clinic
  • Lab
  • 2-storey teaching facilities

→ Ý: mở rộng sang dịch vụ y tế & học thuật

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be upgraded → được nâng cấp
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • be removed → bị loại bỏ
  • be introduced → được bổ sung
  • all-weather surface → mặt sân đa thời tiết

The diagrams illustrate the changes made to a university sports centre between 2007 and the present day.

Overall, the site has been significantly upgraded, with the addition of new facilities and expansion of existing ones. While the football pitch remains the central feature, it has been enhanced, and several new sports and medical facilities have been introduced.

In 2007, the sports centre was relatively simple. A grass football pitch occupied the northern area. Below it, there was a swimming pool and a teaching facility with a capacity of 20 students. A tennis court was located to the southwest of the pool. At the southern end, a temporary teaching hut was positioned along a path.

At present, the football pitch has been converted into an all-weather surface and is now surrounded by a running track. The teaching facility has been expanded substantially, increasing its capacity to 47\. The former tennis court has been replaced by a squash court, while the swimming pool remains unchanged in position.

The most notable development is in the southern area, where the temporary huts have been removed and replaced with permanent buildings, including a first aid room, a clinic, a laboratory, and two-storey teaching facilities.

title: Map: The plans show the room layouts for training sessions for up to ten people and mor...
description: The plans show the room layouts for training sessions for up to ten people and more than ten people. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Room layouts for training sessions (Plan A vs Plan B)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ so sánh hai cách bố trí phòng cho các buổi đào tạo.

→ Dạng: diagram – comparison (two layouts)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: room layouts – training sessions – Plan A – Plan B

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • layouts → arrangements / configurations
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Hai phương án có cùng các thành phần chính (tables, chairs, podium, whiteboard, tea area)
  • Tuy nhiên, vị trí các khu vực được sắp xếp khác nhau đáng kể
  • Plan B có bố cục linh hoạt và tương tác hơn
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Plan A
  • Podium nằm ở góc trên bên trái
  • Whiteboard đặt ở phía trên, gần trung tâm
  • Ba cụm bàn:
  • Một ở bên trái
  • Một ở bên phải
  • Một ở phía dưới
  • Morning tea area đặt dọc phía dưới phòng
  • Bố cục khá phân tán, các nhóm tách biệt

→ Ý: phù hợp với làm việc nhóm riêng lẻ, ít tương tác chung

BODY 2 – Plan B
  • Podium được chuyển vào trung tâm phòng
  • Whiteboard vẫn ở phía trên nhưng gần podium hơn
  • Morning tea area chuyển lên góc trên bên trái
  • Các bàn:
  • Sắp xếp thành hình chữ U / vòng cung
  • Tạo không gian mở hướng về trung tâm
  • Người tham gia dễ tương tác với người trình bày hơn

→ Ý: bố cục hỗ trợ thảo luận và giao tiếp tốt hơn

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be arranged in → được sắp xếp theo
  • be positioned → được đặt ở
  • be relocated → được di chuyển
  • face towards → hướng về
  • facilitate interaction → thúc đẩy tương tác
  • collaborative layout → bố cục mang tính hợp tác

The diagrams compare two alternative layouts (Plan A and Plan B) for a training room.

Overall, both plans contain the same basic elements—tables, chairs, a podium, a whiteboard, and a refreshment area—but they are arranged differently. Plan B appears to offer a more centralised presentation space, while Plan A provides a clearer separation between the training and refreshment areas.

In Plan A, the whiteboard is positioned along the front wall, with the podium placed to the left of it. Three separate tables are arranged across the room: one in the centre, one to the right, and one at the bottom. Chairs are grouped around each table. The morning tea area is located along the back wall, away from the main presentation space.

In contrast, Plan B places the podium in a more central position beneath the whiteboard, which remains on the front wall. The tables are arranged more symmetrically, with two larger tables on either side and one at the bottom. Chairs are distributed around these tables in a more balanced manner. Additionally, the morning tea area has been moved to the front-left corner of the room, closer to the entrance.

title: Map: The plans below show a student common room five years ago and the common room now
description: The plans below show a student common room five years ago and the common room now. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Student common room (5 years ago vs Now)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi trong phòng sinh hoạt chung của sinh viên trong vòng 5 năm.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: student common room – 5 years ago – now

Dùng:

  • show → illustrate / compare
  • now → at present / currently
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Không gian được hiện đại hoá và đa chức năng hơn
  • Giảm số lượng bàn tròn, thay bằng nhiều khu vực khác nhau
  • Thêm tiện ích mới: TV, armchairs, drinking machine, laptop bench
  • Khu bếp được mở rộng nhẹ (thêm microwave)
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu trung tâm (seating area)
  • Trước đây:
  • Có 4 bàn tròn lớn, mỗi bàn nhiều ghế
  • Bố cục khá đơn giản và đồng nhất
  • Hiện tại:
  • Giảm xuống còn 2 bàn tròn \+ 1 bàn chữ nhật lớn
  • Bổ sung:
  • Armchairs \+ television (khu thư giãn)
  • Bench for laptops (khu học tập)

→ Ý: chuyển từ không gian ăn/uống → không gian đa mục đích

BODY 2 – Khu tiện ích (top & right side)
  • Trước đây:
  • Có: cupboard, sink, 2 benches, microwave, refrigerator
  • Hiện tại:
  • 1 bench bị loại bỏ
  • Microwave tăng từ 1 → 2
  • Thêm:
  • Drinking machine (bên phải)

→ Ý: nâng cấp tiện nghi phục vụ sinh viên

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be rearranged → được sắp xếp lại

  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be added → được bổ sung
  • multifunctional space → không gian đa chức năng
  • seating area → khu chỗ ngồi

The diagrams compare the layout of a student common room five years ago and at present.

Overall, the room has been modernised to provide a wider range of facilities, with fewer traditional seating areas and more space for relaxation and individual use.

Five years ago, the room contained four identical round tables surrounded by chairs, arranged evenly across the space. Along the top wall were basic kitchen facilities, including a cupboard, sink, two benches, a microwave, and a refrigerator.

At present, the layout is more varied. One of the round tables has been replaced by a larger rectangular table, while the total number of tables has been reduced. A new bench for laptops has been added along the bottom wall. On the right-hand side, a relaxation area has been introduced, featuring armchairs and a television, alongside a drinking machine. In addition, the kitchen area has been upgraded, with an extra microwave replacing one of the benches.

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Shopping centre (Before vs After – Level 1 & Level 2\)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi của một trung tâm mua sắm ở hai tầng trước và sau khi được cải tạo.

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: shopping centre – two levels – before and after

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • after → following renovation / after redevelopment
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Trung tâm được hiện đại hoá mạnh
  • Cầu thang được thay bằng thang cuốn
  • Xuất hiện các khu chức năng mới như supermarket và cinema
  • Bố cục tổng thể trở nên đơn giản và hợp lý hơn
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Level 1
Before:
  • Có department store ở góc trên trái
  • ATM ở gần trung tâm
  • Có stairs (cầu thang) ở giữa
  • Nhiều cửa hàng bố trí rải rác
  • Lift nằm ở góc dưới
After:
  • Stairs → replaced by escalator (thang cuốn)
  • Xuất hiện supermarket chiếm toàn bộ phía dưới
  • Lift được di chuyển vào trung tâm hơn
  • Department store vẫn giữ nhưng bố cục gọn hơn

→ Ý: tầng 1 chuyển sang phục vụ mua sắm chính (anchor store)

BODY 2 – Level 2
Before:
  • Chủ yếu là shops xung quanh
  • Có stairs ở giữa
  • Không có khu chức năng lớn
After:
  • Cinema được xây ở phía dưới
  • Thêm escalator thay cho cầu thang
  • Department store xuất hiện ở bên trái
  • Lift được đặt gần trung tâm

→ Ý: tầng 2 chuyển sang giải trí (entertainment-focused)

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be relocated → được di dời
  • be introduced → được bổ sung
  • occupy the entire area → chiếm toàn bộ diện tích
  • retail space → không gian bán lẻ
  • entertainment facility → tiện ích giải trí

The diagrams illustrate changes made to a two-level shopping centre, comparing its layout before and after redevelopment.

Overall, the centre has been modernised with the addition of large anchor facilities on both floors and improved vertical access. The original layout of scattered shops has been simplified, while new amenities such as a supermarket and a cinema have been introduced.

Before the renovation, Level 1 contained a department store in the upper-left corner and an ATM nearby, with several smaller shops arranged around the perimeter. Stairs were located centrally, and a lift was positioned in the bottom-right corner. On Level 2, shops occupied most of the outer areas, with stairs again placed near the centre.

After the redevelopment, Level 1 retains the department store and ATM in similar positions, but the internal layout has been reorganised. The stairs have been replaced by an escalator, and the lift has been relocated closer to the centre. A large supermarket now occupies the entire southern side of this floor, replacing several smaller retail units.

On Level 2, a similar pattern can be observed. The department store and ATM remain, while the lift is centrally positioned and an escalator has been added. Most notably, a cinema has been constructed along the southern edge, taking over space previously used for shops. Overall, the changes reflect a shift from multiple small outlets to fewer, larger facilities.

title: Line Graph: The graph below shows information about the percentage of the population in four A...
description: The graph below shows information about the percentage of the population in four Asian countries living in cities from 1970 to 2020, with predictions for 2030 and 2040. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Line graph: Percentage of the population living in cities (1970–2040)

1. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ dân số sống ở khu vực thành thị tại bốn quốc gia trong giai đoạn từ 1970 đến 2040\.

→ Dạng: line graph – multiple groups (so sánh \+ xu hướng theo thời gian, có cả dự đoán)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ các từ khóa:

percentage / proportion

population

living in cities / urban areas

time period

Có thể dùng:

shows → illustrates / compares

living in cities → residing in urban areas

Mẫu:

The line graph illustrates the proportion of the population living in urban areas in four countries between 1970 and 2040\.

3. Overview (ý chính)

Malaysia có tỷ lệ đô thị hóa cao nhất và tăng đều mạnh

Indonesia tăng nhanh nhất, đặc biệt sau năm 2000

Philippines dao động nhẹ trước khi tăng trở lại

Thailand luôn thấp nhất nhưng có xu hướng tăng

Từ khóa nên dùng:

showed the most significant growth

experienced rapid increases

fluctuated slightly

remained the lowest

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Nhóm nổi bật (Malaysia & Indonesia)

Malaysia:

tăng đều từ khoảng 30% lên hơn 80%

→ xu hướng tăng mạnh và ổn định

Indonesia:

tăng nhanh từ khoảng 13% lên 70%

đặc biệt tăng mạnh sau năm 2000

→ tốc độ tăng nhanh nhất

Ý chính: hai quốc gia này có xu hướng tăng rõ rệt, trong đó Indonesia tăng nhanh nhất còn Malaysia duy trì mức cao nhất

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại (Philippines & Thailand)

Philippines:

tăng từ khoảng 32% lên gần 50% vào 1990, sau đó giảm nhẹ rồi tăng lại lên \~60%

→ xu hướng dao động nhẹ

Thailand:

tăng chậm từ khoảng 17% lên gần 50%

luôn là quốc gia có tỷ lệ thấp nhất

→ tăng ổn định nhưng chậm

Ý chính: Philippines có biến động nhẹ, trong khi Thailand tăng đều nhưng luôn ở mức thấp hơn các nước khác

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

increase steadily

rise sharply

experience a fluctuation

decline slightly

remain the highest

record the lowest figure

show an upward trend

grow gradually

Ví dụ:

The proportion of people living in cities in Malaysia increased steadily throughout the period.

Indonesia experienced a sharp rise, particularly after 2000\.

The Philippines showed slight fluctuations before rising again.

Thailand consistently recorded the lowest figures despite gradual growth.

—--------------------------

The line graph compares the proportion of people living in cities in four countries—Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia—between 1970 and 2040\.

In 1970, urban populations were relatively low in all countries, with the Philippines and Malaysia at around 30%, compared to approximately 17% in Thailand and 13% in Indonesia. Over the following decades, Malaysia showed a steady and consistent increase, rising to about 60% in 2000 and continuing upward to just over 80% by 2040, making it the most urbanised country throughout the later years.

The Philippines followed a more fluctuating pattern. Its figure increased from just above 30% in 1970 to a peak of around 48% in 1990, before declining slightly to the mid-40s in 2010\. It then recovered gradually, reaching approximately 60% by 2040\.

Indonesia experienced the most notable late growth. Starting from the lowest point, it rose slowly to 30% in 2000, after which it increased sharply, reaching around 70% by 2040\. In contrast, Thailand had the slowest overall growth, climbing gradually from about 17% in 1970 to around 30% in 2000, and then rising more moderately to just under 50% by the end of the period.

title: Line Graph: The graph below shows different sources of air pollutants in the UK from 1990 to 2...
description: The graph below shows different sources of air pollutants in the UK from 1990 to 2005. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and making comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Line graph: Air pollutants by source (1990–2005)

1. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ cho thấy lượng khí thải (triệu tấn) từ ba nguồn khác nhau (transport, industry, household) và tổng lượng khí thải trong giai đoạn 1990–2005.

→ Dạng: line graph – multiple groups (so sánh \+ xu hướng theo thời gian)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ các từ khóa:

air pollutants

sources

million tonnes

time period

Có thể dùng:

shows → illustrates / compares

by source → from different sources

Mẫu:

The line graph illustrates the amount of air pollutants emitted from different sources between 1990 and 2005, measured in million tonnes.

3. Overview (ý chính)

Tổng lượng khí thải giảm đều theo thời gian

Industry giảm mạnh nhất và là nguồn chính

Transport tăng nhẹ

Household giảm nhìn chung nhưng có dao động nhỏ

Từ khóa nên dùng:

showed a downward trend

declined significantly

remained the main source

fluctuated slightly

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Nhóm chính (Total & Industry)

Total:

giảm đều từ khoảng 7 xuống hơn 3 triệu tấn

→ xu hướng giảm rõ rệt

Industry:

giảm mạnh từ khoảng 5.7 xuống dưới 2

đặc biệt giảm nhanh giai đoạn 1993–1996

→ nguồn gây ô nhiễm lớn nhất nhưng giảm đáng kể

Ý chính: tổng lượng khí thải giảm chủ yếu do sự sụt giảm mạnh từ ngành công nghiệp

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại (Transport & Household)

Transport:

tăng nhẹ từ khoảng 1 lên khoảng 1.4–1.5

có dao động nhỏ nhưng xu hướng chung là tăng

→ nguồn duy nhất tăng

Household:

giảm từ khoảng 1 xuống gần 0.2

có tăng nhẹ vào năm 1999 trước khi tiếp tục giảm

→ xu hướng giảm nhưng không ổn định

Ý chính: transport tăng nhẹ trong khi household giảm dần với một vài biến động nhỏ

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

decline steadily

drop sharply

increase slightly

experience fluctuations

remain the largest contributor

show a downward trend

rise gradually

Ví dụ:

The total amount of air pollutants declined steadily over the period.

Industrial emissions dropped sharply, especially in the mid-1990s.

Transport emissions increased slightly despite minor fluctuations.

Household emissions showed an overall decrease with some variation.

The line graph illustrates the amount of air pollutants produced by different sources—transport, industry, and households—between 1990 and 2005, measured in million tonnes, along with the overall total.

Overall, total air pollution declined steadily over the period, largely driven by a significant reduction in industrial emissions. By contrast, transport emissions showed a slight upward trend, while household pollution decreased overall despite minor fluctuations.

In 1990, industry was the dominant source of pollution at approximately 5.7 million tonnes, followed by transport and household emissions at around 1 million tonnes each. Industrial emissions then fell sharply to about 3 million tonnes in 1996 and continued to decline gradually to just under 2 million tonnes by 2005\. This substantial reduction was the main contributor to the overall drop in total pollution, which decreased from 7 million tonnes to just over 3 million tonnes during the period.

Transport emissions, on the other hand, increased moderately. Starting at 1 million tonnes in 1990, they rose to around 1.4 million tonnes in 1996, fluctuated slightly thereafter, and ended at approximately 1.4 million tonnes in 2005\. Meanwhile, household emissions followed a generally downward trend, falling from 1 million tonnes to about 0.2 million tonnes, despite a brief increase to around 0.7 million tonnes in 1999\.

KEY FEATURES:
* Total Air Pollutants showed a consistent decline from 7 million tonnes in 1990 to 3.1 million tonnes in 2005.
* Industry was the largest source of air pollutants in 1990 (5.7 million tonnes) and experienced the most significant drop, ending at 1.9 million tonnes in 2005.
* Transport emissions remained relatively stable, fluctuating between 1 and 1.5 million tonnes throughout the period.

* Industry's contribution to total pollutants decreased sharply between 1993 and 1996.
* By 2005, Transport became the largest individual source of air pollutants, surpassing Industry.

title: Line Graph: The graph below shows the average number of people attending top-level football ma...

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Line graph: Average attendance per top-level football match (1980–2004)

1. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ cho thấy số lượng khán giả trung bình (nghìn người) mỗi trận bóng đá cấp cao nhất tại ba quốc gia: Italy, England và Germany từ năm 1980 đến 2004\.

→ Dạng: line graph – multiple groups (so sánh \+ xu hướng theo thời gian)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ các từ khóa:

average attendance

football matches

three countries

time period

Có thể dùng:

shows → illustrates / compares

top-level → major / professional

Mẫu:

The line graph illustrates the average number of spectators attending top-level football matches in three countries between 1980 and 2004\.

3. Overview (ý chính)

Italy giảm dần theo thời gian

England và Germany giảm ban đầu rồi tăng mạnh

Đến cuối kỳ, England có mức cao nhất

→ xu hướng trái ngược giữa Italy và hai nước còn lại

Từ khóa nên dùng:

declined overall

recovered and increased

showed an upward trend

reached the highest figure

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Italy

Italy:

tăng nhẹ từ 35 lên 37 (1980–1986)

sau đó giảm đều xuống khoảng 25 vào 2004

→ xu hướng giảm tổng thể

Ý chính: Italy bắt đầu cao nhất nhưng giảm liên tục về cuối kỳ

BODY 2 – England & Germany

England:

giảm từ 25 xuống 22 (1980–1986)

sau đó tăng dần lên khoảng 34 (cao nhất vào cuối kỳ)

→ phục hồi và tăng mạnh

Germany:

giảm mạnh từ \~25 xuống \~18 (1986)

sau đó tăng đều lên khoảng 32–33

→ phục hồi rõ rệt

So sánh:

cả hai nước đều vượt Italy vào cuối giai đoạn

Ý chính: England và Germany có xu hướng phục hồi sau giai đoạn giảm, và vượt Italy về lượng khán giả

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

decline gradually

drop sharply

recover

increase steadily

surpass / overtake

reach a peak

Ví dụ:

Attendance in Italy declined gradually after an initial rise.

England experienced a slight drop before recovering steadily.

Germany saw a sharp decline followed by consistent growth.

By the end of the period, both England and Germany had overtaken Italy.

The line graph compares the average attendance per top-level football match in Italy, England, and Germany between 1980 and 2004, measured in thousands of spectators.

Overall, Italy started with the highest attendance but experienced a steady decline over time, while England and Germany showed overall upward trends and eventually surpassed Italy by the end of the period.

In 1980, Italy recorded the highest figure at around 35,000 spectators per match, compared to approximately 25,000 in England and 24,000 in Germany. Italy’s attendance then rose slightly to about 37,000 in 1986 before falling steadily to 30,000 in 1992 and continuing to decline to 25,000 by 2004\.

England followed a different pattern. After a drop from 25,000 in 1980 to roughly 22,000 in 1986, attendance gradually increased to around 24,000 in 1992 and 26,000 in 1998, before reaching a peak of approximately 34,000 in 2004\.

Germany saw a sharper fluctuation initially, declining from about 24,000 in 1980 to around 18,000 in 1986\. However, this was followed by a consistent rise, with figures reaching 22,000 in 1992, 26,000 in 1998, and approximately 32,000 by the final year.

* Germany's attendance decreased initially then steadily increased.
* England and Germany's attendance converged and surpassed Italy's by 2004.

title: Line Graph: The graph shows the amount of fruit produced in four countries (France, Spain, Ger...
description: The graph shows the amount of fruit produced in four countries (France, Spain, Germany, Turkey) from 1970 to 2010. Summarize the information by reporting the main features, and making comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Fruit Production in Four Countries (1970–2010)
1\. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường thể hiện sản lượng trái cây (triệu tấn) ở 4 quốc gia:

  • Spain
  • Turkey
  • France
  • Germany

trong giai đoạn 1970–2010

→ Dạng: line graph (time \+ comparison)

2\. Introduction

The line graph illustrates the amount of fruit produced, measured in millions of tonnes, in four countries between 1970 and 2010\.

3\. Overview
  • Spain luôn là nước sản xuất nhiều nhất
  • Turkey và France có xu hướng tăng
  • Germany giảm dần theo thời gian
  • France biến động nhưng tăng mạnh về cuối kỳ

→ Xu hướng chính:

  • dominant country (Spain)
  • upward trend (Turkey, France)
  • downward trend (Germany)
4\. Cách chia BODY

→ Chia theo xu hướng:

  • Body 1: Spain \+ Turkey (mức cao, xu hướng rõ)
  • Body 2: France \+ Germany (mức thấp hơn, biến động trái chiều)
BODY 1

Spain:

  • tăng từ \~5.5 lên 6 (1980)
  • sau đó giảm dần xuống \~5.1

→ slight rise then gradual decline

Turkey:

  • tăng đều từ 2 → 3.5

→ steady growth

BODY 2

France:

  • tăng nhẹ (1970–1980)
  • tăng mạnh đến \~2.2 (1990)
  • giảm nhẹ (2000)
  • tăng mạnh lên \~2.9 (2010)

→ fluctuation with overall increase

Germany:

  • giảm liên tục từ \~2.5 xuống \~1.3
  • gần như ổn định sau 1990

→ steady decline then stabilization

5\. Từ vựng ăn điểm
  • remain the highest
  • increase steadily
  • decline gradually
  • fluctuate
  • reach a peak of
  • fall to
  • overall upward trend

The line chart compares fruit production in Spain, Turkey, France and Germany between 1970 and 2010, measured in millions of tonnes.

Overall, Spain remained the largest producer throughout the period despite a gradual decline after 1980\. Turkey showed steady growth and became the second-largest producer by the end. France experienced fluctuations but generally increased, while Germany saw a consistent downward trend.

Spain’s output rose from about 5.5 million tonnes in 1970 to a peak of 6 million in 1980, before falling gradually to just over 5 million by 2010\. In contrast, Turkey’s production increased steadily from 2 million tonnes to approximately 3.5 million over the same period.

France started at around 1.2 million tonnes in 1970 and climbed modestly to about 1.3 million in 1980\. It then rose more sharply to just above 2 million in 1990, dipped slightly in 2000, and finished at nearly 2.9 million tonnes in 2010\. Germany, however, declined from roughly 2.5 million tonnes in 1970 to around 1.3 million by the end of the period, with only minor fluctuations after 1990\.

* By 2010, Turkey had the second-highest production, followed by France, with Germany having the lowest.

The graph below gives information about telephone subscribers per 100 inhabitants in Africa from 1994-2004. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

The line graph illustrates the number of telephone subscribers per 100 inhabitants in Africa between 1994 and 2004, divided into fixed-line and mobile users.

Overall, both types of telephone subscriptions increased over the period, but mobile usage grew far more rapidly and eventually surpassed fixed-line subscriptions. Fixed-line growth, in contrast, was relatively slow and modest.

In 1994, fixed-line subscriptions stood at about 1.7 per 100 people, while mobile usage was negligible at just 0.06. Over the following years, fixed-line figures rose gradually, reaching around 2.5 by 1999 and remaining relatively stable until 2000\. After that, they increased slightly to approximately 3.1 by 2004\.

Mobile subscriptions followed a very different pattern. Although they remained low in the mid-1990s, increasing only to about 1 per 100 inhabitants by 1999, growth accelerated significantly after 2000\. The figure doubled to around 2 in 2000 and reached 3 in 2001, at which point it equalled fixed-line usage. It then rose sharply to approximately 6 in 2003 and peaked at about 8.8 in 2004\.

By the end of the period, mobile phones had become the dominant form of telecommunication in Africa, far exceeding the number of fixed-line subscribers.

  • Giảm không gian chung (living room bị thay thế)
  • Thêm tiện ích mới (en-suite, car park)
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu bên trong (core changes)
  • Living room → bị thay bằng bedroom
  • Số bedroom tăng (từ \~3 → \~5)
  • Bathroom & kitchen: giữ nguyên vị trí
  • Thêm en-suite room

→ Ý: tối ưu hoá chỗ ở → nhiều phòng hơn, ít không gian chung

BODY 2 – Khu bên ngoài & bố cục
  • Garden: giảm diện tích / bố trí lại
  • Thêm car parking (khu mới hoàn toàn)
  • Layout nhìn chung chặt chẽ hơn

→ Ý: ngoại cảnh bị thu hẹp để phục vụ tiện ích mới

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • be reduced → bị thu hẹp
  • additional facilities → tiện ích bổ sung

Ví dụ:

  • The living room was converted into an additional bedroom.
  • The number of bedrooms increased significantly.
  • Outdoor space was reduced to make room for a car park.

The diagrams illustrate how a student accommodation building has changed between 2010 and the present.

Overall, the layout has been modified to accommodate more students. Communal space has been reduced, while the number of bedrooms has increased. In addition, some facilities have been upgraded, and a car parking area has been introduced.

In 2010, the accommodation included a living room in the upper-left area, alongside two student bedrooms on the top and right sides. There was another bedroom in the lower-left corner, making a total of three bedrooms. A bathroom was located centrally, and a kitchen was positioned on the right side. The building was surrounded by a garden on three sides.

At present, the living room has been removed and replaced with additional student bedrooms, increasing the total number to five. The kitchen remains in the same location, and the bathroom is still centrally positioned. However, an en-suite room has been added in the bottom-right corner, replacing part of the former bedroom space.

Externally, the garden area has been reduced, particularly at the bottom, where it has been replaced by a car parking space.

title: Line Graph: The graph below shows the number of tourists (measured in millions) visiting a par...
description: The graph below shows the number of tourists (measured in millions) visiting a particular Caribbean island between 2010 and 2017. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Line graph: Number of tourists visiting a Caribbean island (2010–2017)

1. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ cho thấy số lượng khách du lịch (triệu người) đến một hòn đảo Caribbean từ năm 2010 đến 2017, gồm ba nhóm: khách ở trên tàu du lịch (cruise ships), khách ở trên đảo (island), và tổng số khách.

→ Dạng: line graph – multiple groups (so sánh \+ xu hướng theo thời gian)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ các từ khóa:

number of tourists

Caribbean island

visitors

time period

Có thể dùng:

shows → illustrates / compares

visiting → travelling to

Mẫu:

The line graph illustrates the number of tourists visiting a Caribbean island between 2010 and 2017, including those staying on cruise ships and on the island.

3. Overview (ý chính)

Tổng số khách du lịch tăng mạnh theo thời gian

Khách ở trên tàu tăng nhanh nhất

Khách ở trên đảo tăng rồi chững lại

Từ khoảng 2016, khách tàu vượt khách ở đảo

Từ khóa nên dùng:

showed a significant increase

rose sharply

remained relatively stable

overtook

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Tổng & Cruise ships

Total:

tăng đều từ khoảng 1 triệu lên 3.5 triệu

→ xu hướng tăng mạnh và liên tục

Cruise ships:

tăng từ khoảng 0.3 lên 2 triệu

có giảm nhẹ năm 2012 nhưng sau đó tăng nhanh

→ tăng mạnh nhất

Ý chính: tổng số khách tăng chủ yếu nhờ sự gia tăng mạnh của khách đi tàu

BODY 2 – Visitors staying on island

Island:

tăng từ khoảng 0.7 lên 1.5 vào 2013

sau đó giữ ổn định đến 2015

giảm nhẹ năm 2016 rồi tăng lại

→ xu hướng tăng nhưng có giai đoạn chững

So sánh:

ban đầu cao hơn cruise ships

nhưng bị vượt vào khoảng 2016

Ý chính: khách ở đảo tăng sớm nhưng không duy trì được tốc độ, và bị nhóm cruise vượt qua

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

increase steadily

rise sharply

experience a slight dip

remain stable

level off

overtake

reach a peak

Ví dụ:

The total number of tourists increased steadily over the period.

Visitors staying on cruise ships rose sharply despite a brief dip in 2012\.

The number of tourists staying on the island remained stable for several years before rising again.

Cruise ship visitors overtook island visitors towards the end of the period.

The line graph shows the number of tourists visiting a Caribbean island between 2010 and 2017, divided into visitors staying on cruise ships and those staying on the island, measured in millions.

Overall, the total number of tourists increased steadily over the period, with particularly strong growth after 2012\. While visitors staying on the island were higher at the beginning, those staying on cruise ships grew more rapidly and eventually overtook them.

In 2010, around 0.7 million tourists stayed on the island, compared to only 0.3 million cruise ship visitors, resulting in a total of 1 million. The number of island-based tourists remained relatively stable at about 0.7 million in 2011 before rising to 1.5 million in 2013\. It then plateaued until 2015, dipped slightly to around 1.3 million in 2016, and recovered to 1.5 million in the final year.

By contrast, cruise ship visitors showed a more fluctuating but overall upward trend. Starting at 0.3 million in 2010, the figure rose to 0.5 million in 2011, fell back to 0.3 million in 2012, and then increased consistently to reach 2 million by 2017\. Notably, cruise ship visitors surpassed those staying on the island in 2016\.

As a result of these trends, the total number of tourists rose from 1 million in 2010 to 3.5 million in 2017, with the most significant growth occurring in the latter half of the period.

DATA:
Visitors staying on cruise ships: 2010: 0.2, 2011: 0.5, 2012: 0.2, 2013: 0.5, 2014: 1.0, 2015: 1.2, 2016: 1.5, 2017: 2.0
Visitors staying on island: 2010: 0.7, 2011: 0.7, 2012: 1.2, 2013: 1.5, 2014: 1.5, 2015: 1.5, 2016: 1.2, 2017: 1.5

KEY FEATURES:
* The total number of tourists increased steadily from 1 million in 2010 to 3.5 million in 2017.
* Visitors staying on cruise ships showed a general upward trend, starting at 0.2 million and reaching 2.0 million by 2017, with a dip in 2012.
* Visitors staying on the island fluctuated, starting at 0.7 million, peaking at 1.5 million in 2013, 2014, 2015, and 2017, and dipping to 1.2 million in 2016.
* In 2016, the number of visitors staying on cruise ships surpassed those staying on the island for the first time.
* The largest increase in total tourists occurred between 2016 and 2017.

title: Line Graph: The graph shows the percentage of people in different age groups in one city who a...
description: The graph shows the percentage of people in different age groups in one city who attended music concerts between 2010 and 2015. Summarize the information by reporting the main features, and making comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

The percentage of people visiting the cinema once a month or more between 1984 and 2003

1. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường thể hiện tỷ lệ người đi xem phim ít nhất một lần mỗi tháng trong giai đoạn 1984–2003, chia theo 4 nhóm tuổi.

→ Dạng: line graph (time series \+ multiple groups)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

The line graph illustrates the percentage of people from four different age groups who visited the cinema at least once a month between 1984 and 2003.

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Tất cả các nhóm tuổi đều có xu hướng tăng theo thời gian
  • Nhóm 15–24 luôn cao nhất, trong khi 35+ thấp nhất
  • Khoảng cách giữa các nhóm khá rõ rệt và duy trì ổn định

### 4. Cách chia BODY

Nên chia theo nhóm tuổi (grouping), không đi theo năm

BODY 1 – Nhóm trẻ (15–24 & 7–14)

  • Nhóm 15–24:

→ tăng mạnh từ khoảng 15% (1984) lên hơn 50% (2003)

→ có dao động nhưng xu hướng chung là tăng rõ rệt

  • Nhóm 7–14:

→ tăng từ khoảng 10% lên khoảng 30%

→ cũng có biến động nhẹ nhưng nhìn chung đi lên

→ Key idea:

  • Hai nhóm trẻ có mức độ tham gia cao nhất và tăng mạnh nhất

### BODY 2 – Nhóm lớn tuổi hơn (25–35 & 35+)

  • Nhóm 25–35:

→ tăng dần từ khoảng 5% lên gần 30%

  • Nhóm 35+:

→ thấp nhất, tăng nhẹ từ \~1% lên khoảng 13%

→ Key idea:

  • Nhóm lớn tuổi ít đi xem phim hơn, nhưng vẫn có xu hướng tăng

### 5. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm

Trend verbs:

  • increase / rise / climb
  • fluctuate
  • remain the highest / lowest

Useful structures:

  • showed an upward trend
  • experienced a significant increase
  • remained consistently higher than
  • saw a gradual rise

So sánh:

  • considerably higher than
  • by contrast
  • in comparison

Ví dụ câu:

  • The figure for the 15–24 group rose significantly over the period.
  • In contrast, the 35+ group remained the lowest despite a gradual increase.
  • Younger people were consistently more frequent cinema-goers than older groups.

The line graph illustrates the proportion of people in four age groups who went to the cinema at least once a month between 1984 and 2003.

Overall, cinema attendance increased across all age groups over the period, with the 15–24 group consistently recording the highest figures, while those aged 35 and over remained the least frequent visitors.

In 1984, around 15% of people aged 15–24 visited the cinema monthly, compared to approximately 10% for the 7–14 group and about 5% for those aged 25–35. The figure for the oldest group was negligible, at roughly 1%. Over time, all groups experienced an upward trend, although there were some fluctuations.

The most notable growth occurred among 15–24-year-olds, whose participation rose sharply to around 50% in the late 1990s and peaked at approximately 56% in 2002, before slightly declining by the end of the period. A similar but less dramatic increase was observed among the 7–14 group, climbing to nearly 38% in 2002 before falling to about 30% in 2003.

Meanwhile, the 25–35 group showed steady growth overall, reaching just over 30% in the early 2000s, despite a temporary dip around 2000. In contrast, the 35-and-over group experienced the slowest rise, increasing gradually from about 1% to roughly 13% by 2003.
