KEY FEATURES:
* The 25-44 age group consistently had the highest percentage of concert attendees from 2011 to 2015, showing a strong upward trend.
* The 75+ age group generally had the lowest percentage of attendees throughout the period, though it saw a significant increase in 2011 and 2015.
* The 16-24 age group showed fluctuations but ended at the same percentage in 2015 as in 2010 (52%).
* The 55-64 age group experienced a general decline in attendance after 2013.
* The 45-54 age group initially decreased but then recovered to its 2010 level by 2014 and continued to rise.
* There was a crossover between the 16-24 and 25-44 age groups in 2010-2011, with 25-44 surpassing 16-24.

title: Line Graph: The number of train passengers from 2000 to 2009
description: The first graph shows the number of train passengers from 2000 to 2009. The second graph shows the percentage of trains running on time. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Mixed charts: Train passengers & On-time performance (2000–2009)

1. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ gồm hai phần:

  • Biểu đồ 1: số lượng hành khách đi tàu (triệu người) từ 2000 đến 2009
  • Biểu đồ 2: tỷ lệ tàu chạy đúng giờ so với mục tiêu (95%) trong cùng giai đoạn

→ Dạng: mixed line graphs (mô tả 2 biểu đồ → cần overview chung \+ nhóm thông tin hợp lý)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ các từ khóa:

number of passengers

in millions

percentage of trains running on time

target

time period

Có thể dùng:

shows → illustrates / presents

compared with → in comparison with

Mẫu:

The charts illustrate the number of train passengers (in millions) and the percentage of trains running on time compared with the target between 2000 and 2009\.

3. Overview (ý chính)

Số hành khách dao động nhẹ nhưng nhìn chung ổn định

Tỷ lệ đúng giờ biến động quanh mức mục tiêu 95%

Có giai đoạn giảm rõ (2005–2006) rồi tăng mạnh cuối kỳ

→ không có xu hướng tăng/giảm rõ ràng ở passengers, nhưng on-time có biến động đáng chú ý

Từ khóa nên dùng:

fluctuated

remained relatively stable

hovered around

dropped noticeably

recovered

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Train passengers

Passengers:

dao động trong khoảng 35–46 triệu

tăng từ 2000 đến đỉnh \~46 vào 2005

sau đó giảm nhẹ rồi ổn định quanh \~40–42

→ xu hướng: biến động nhẹ, không thay đổi lớn

Ý chính: lượng hành khách đạt đỉnh giữa kỳ rồi duy trì ổn định

BODY 2 – On-time performance

Target:

luôn cố định ở 95%

Actual performance:

tăng từ 92% lên 96% (2000–2004)

giảm xuống khoảng 92% vào 2006

sau đó tăng mạnh lên \~97% vào cuối kỳ

→ dao động quanh target, có lúc dưới và trên mức này

Ý chính: tỷ lệ đúng giờ không ổn định nhưng cải thiện rõ rệt vào cuối giai đoạn

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

fluctuate slightly

remain stable

reach a peak

drop noticeably

recover strongly

hover around

meet / exceed the target

Ví dụ:

The number of passengers fluctuated within a narrow range.

Passenger figures reached a peak in 2005 before stabilising.

The percentage of trains running on time dropped noticeably in 2006\.

It then recovered and exceeded the target in the final years.

The charts show the number of train passengers between 2000 and 2009, along with the percentage of trains running on time compared with a fixed target.

Overall, passenger numbers fluctuated moderately but showed a slight upward trend, while punctuality varied around the target, falling below it in some years before exceeding it towards the end of the period.

In 2000, around 36 million passengers used the train service. This figure rose to approximately 42 million in 2002, before dropping back to about 36 million in 2003\. Passenger numbers then increased again, peaking at roughly 46 million in 2005\. After this high point, the figure declined slightly and stabilised at around 40–42 million between 2006 and 2009\.

Regarding punctuality, the target remained constant at 95% throughout the period. The actual percentage started below target at around 92% in 2000 and improved steadily to reach the target in 2002\. It then exceeded the target slightly, peaking at about 96% in 2004, before declining again to a low of approximately 92% in 2006\. In the final years, punctuality improved significantly, reaching around 97% in both 2008 and 2009, thus clearly surpassing the target.

title: Line Graph: The charts show the changes in ownership of electrical appliances and amount of ti...
description: The charts show the changes in ownership of electrical appliances and amount of time spent doing housework in households in one country between 1920 and 2019. Summarise the information by se
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI (2 BIỂU ĐỒ KẾT HỢP)

1. Phân tích đề

Biểu đồ gồm 2 line graphs:

1. % hộ gia đình sở hữu thiết bị điện (washing machine, refrigerator, vacuum cleaner)

2. Số giờ làm việc nhà mỗi tuần

→ Dạng: mixed trends \+ relationship (cause–effect)

2. Introduction

The two line graphs illustrate the percentage of households owning three electrical appliances and the average number of hours of housework per week between 1920 and 2019.

3. Overview (QUAN TRỌNG)

  • Ownership of appliances increased significantly overall
  • Housework hours decreased dramatically
  • → Clear inverse relationship (thiết bị ↑ → việc nhà ↓)

4. Body 1 – Appliances

Refrigerator:

  • tăng mạnh nhất: 0% → 100% (2000)
  • gần như phổ cập hoàn toàn

Vacuum cleaner:

  • tăng đều: 30% → 100% (2000–2019)

Washing machine:

  • tăng nhưng có fluctuation
  • từ 40% → \~70%, giảm nhẹ năm 1980 rồi tăng lại

→ key: not all lines are perfectly linear

5. Body 2 – Housework hours

  • giảm liên tục: 50h → 10h/tuần
  • giảm mạnh nhất giai đoạn 1920–1960
  • sau đó giảm chậm hơn

→ strong downward trend

The charts illustrate the proportion of households owning three electrical appliances (washing machines, refrigerators and vacuum cleaners) from 1920 to 2019, alongside the average weekly hours of housework over the same period.

Overall, ownership of all appliances increased substantially, with refrigerators and vacuum cleaners becoming almost universal by the end of the period. In contrast, the amount of time spent on housework declined dramatically.

Refrigerator ownership rose most sharply, from virtually 0% in 1920 to around 90% in 1960, reaching full penetration by 2000 and remaining at that level in 2019. Vacuum cleaner ownership also grew steadily, from about 30% in 1920 to 70% in 1960, before reaching 100% by 2000. Washing machines followed a more moderate trend, increasing from 40% in 1920 to roughly 70% in 1960, dipping slightly to just over 60% in 1980, and then rising again to approximately 75% in 2019.

Meanwhile, the number of hours of housework per household fell consistently. It dropped from around 50 hours per week in 1920 to 35 hours in 1940, and then to 20 hours in 1960. After a smaller decline to about 15 hours in 1980, the figure remained stable in 2000 before decreasing further to just 10 hours per week by 2019.

HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Visitors by Purpose: Business, Holiday and Meeting Friends (1989–2009)
1\. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường thể hiện số lượng khách (triệu người) theo 3 mục đích:

  • Business
  • Holiday

The line chart illustrates the number of visitors (in millions) who travelled for three purposes—business, holidays, and visiting friends and relatives—between 1989 and 2009\.

Business travel showed a general upward trend despite a slight decline at the end, while visits to friends and relatives increased steadily before experiencing a minor drop in the final year.

Holiday travel rose from about 6.5 million in 1989 to a peak of 9 million in 1994, before falling to around 7 million in 1999 and further to approximately 6.5 million in 2004\. It then recovered significantly, reaching 9 million again by 2009\.

title: Map: The museum's plant in 1998 and after some changes were made in 2008
description: The picture below shows the museum’s plant in 1998 and after some changes were made in 2008. Summarize the information by describing the main features of the charts and making comparisons where appropriate.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Museum floor plan (1998 vs 2008\)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy bố trí bảo tàng vào 1998 và 2008.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)
  • Giữ: layout / floor plan – museum – two years
  • Dùng:
shows → illustrates / compares* changes → modifications / redevelopment*
3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Layout thay đổi đáng kể (major redevelopment)
  • Thêm nhiều tiện ích cho khách (restaurant, fountains, shops)
  • Không gian được tổ chức lại rõ ràng hơn
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu trung tâm & chức năng chính
  • Garden → fountains (thay đổi lớn)
  • Cafe giữ nhưng đổi vị trí
  • Entrance vẫn ở trung tâm dưới (giữ nguyên)

→ Ý: khu trung tâm được nâng cấp & hiện đại hóa

BODY 2 – Các khu xung quanh
  • Thêm restaurant (trái trên)
  • Shop → shops (mở rộng)
  • WC đổi vị trí (lên trên)
  • Cloakroom giữ nhưng di chuyển
  • Temporary exhibition: vẫn giữ

→ Ý: tăng tiện ích \+ thay đổi vị trí các phòng

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be replaced by → được thay thế bởi
  • be relocated → được di chuyển
  • be added → được thêm vào
  • remain unchanged → giữ nguyên
  • undergo significant changes → trải qua thay đổi lớn

Ví dụ:

  • The garden was replaced by a fountain area.
  • Several new facilities were added, including a restaurant and shops.
  • The entrance remained unchanged.

The diagrams compare the layout of a museum in 1998 and 2008\.

Overall, the museum underwent a substantial reorganisation over the ten-year period. The central garden was replaced with fountains, new facilities such as a restaurant and additional shops were introduced, and several existing areas were relocated or expanded.

In 1998, the museum had a relatively simple layout. A garden occupied the centre, with a café positioned directly above it. On the lower level, the ticket entrance was located in the middle, flanked by a temporary exhibition room on the left and a shop on the right. A cloakroom and WC were situated in the bottom-right corner. Two permanent exhibition rooms were located on either side of the central area.

By 2008, the layout had become more complex and visitor-oriented. The garden was replaced by fountains, creating a redesigned central feature. The café remained but was reduced in size and moved slightly, while a new restaurant was added to the upper-left corner. The WC was relocated next to the café at the top.

On the ground level, the entrance area became larger, and the cloakroom was moved to the bottom centre. The single shop was replaced by multiple shops in the bottom-left corner. The temporary exhibition room remained on the left but was slightly repositioned. Meanwhile, the permanent exhibition area on the right was expanded significantly, occupying a larger portion of the floor plan.

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

reach a peak

experience growth

Ví dụ:

The number of students from Indonesia rose dramatically over the period.

Singapore experienced steady growth from a very low base.

Hong Kong showed some fluctuations towards the end of the period.

Malaysia remained relatively stable with gradual increases.

The line graph shows the number of students (in thousands) arriving for education from four countries—Indonesia, Hong Kong, Malaysia, and Singapore—between 1982 and 2000\.

Overall, student numbers from all countries increased over the period, with Indonesia experiencing the most dramatic growth, particularly after the mid-1990s. Malaysia showed a relatively steady rise, while Hong Kong and Singapore displayed more fluctuation before ending with upward trends.

In the early years, Malaysia had the highest number of students, starting at around 6,000 in 1982 and rising gradually to about 8,000 by 1990\. In contrast, Indonesia and Singapore recorded negligible figures initially, while Hong Kong remained very low until the late 1980s. From 1988 onwards, Hong Kong saw a sharp increase, reaching approximately 10,000 students by 1992, before stabilising briefly.

Indonesia followed a steady upward trend from near zero in 1982 to around 10,000 in 1994\. After that, it experienced a rapid surge, peaking at about 26,000 in 1998 before declining slightly to around 23,000 in 2000, remaining the largest source of students.

Singapore also grew gradually, particularly after 1990, rising from minimal numbers to approximately 20,000 by 2000\. Meanwhile, Malaysia increased steadily overall despite minor fluctuations, ending at around 16,000 students in the final year.

Overall, the services sector increased steadily and became the dominant source of employment, while manufacturing and agriculture declined significantly. Construction remained relatively stable, and mining accounted for the smallest share throughout the period.

In 1962, services already represented the largest proportion at just over 50%, followed by manufacturing at around 27%. description: The map below shows the development of the village of Ryemouth between 1995 and present. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Village of Ryemouth (1995 vs Present)
1\. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự phát triển của ngôi làng Ryemouth từ năm 1995 đến hiện tại.

3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Khu vực chuyển từ nông nghiệp và đánh bắt → du lịch và dịch vụ
  • Ven biển được tái phát triển mạnh (apartments, restaurant)
  • Xuất hiện khu giải trí mới (golf, tennis)
4\. Chia BODY
BODY 1 – Khu phía Đông (big transformation)
  • Farmland → golf course
  • Forest park → tennis courts

→ Ý: chuyển đổi sang recreational purposes (giải trí)

BODY 2 – Khu ven biển & trung tâm
  • Fish market \+ fishing port → bị xoá bỏ hoàn toàn
  • Shop → restaurant
  • Xuất hiện apartments dọc bờ biển
  • Hotel vẫn giữ, thêm car park
  • Cafe: không thay đổi vị trí

→ Ý: chuyển từ đánh bắt → du lịch và thương mại

5\. Gợi ý từ vựng
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be removed → bị loại bỏ
  • be redeveloped → được tái phát triển
  • be introduced → được bổ sung

The maps illustrate how the village of Ryemouth has changed from 1995 to the present.

Overall, the village has undergone significant redevelopment, with a shift from a fishing-based economy towards residential and tourism functions. Several original features have been removed or repurposed, while new facilities have been introduced.

In 1995, Ryemouth featured traditional coastal activities and open land. A fish market and fishing port were located along the shoreline, with a row of shops nearby. To the northeast, there was farmland and a forest park, while housing was concentrated in the northwest. A hotel stood close to the forest park, and a café was positioned near the coast.

At present, many of these features have been replaced. The fishing port and fish market have disappeared, making way for apartment buildings along the coast. The former shops have been converted into restaurants. The farmland and forest park have been redeveloped into recreational areas, including a golf course and tennis courts.

A car park has also been added next to the hotel, which remains in the same location. The café is still present but appears slightly repositioned.

title: Line Graph: The graph below shows the number of inquiries received by the Tourist Information ...

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Line graph: Percentage of the population living in cities (1970–2040)

1. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ dân số sống ở khu vực thành thị tại bốn quốc gia (Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia) từ năm 1970 đến 2040\.

→ Dạng: line graph – multiple groups (so sánh \+ xu hướng theo thời gian, có yếu tố dự đoán)

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ các từ khóa:

percentage / proportion

population

living in cities / urban areas

four countries

time period

Có thể dùng:

shows → illustrates / compares

living in cities → residing in urban areas

Mẫu:

The line graph illustrates the proportion of people living in urban areas in four different countries between 1970 and 2040\.

3. Overview (ý chính)

Malaysia tăng mạnh và trở thành nước có tỷ lệ cao nhất

Indonesia có tốc độ tăng nhanh nhất, đặc biệt sau năm 2000

Philippines dao động nhẹ trước khi tăng trở lại

Thailand luôn thấp nhất nhưng tăng đều theo thời gian

Từ khóa nên dùng:

experienced the most significant growth

rose rapidly

showed slight fluctuations

remained the lowest

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Nhóm nổi bật (Malaysia & Indonesia)

Malaysia:

tăng liên tục từ khoảng 30% lên hơn 80%

→ xu hướng tăng mạnh và ổn định, luôn đứng đầu từ sau 2000

Indonesia:

tăng từ khoảng 13% lên khoảng 60%

đặc biệt tăng nhanh từ 2000 đến 2020 (30% → 50%)

→ tốc độ tăng nhanh nhất

Ý chính: cả hai quốc gia đều tăng mạnh, trong đó Malaysia dẫn đầu còn Indonesia có mức tăng ấn tượng nhất

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại (Philippines & Thailand)

Philippines:

tăng từ khoảng 32% lên gần 48% vào 1990

sau đó giảm nhẹ xuống \~42% vào 2010 rồi tăng lại lên \~50%

→ xu hướng dao động nhẹ

Thailand:

tăng đều từ khoảng 17% lên khoảng 46%

→ tăng chậm nhưng ổn định, luôn thấp nhất

Ý chính: Philippines có sự biến động nhẹ trong khi Thailand duy trì xu hướng tăng đều nhưng ở mức thấp hơn các nước khác

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

increase steadily

rise sharply

experience fluctuations

decline slightly

remain the highest

record the lowest figure

show an upward trend

grow gradually

Ví dụ:

Malaysia experienced a steady and significant increase throughout the period.

Indonesia saw a sharp rise, particularly after 2000\.

The Philippines showed slight fluctuations before rising again.

Thailand remained the lowest despite gradual growth.

—---------------------------------

The line graph illustrates the proportion of people living in urban areas in four countries—Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia—between 1970 and 2040\.

Malaysia shows a steady and consistent increase throughout the period. Starting at around 30% in 1970, it rose to approximately 45% in 1990, then climbed sharply to 60% in 2000 and continued growing to just over 80% by 2040, making it the highest among all countries from 2000 onwards.

The Philippines follows a more fluctuating pattern. Its urban population increased from about 32% in 1970 to a peak of roughly 48% in 1990, before declining slightly to just above 40% in 2010\. After that, it recovered gradually, reaching around 50% by the end of the period.

Indonesia experienced the most dramatic growth after 2000\. Beginning at approximately 13% in 1970, it rose steadily to 30% in 2000, then increased rapidly to about 60% by 2040\.

Thailand, in contrast, had the lowest figures overall. Although it grew from around 17% in 1970 to 30% in 1990, its increase remained relatively slow until 2020, before rising more noticeably to roughly 46% in the final year.

Malaysia: 1970: 30%, 1980: 40%, 1990: 50%, 2000: 60%, 2010: 70%, 2020: 75%, 2030: 80%, 2040: 83%
Thailand: 1970: 15%, 1980: 20%, 1990: 30%, 2000: 30%, 2010: 30%, 2020: 35%, 2030: 38%, 2040: 46%

* Malaysia consistently has the highest percentage of its population living in cities throughout the period, reaching over 80% by 2030.
* Thailand consistently has the lowest percentage of its population living in cities, remaining below 50% even by 2040.
* Indonesia shows the most significant growth in urban population percentage, particularly from 1990 onwards, with a sharp increase between 2000 and 2010.
* The Philippines' urban population percentage fluctuates, with a slight dip around 2010 before rising again.
* All four countries are projected to see an increase in their urban population percentage by 2040 compared to 1970.

title: Line Graph: The percentage of the population in three different countries who used the interne...
description: The line graph shows the percentage of the population in three different countries who used the internet between 1999 and 2009. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Line graph: Internet users as a percentage of population (1999–2009)

1. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ người sử dụng Internet (% dân số) tại ba quốc gia: USA, Canada và Mexico trong giai đoạn 1999–2009.

Giữ các từ khóa:

Internet users

percentage of population

three countries

time period

Có thể dùng:

shows → illustrates / compares

Internet users → people using the Internet

Mẫu:

The line graph illustrates the percentage of Internet users in three countries between 1999 and 2009\.

3. Overview (ý chính)

Cả ba quốc gia đều tăng mạnh theo thời gian

Canada tăng nhanh nhất và trở thành nước cao nhất từ 2003

USA tăng đều và đứng thứ hai

Mexico tăng chậm hơn và luôn thấp nhất

Từ khóa nên dùng:

showed an upward trend

rose sharply

increased steadily

remained the lowest

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Canada & USA

Canada:

tăng mạnh từ khoảng 5% lên hơn 90%

đặc biệt tăng đột biến giai đoạn 2001–2003

→ tăng nhanh nhất và cao nhất

USA:

tăng đều từ khoảng 15% lên khoảng 70%

→ xu hướng ổn định, đứng thứ hai

Ý chính: Canada vượt USA từ 2003 và duy trì khoảng cách lớn đến cuối kỳ

BODY 2 – Mexico

Mexico:

tăng từ khoảng 2% lên khoảng 35%

→ tăng liên tục nhưng chậm hơn đáng kể

So sánh:

luôn thấp hơn rõ rệt so với USA và Canada

Ý chính: Mexico có xu hướng tăng ổn định nhưng vẫn ở mức thấp nhất trong suốt giai đoạn

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

increase steadily

rise sharply

grow significantly

show an upward trend

remain considerably lower

experience rapid growth

Ví dụ:

Internet usage in Canada rose sharply, especially between 2001 and 2003\.

The figure for the USA increased steadily throughout the period.

Mexico experienced gradual growth but remained significantly lower than the other countries.

The line graph illustrates the proportion of internet users as a percentage of the population in the USA, Canada, and Mexico between 1999 and 2009\.

Overall, internet usage rose significantly in all three countries. Canada experienced the fastest growth and became the leading country from 2003 onwards, while Mexico remained the lowest despite steady increases.

In 1999, the USA had the highest proportion at about 15%, followed by Canada at roughly 5%, and Mexico at only around 2%. By 2001, the USA had risen to approximately 30%, while Canada increased more modestly to about 18%. However, Canada then saw a sharp surge to around 55% in 2003, overtaking the USA, which reached just under 40% in the same year.

After 2003, all three countries continued to grow. The USA increased steadily from about 38% to 70% by 2009\. Canada maintained the most rapid upward trend, climbing from around 55% in 2003 to approximately 90% in the final year. Meanwhile, Mexico showed gradual but consistent growth, rising from about 2% in 1999 to around 35% by 2009\.

computer ownership

became the most common category

increased steadily

showed an upward trend

tăng đều từ khoảng 5% lên hơn 20%

→ tăng ổn định

tăng từ khoảng 1% lên gần 10%

increase steadily

rise gradually

decline sharply

remain the lowest

become dominant

show an upward trend

The proportion of households with no computer declined sharply over the period.

Ownership of one computer increased steadily and became the most common category.

The figures for two and three or more computers rose gradually.

Households with three or more computers remained the least common group.

The line graph illustrates the percentage of households in the U.S. owning different numbers of computers between 1997 and 2012\.

Overall, computer ownership became increasingly widespread over the period. The proportion of households with no computer declined markedly, while those owning one or more devices rose, particularly in the case of households with two or more computers.

In 1997, households without a computer accounted for the largest share at around 67%, followed by those with one computer at approximately 27%. Over time, the figure for non-ownership fell steadily to about 17% in 2012\. In contrast, the percentage of households owning one computer increased from 27% to a peak of 50% in 2003, before fluctuating slightly and ending at around 50% in the final year.

Meanwhile, ownership of multiple computers rose consistently. The proportion of households with two computers grew from roughly 5% in 1997 to about 23% in 2012\. Similarly, those with three or more computers increased from just 2% to around 9% in 2009, before experiencing a slight decline to approximately 8% by the end of the period.

average hours

giảm đều từ khoảng 32 xuống khoảng 22 giờ

dao động nhưng nhìn chung giảm nhẹ (21 → \~19)

→ biến động nhẹ

decline steadily

drop significantly

The line graph shows the average number of hours required to produce cars in the US by four manufacturers—General Motors, Ford, Toyota, and Honda—between 1998 and 2005\.

Overall, production time decreased for all companies over the period. General Motors and Ford started with the highest figures but recorded significant reductions, while Toyota and Honda consistently maintained lower production times.

In 1998, General Motors had the longest production time at just over 32 hours per vehicle, followed by Ford at around 28 hours. Both companies reduced their production time steadily, with General Motors falling to approximately 23 hours in 2005\. Ford initially rose to a peak of about 31 hours in 2001 before declining sharply to around 20 hours by the end of the period.

Toyota and Honda, in contrast, began with lower figures. Toyota fluctuated slightly, increasing from around 20 hours in 1998 to a peak of 24 hours in 2002, before declining to approximately 19 hours in 2005\. Honda showed a similar pattern of fluctuation, starting at about 21 hours, dropping to 18 hours in 1999, then rising to 24 hours in 2002, and finally decreasing again to around 18 hours in the final year.

By 2005, the production times of all four manufacturers had converged, with Ford and Toyota recording the lowest figures, followed closely by Honda and General Motors.

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

The line graph illustrates the amount of goods transported in the UK by four different modes between 1974 and 2002\.

3\. Overview (ý chính)

  • Water tăng ổn định
  • Rail dao động, không có xu hướng rõ ràng
  • Pipeline thấp nhất nhưng tăng nhanh giai đoạn đầu rồi ổn định
4\. Cách chia BODY

→ Chia theo tăng mạnh vs dao động/thấp

BODY 1 – Road & Water

→ từ \~70 lên gần 100

→ có giảm nhẹ giai đoạn đầu nhưng nhìn chung tăng mạnh

→ dao động quanh 30–40

→ giảm (1986), tăng lại (1990), rồi lại giảm nhẹ

→ không có xu hướng rõ ràng

  • Pipeline:

→ tăng nhanh từ \~5 lên \~23 (1982)

→ sau đó gần như ổn định quanh 20–23

→ Key idea:

  • Rail biến động, pipeline tăng sớm rồi ổn định
5\. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm
Trend:
  • increase significantly
  • rise steadily
  • fluctuate
  • level off
Structure:
  • remained the dominant mode
  • showed a steady upward trend
  • fluctuated over the period
  • rose sharply before stabilizing
So sánh:
  • by contrast
  • while / whereas
  • compared with
Ví dụ câu:
  • Road transport remained the dominant mode throughout the period.
  • Pipeline rose sharply in the early years before leveling off.
  • Rail fluctuated without a clear overall trend.

The line graph compares the amount of goods transported in the UK by four different modes—road, water, rail and pipeline—between 1974 and 2002, measured in million tonnes.

Overall, road transport was consistently the dominant mode and showed a clear upward trend over the period. Water transport also increased overall, while rail fluctuated without a clear long-term rise. Pipeline transport grew rapidly at first and then stabilised.

In 1974, around 70 million tonnes of goods were moved by road, compared to approximately 40 million tonnes by both water and rail. Pipeline accounted for a much smaller figure, at about 5 million tonnes. Road transport dipped slightly in the early 1980s but then rose steadily, reaching nearly 100 million tonnes by 2002\.

Water transport experienced moderate growth, increasing from about 38 million tonnes in 1974 to just over 60 million tonnes at the end of the period, despite a slight decline in the mid-1990s. Rail transport, by contrast, showed fluctuations: it fell from around 40 million tonnes to just above 30 million tonnes in the mid-1980s before recovering to approximately 40 million tonnes by 2002\.

Pipeline transport rose sharply from 5 million tonnes in 1974 to around 22–23 million tonnes by the early 1980s, after which it remained relatively stable, with a slight decline to about 20 million tonnes in the later years.

title: Line Graph: The graph below gives information on the numbers of participants for different act...

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Number of participants, by activity 2000–2020
1\. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường thể hiện số lượng người tham gia 5 hoạt động (film club, martial arts, amateur dramatics, table tennis, musical performances) trong giai đoạn 2000–2020.

→ Dạng: line graph (time \+ multiple categories)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

The line graph illustrates the number of participants in five different activities between 2000 and 2020\.

3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Film club luôn cao nhất, tương đối ổn định
  • Table tennis tăng mạnh nhất, đặc biệt sau 2010
  • Amateur dramatics giảm liên tục
  • Musical performances bắt đầu từ 0 nhưng tăng đều
  • Martial arts dao động nhẹ, không có xu hướng rõ ràng
4\. Cách chia BODY

→ Chia theo nhóm ổn định/tăng vs giảm/dao động

BODY 1 – Film club & Table tennis
  • Film club:

→ khoảng 63 (2000) → giảm nhẹ → tăng lại \~65 (2020)

→ luôn là cao nhất

  • Table tennis:

→ tăng từ \~18 lên \~55

→ tăng mạnh nhất, đặc biệt sau 2010

→ Key idea:

  • Film club ổn định ở mức cao, trong khi table tennis tăng vượt trội
BODY 2 – Các hoạt động còn lại
  • Amateur dramatics:

→ tăng nhẹ đến 2005 (\~28)

→ sau đó giảm mạnh xuống \~10 (2020)

  • Martial arts:

→ dao động quanh 30–38

→ không có xu hướng rõ ràng

  • Musical performances:

→ từ 0 (2000–2005)

→ tăng đều lên \~18 (2020)

→ Key idea:

  • Amateur dramatics giảm đáng kể, musical performances tăng dần từ mức rất thấp, còn martial arts biến động nhẹ
5\. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm
Trend:
  • rise sharply / increase significantly
  • decline steadily
  • fluctuate slightly
  • remain stable
Structure:
  • remained the most popular activity
  • experienced a dramatic increase
  • saw a gradual decline
  • started at zero and rose steadily
So sánh:
  • whereas / while
  • by contrast
  • compared to
Ví dụ câu:
  • Table tennis experienced a sharp rise after 2010\.
  • Amateur dramatics declined steadily over the period.
  • Film club remained the most popular activity throughout.

Overall, the film club consistently attracted the largest number of participants throughout the period, while table tennis experienced the most significant growth. In contrast, amateur dramatics declined steadily, becoming the least popular activity by 2020\.

In 2000, around 63 people attended the film club, compared to approximately 37 for martial arts and 26 for amateur dramatics. Table tennis had a lower figure of about 18 participants, while musical performances had virtually none. Over the next decade, film club participation dipped slightly to 60 in 2010 before recovering to around 65 by 2020\.

Table tennis showed a marked upward trend, rising from 18 in 2000 to 20 in 2010, then surging to 35 in 2015 and reaching approximately 55 participants in 2020\. Martial arts fluctuated modestly, decreasing from 37 to 31 in 2005, then increasing to 38 in 2010, and ending at about 38 again in 2020\.

By contrast, amateur dramatics fell continuously from 26 in 2000 to just 10 participants by 2020\. Musical performances, which had no participants initially, saw gradual growth, increasing to around 12 in 2010 and reaching approximately 18 by the end of the period.

5\. Từ vựng ăn điểm
Trend:

  • reached a peak of

The line graph compares the value of four types of investment funds—property, fine art, gold and company shares—in the US between 1988 and 2014, measured in millions of dollars.

Overall, all four investment categories showed an upward trend over time, although gold and fine art were more volatile. Gold experienced the most dramatic growth and ended as the highest-value asset, while property increased steadily but remained the least valuable throughout the period.

In the early years, gold was already relatively high at around $90 million in 1988 and rose slightly to about $100 million in 1990 before dropping sharply to roughly $50 million in 1992\. It then recovered and fluctuated moderately until 2006, after which it surged significantly, peaking at approximately $450 million in 2012 before falling to around $380 million in 2014\.

Company shares showed a strong and consistent upward trend. Starting at about $30 million in 1988, they rose sharply to $150 million in 1994 and continued to increase steadily, reaching approximately $250 million by the end of the period.

Fine art displayed considerable fluctuations. It rose from around $65 million in 1988 to about $80 million in 1990, then dropped to roughly $40 million in 1998\. After that, it increased sharply, reaching around $175 million in 2004, before dipping again and then climbing significantly to approximately $330 million in 2014\.

Property, in contrast, followed a gradual and stable upward trend. Beginning at about $50 million in 1988, it increased steadily over time, reaching nearly $200 million by 2014, with only minor fluctuations along the way.

  • Timber:

→ sau đó tăng đều từ khoảng 3 lên gần 10 (1996)

BODY 2 – Pulp (dao động)

→ tăng từ \~4.5 lên gần 9.5 (1984)

→ sau đó giảm dần và dao động quanh mức 7–8

→ kết thúc khoảng 7.5 (1996)

→ Key idea:

  • Pulp có xu hướng biến động, không tăng rõ rệt như hai ngành còn lại
5\. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm

  • fluctuate
  • peak at
  • decline slightly

  • ended the period at

  • in contrast
  • compared to
Ví dụ câu:

  • Timber recovered after an initial drop and rose consistently thereafter.
  • In contrast, pulp fluctuated and remained relatively stable overall.

The line graph illustrates the production of pulp, timber and paper in a forest industry between 1980 and 1996, measured in million tonnes.

Overall, paper production increased steadily and became the highest by the end of the period. Timber also showed a general upward trend despite an early decline, while pulp fluctuated and finished slightly below its mid-period peak.

In 1980, timber was the leading product at around 5.5 million tonnes, followed by pulp at approximately 4.5 million tonnes and paper at just under 4 million tonnes. However, timber output dropped sharply to about 3 million tonnes in 1982 before recovering to nearly 7 million tonnes by 1984\. After that, it rose gradually, reaching around 9.5 million tonnes in 1996\.

Pulp production increased significantly in the early years, climbing from roughly 4.5 million tonnes in 1980 to a peak of about 9.5 million tonnes in 1984\. It then declined and fluctuated between 6.5 and 8 million tonnes for the remainder of the period, ending at approximately 7.5 million tonnes.

By contrast, paper production followed a consistent upward trend throughout. It rose from about 3.7 million tonnes in 1980 to around 7.5 million tonnes in 1990, then continued to grow, overtaking both pulp and timber after 1992 and peaking at approximately 12 million tonnes in 1996\.

The line graph illustrates changes in car ownership in the UK between 1975 and 2005, measured as percentages of households across four categories.

In contrast, one-car ownership dropped initially to around 36% in 1985, before rising again to approximately 45% at the end of the period.

Meanwhile, the proportion of households owning two cars increased consistently, from about 5% in 1975 to nearly 18% in 2005\. A similar upward trend was seen for three-car ownership, although at a lower level, rising from roughly 2% to around 9% over the same period.

5\. Từ vựng ăn điểm
  • remain the highest / lowest

  • fluctuate slightly
  • stabilize

The line chart compares the proportion of workers taking sick leave in five European countries—Netherlands, France, Sweden, the UK and Germany—between 1991 and 2001\.

Overall, the Netherlands consistently recorded the highest absence rates, while Germany had the lowest throughout the period. France showed a clear downward trend, whereas Sweden generally increased over time. The UK and Germany remained relatively stable with only minor fluctuations.

In the Netherlands, the percentage started at around 5% in 1991, peaked slightly above 5% in 1992, and then declined to just under 4% in 1996\. The line graph compares the amount of nitrogen oxide emissions, measured in grams per kilometre, produced by four types of vehicles at different speeds.

3\. Overview

  • Buses luôn thấp nhất

  • Lorries và buses biến động nhẹ, khá ổn định

  • slight fluctuation (lorries & buses)

Petrol cars:

  • sau đó tăng nhẹ

BODY 2

  • giảm nhẹ từ \~12 xuống \~10
  • sau đó tăng lại đến \~13

→ minor fluctuation

Buses:

  • sau đó gần như ổn định

→ slight decline then stable

  • decline gradually

  • remain relatively stable

The line graph illustrates the amount of nitrogen oxide emissions produced by four types of vehicles—diesel cars, petrol cars, lorries and buses—at different speeds ranging from 10 to 130 kph.

Overall, diesel cars emitted the highest levels of nitrogen oxide across all speeds, while buses consistently produced the lowest. Emissions from diesel and petrol cars generally decreased as speed increased up to around 60–90 kph, before rising again. In contrast, lorries and buses showed relatively minor fluctuations throughout.

At low speeds (10 kph), diesel cars emitted approximately 38 g/km, compared to around 33 g/km for petrol cars. These figures declined steadily, reaching their lowest points at about 26 g/km (diesel) and 21 g/km (petrol) at 60 kph. After this, emissions from both vehicle types increased again, with diesel cars rising sharply to roughly 40 g/km at 130 kph, and petrol cars climbing more moderately to about 24 g/km.

Lorries started at around 12 g/km and decreased slightly to about 10 g/km at mid-range speeds, before gradually increasing again to approximately 12–13 g/km at the highest speeds. Similarly, buses emitted the least, beginning at about 8 g/km and falling to around 5 g/km at 60 kph, after which emissions remained relatively stable with only a slight upward trend towards 6 g/km by 130 kph.

In Japan, prices rose from about $2.0/kg in 1996 to a peak of $3.0 in 1998, before dropping sharply to $2.0 in 1999\. They then fluctuated, reaching around $2.5 in 2000, dipping again in 2001, and ending at approximately $2.5 in 2004 despite a brief fall in 2003\.

France maintained a comparatively steady pattern, remaining close to $2.0/kg throughout the period. There was a slight dip to about $1.5 in 1999, followed by a recovery to around $2.0 by 2000, after which prices hovered just below or at this level.

Germany started at roughly $1.5/kg, fell to $1.2 in 1997, and then climbed to around $1.8 in 1998\. Although it dropped again in 1999, prices generally increased afterwards, peaking at about $2.0 in 2002 before stabilising at around $1.7 by 2004\.

In contrast, the USA recorded the lowest prices, beginning at $1.0/kg and showing only slight fluctuations. Prices rose modestly to around $1.3 in 1998, remained relatively stable thereafter, and finished at approximately $1.2 in 2004\.

The line graph compares the percentage of internet users in four countries—Japan, the US, China and India—between 1996 and 2001\.

In 1996, Japan had by far the highest proportion of users at 26%, followed by the US at 11%. China and India were significantly lower, at 2% and 1% respectively. From 1999 onwards, China’s growth accelerated sharply, rising from 11% in 1999 to 25% in 2000 and reaching 28% in 2001, overtaking all other countries. In contrast, Japan declined slightly to 17% and then stabilised. The US dropped to 5% in 2000 before recovering modestly to 7% in the final year. India, on the other hand, climbed steadily to 7% in 2000, before falling slightly to 5% in 2001\.

Number of people using different communication services (1998–2008)

Biểu đồ đường cho thấy số người sử dụng (trên 100 dân) của 5 loại dịch vụ liên lạc:

  • cellular phone

trong giai đoạn 1998–2008.

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

The line graph illustrates the number of people per 100 inhabitants using five different communication services between 1998 and 2008\.

3\. Overview (ý chính)

  • Internet tăng đều đáng kể
  • Landline tăng nhẹ rồi chững/lệch nhẹ cuối kỳ
  • Broadband (fixed & mobile) xuất hiện muộn nhưng tăng nhanh
4\. Cách chia BODY

→ Chia theo tăng mạnh vs tăng nhẹ/late development

BODY 1 – Cellular phone, Internet, Landline

→ tăng mạnh từ \~4 lên \~63

→ vượt tất cả các dịch vụ khác

  • Internet:

→ tăng đều từ \~3 lên \~23

→ không có giảm

  • Landline:

→ tăng nhẹ từ \~13 lên \~19 (2006)

→ sau đó giảm nhẹ về \~18 (2008)

→ Key idea:

  • Mobile phone bùng nổ, internet tăng ổn định, landline gần như bão hòa
BODY 2 – Fixed & Mobile broadband
  • Fixed broadband:

→ bắt đầu khoảng 2002 (\~0)

→ tăng lên \~5 (2008)

  • Mobile broadband:

→ gần như 0 đến 2006

→ tăng lên \~3 (2008)

→ Key idea:

  • Cả hai xuất hiện muộn nhưng tăng nhanh ở cuối giai đoạn
5\. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm
Trend:
  • rise dramatically
  • increase steadily
  • level off
  • remain relatively stable

  • showed a gradual increase
  • emerged later in the period

  • compared to
Ví dụ câu:
  • Cellular phone service experienced the most dramatic growth.
  • Landline usage remained relatively stable before a slight decline.

The line graph illustrates the number of people per 100 inhabitants using five types of communication services—landline, cellular phone, internet, fixed broadband and mobile broadband—between 1998 and 2008\.

Overall, cellular phone usage rose dramatically and became the most widely used service by the end of the period. Internet and broadband services also showed strong growth, while landline usage remained relatively stable with a slight decline in the final years.

In 1998, landline service was the most common, at around 13 users per 100 people, followed by cellular phones at approximately 4\. Over the next decade, landline usage increased modestly to about 19 in 2006 before falling slightly to 18 in 2008\. In contrast, cellular phone usage surged steadily, reaching around 17 in 2002, then climbing sharply to over 60 by 2008\.

Internet usage also rose consistently, from roughly 3 users in 1998 to about 23 in 2008\. Fixed broadband appeared later, starting at virtually zero in 2002 and increasing gradually to around 5 users by the end of the period. Mobile broadband emerged even later, remaining negligible until 2006 before rising slightly to approximately 3 users in 2008\.

trong giai đoạn 1980–2010

The line graph illustrates the percentage of people in four age groups who visited a museum at least once a year between 1980 and 2010\.

3\. Overview (quan trọng nhất)
  • Nhóm 50+ luôn cao nhất, nhưng giảm dần theo thời gian
  • Nhóm 15–24 thấp nhất, dao động nhẹ
  • Nhóm 25–34 và 35–49 giảm vào 1990 rồi tăng lại

→ peak around 1990 → dip → recovery → slight decline at the end

→ Chia hợp lý:

  • tăng nhẹ lên \~49% (1990)
  • sau đó giảm dần đều
  • kết thúc khoảng 41% (2010)

→ Key:

  • gradual downward trend after 1990
BODY 2 – Other groups

  • đều giảm mạnh về \~29% (1990)
  • sau đó phục hồi lên \~35–38% (1995–2005)
  • rồi giảm nhẹ cuối kỳ
15–24:

  • tăng nhẹ đến \~25% (1990)
  • dao động nhẹ
  • giảm về \~21% (2010)

→ Key:

  • relatively stable compared to 50+

  • saw a recovery afterwards

The line graph illustrates the proportion of people in four age groups who visited a museum at least once a year between 1980 and 2010\.

Overall, people aged 50 and over consistently recorded the highest participation rates, while the 15–24 group had the lowest. Most groups experienced a decline around 1990, followed by a recovery in the mid-1990s, before generally stabilising or slightly decreasing towards the end of the period.

In detail, the figure for those aged 50+ rose from about 46% in 1980 to a peak of nearly 49% in 1990, after which it gradually declined to approximately 41% by 2010\. Similarly, the 35–49 group fell from around 37% in 1980 to 29% in 1990, then rebounded sharply to about 38% in 1995, remaining relatively stable before ending at roughly 36%.

For younger adults, the percentage of 25–34-year-olds decreased from 35% in 1980 to 29% in 1990, before recovering to around 35% and then edging down slightly to 33% by 2010\. The 15–24 group followed a similar but lower pattern, rising from 20% to 25% between 1980 and 1990, then fluctuating modestly and finishing at just above 20% in the final year.

→ tăng đều từ \~38 lên \~100

  • Coal:

→ giảm liên tục, chỉ t��ng nhẹ giai đoạn giữa

The line graph shows changes in UK fuel production levels from 1981 to 2000, measured in energy units, for coal, natural gas and petroleum.

Overall, petroleum remained the dominant source throughout the period despite some fluctuations. Natural gas experienced a steady and then rapid increase, while coal production declined consistently over time.

In 1981, coal and petroleum were the main fuels, at about 80 and 85 energy units respectively, whereas natural gas was much lower at around 37 units. Petroleum production rose sharply to approximately 140 units in 1986 before falling to about 90 in 1991\. It then recovered, reaching around 140 units again in 1996 and remaining stable at this level in 2000\.

Coal production followed the opposite trend. After starting at roughly 80 units in 1981, it dropped significantly to just under 50 in 1983, recovered slightly to around 60 in 1986, and then declined steadily to about 35 units by 2000\.

Natural gas showed continuous growth. It increased gradually from about 37 units in 1981 to 42 in 1991, before rising more sharply to nearly 80 units in 1996 and finishing at approximately 100 units in 2000\.

HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

USA Labour Force Employment (1930–2010)
1\. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường thể hiện tỷ lệ (%) lực lượng lao động Mỹ làm việc trong 5 lĩnh vực (industrial, technical, sales & office, other services, farming/fishing/forestry) từ 1930 đến 2010.

The line graph illustrates the percentage of the US labour force employed in five different sectors between 1930 and 2010\.

3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Nhìn chung, farming giảm mạnh, trong khi industrial và technical tăng đáng kể
  • Industrial trở thành ngành lớn nhất vào cuối kỳ

→ Chia theo giảm mạnh vs tăng

→ giảm mạnh còn \~30% (1990)

→ Key idea:

  • Đây là ngành giảm mạnh nhất, từ dominant → gần như biến mất
BODY 2 – Các ngành còn lại (tăng)
  • Industrial:

→ gần như 0% (1930–1950)

→ tăng mạnh sau 1970, đạt khoảng \~38% (2010) → cao nhất

  • Technical:

→ tăng đều từ \~2% lên \~25%

  • Sales and office:

→ tăng dần từ \~10% lên \~20%

  • Other services:

→ dao động nhẹ quanh 8–10%, tương đối ổn định

→ Key idea:

  • Lao động chuyển dịch từ nông nghiệp sang công nghiệp và dịch vụ
5\. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm
Trend verbs:
  • decline dramatically
  • rise steadily
  • remain stable
  • increase sharply
Useful structures:
  • accounted for the largest proportion
  • experienced a significant decline
  • showed a steady upward trend
  • became the dominant sector
So sánh:
  • in contrast
  • whereas
  • compared to
Ví dụ câu:
  • Employment in farming declined dramatically over the period.
  • Industrial jobs rose sharply and became the dominant sector by 2010\.
  • Other services, by contrast, remained relatively stable throughout.

The line graph illustrates the proportion of the US labour force employed in five sectors between 1930 and 2010\.

Overall, employment in farming, fishing and forestry declined dramatically, while industrial and technical sectors grew substantially. Sales and office work also increased, whereas other services remained relatively stable over time.

In 1930, agriculture-related jobs dominated, accounting for roughly 75% of employment. This figure fell steadily to about 60% in 1970, then dropped sharply to 40% in 1980 and continued to decline to just around 2% by 2010\. In contrast, industrial employment rose from almost 0% in 1930 to around 10% in 1970, before increasing more rapidly to approximately 37% in 2010, becoming the largest sector.

Technical occupations followed a similar upward trend, growing from about 2% in 1930 to roughly 25% by the end of the period. Meanwhile, jobs in sales and office work increased more gradually, rising from around 10% in 1930 to nearly 20% in 2010, despite a slight fluctuation around 1960\.

By comparison, other services showed only minor variation. After peaking at about 15% in 1940, this category declined slightly and then stabilised at around 9–10% from 1980 onwards.

title: Line Graph: The graph below shows average carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions per person in the Uni...
description: The graph below shows average carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions per person in the United Kingdom, Sweden, Italy and Portugal between 1967 and 2007. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Average carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions per person (1967–2007)
1\. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường cho thấy lượng khí CO₂ trung bình trên đầu người ở 4 quốc gia (UK, Portugal, Italy, Sweden) trong giai đoạn 1967–2007.

→ Dạng: line graph (time \+ comparison)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

The line graph illustrates the average amount of carbon dioxide emissions per person in four countries between 1967 and 2007\.

3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • UK giảm dần nhưng vẫn cao nhất trong toàn bộ giai đoạn
  • Italy và Sweden tăng, đặc biệt Sweden tăng mạnh về cuối
  • Portugal tăng rồi giảm, xu hướng biến động
  • Khoảng cách giữa các nước thu hẹp dần theo thời gian
4\. Cách chia BODY

→ Chia theo giảm vs tăng/biến động

BODY 1 – UK và Portugal
  • United Kingdom:

→ cao nhất, khoảng 11 (1967)

→ giảm đều xuống \~8.5 (2007)

  • Portugal:

→ tăng từ \~8.5 lên gần 10 (1977)

→ sau đó giảm mạnh xuống \~5.5 (2007)

→ Key idea:

  • UK giảm ổn định, Portugal tăng rồi giảm đáng kể
BODY 2 – Italy và Sweden
  • Italy:

→ tăng đều từ \~4 lên \~7.5

→ không có biến động lớn

  • Sweden:

→ thấp nhất ban đầu (\~1.5)

→ tăng liên tục lên \~5.5 (2007)

→ Key idea:

  • Cả hai nước tăng, nhưng Sweden có mức tăng rõ rệt hơn
5\. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm
Trend verbs:
  • decline steadily
  • increase gradually
  • fluctuate
  • rise significantly
Useful structures:
  • remained the highest throughout the period
  • showed a steady downward trend
  • experienced a sharp increase
  • reached a peak of
So sánh:
  • while / whereas
  • compared to
  • in contrast
Ví dụ câu:
  • The UK remained the highest emitter despite a gradual decline.
  • Italy showed a steady increase over the period.
  • In contrast, Portugal rose initially before falling significantly.

The line graph compares the average carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions per person in the United Kingdom, Portugal, Italy and Sweden between 1967 and 2007\.

Overall, the UK consistently recorded the highest emissions, although its figures declined gradually over time. In contrast, Italy and Sweden showed upward trends, while Portugal’s emissions rose initially before falling significantly in the later years.

In 1967, the UK emitted just over 11 tonnes per person, far higher than Portugal (around 8.5 tonnes), Italy (4 tonnes) and Sweden (approximately 1.5 tonnes). Over the next four decades, UK emissions steadily decreased to about 8.5 tonnes in 2007\.

Portugal experienced a sharp increase from about 8.5 tonnes in 1967 to nearly 10 tonnes in 1977, before dropping markedly to 6 tonnes by 1997 and further declining to roughly 5.5 tonnes at the end of the period. Italy, by contrast, saw a continuous rise, with emissions climbing from 4 tonnes to approximately 7.5 tonnes in 2007\.

Sweden started with the lowest emissions but showed steady growth, rising from about 1.5 tonnes in 1967 to 5.5 tonnes in 2007, eventually matching Portugal’s level in the final year.

United Kingdom: 1967: 11, 1977: 10.5, 1987: 10, 1997: 9, 2007: 8.5

KEY FEATURES:
* The United Kingdom consistently had the highest emissions per person throughout the period, though it showed a steady decline.
* Sweden had the lowest emissions per person in 1967 but experienced a continuous increase over the period.
* Portugal's emissions peaked in 1977 and then saw a significant decrease.
* Italy's emissions showed a steady increase throughout the period.
* By 2007, Portugal and Sweden had similar emission levels, while the UK remained the highest and Italy was in the middle.

title: Line Graph: The graph below shows the changes in the birth rates for women in 6 different age ...
description: The graph below shows the changes in the birth rates for women in 6 different age groups in the UK from 1973 to 2008. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Birth rates by age group (1973–2008)
1\. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường cho thấy tỷ lệ sinh (trên 1.000 phụ nữ) ở 6 nhóm tuổi trong giai đoạn 1973–2008.

→ Dạng: line graph (time \+ multiple groups)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

The line graph illustrates birth rates among six different age groups between 1973 and 2008\.

3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Nhóm 25–29 luôn cao nhất, dù có biến động
  • 20–24 giảm đều theo thời gian
  • 30–34 và 35–39 tăng đáng kể
  • Under 20 và 40+ đều giảm liên tục
  • Xu hướng chung: dịch chuyển sinh con sang nhóm tuổi lớn hơn
4\. Cách chia BODY

→ Chia theo giảm vs tăng \+ nhóm nổi bật

BODY 1 – Nhóm cao & giảm (25–29, 20–24)
  • 25–29:

→ bắt đầu khoảng 140 (1973)

→ giảm rồi tăng lại (peak \~134 năm 1993\)

→ kết thúc khoảng 120

→ luôn cao nhất

  • 20–24:

→ giảm đều từ \~130 xuống \~90

→ Key idea:

  • Nhóm trẻ (20–29) từng chiếm ưu thế, nhưng 20–24 giảm rõ rệt
BODY 2 – Nhóm tăng & nhóm thấp
  • 30–34:

→ tăng đều từ \~70 lên \~87

  • 35–39:

→ tăng mạnh từ \~40 lên \~65

  • Under 20:

→ giảm từ \~60 xuống \~37

  • 40+:

→ giảm liên tục từ \~20 xuống \~5

→ Key idea:

  • Nhóm 30+ tăng rõ rệt, trong khi nhóm rất trẻ và rất lớn tuổi giảm
5\. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm
Trend:
  • increase steadily
  • decline gradually
  • fluctuate
  • rise significantly
Structure:
  • remained the highest throughout
  • showed a downward trend
  • experienced a steady increase
  • fell consistently over the period
So sánh:
  • whereas / while
  • in contrast
  • compared with
Ví dụ câu:
  • The 25–29 group remained the highest despite some fluctuations.
  • Birth rates among women aged 20–24 declined steadily.
  • In contrast, the figures for the 30–34 and 35–39 groups increased significantly.

The line graph illustrates birth rates per 1,000 women across six age groups between 1973 and 2008\.

Overall, women aged 25–29 consistently recorded the highest birth rates, although their figures fluctuated slightly. In contrast, the youngest (under 20\) and oldest (40 and over) groups experienced steady declines. Meanwhile, birth rates for women aged 30–34 and 35–39 increased over time, indicating a shift towards later childbearing.

In 1973, the highest rate was among women aged 25–29 at about 140 births per 1,000, followed by those aged 20–24 at around 130\. Both groups declined over the period, with the 20–24 group falling more steadily to approximately 90 by 2008\. The 25–29 group fluctuated, peaking again at around 135 in 1993 before settling at about 120 in the final year.

By contrast, the 30–34 group rose consistently from roughly 70 in 1973 to about 87 in 2008\. Similarly, the 35–39 group increased from around 40 to approximately 65, with the most notable growth occurring after 1988\.

The under-20 group declined gradually from about 60 to under 40, while the 40-and-over group fell steadily from around 20 to just 5 births per 1,000 women by 2008\.

title: Line Graph: The graph shows the average monthly change in the prices of three metals during 2014
description: The graph shows the average monthly change in the prices of three metals during 2014. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Average Monthly Change in Prices of Copper, Nickel and Zinc (2014)
1\. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường thể hiện mức thay đổi giá trung bình theo tháng (%) của copper, nickel và zinc trong năm 2014, so với tháng trước đó.

→ Dạng: line graph (time \+ percentage change)

→ Lưu ý: có giá trị âm (giảm) và dương (tăng)

2\. Introduction (paraphrase)

The line graph illustrates the average monthly percentage change in the prices of copper, nickel and zinc in 2014, compared with the previous month.

3\. Overview (ý chính)
  • Nhìn chung, nickel biến động mạnh nhất, còn copper ổn định nhất
  • Tất cả các kim loại đều giảm mạnh vào giữa năm (đặc biệt tháng 6\)
  • Giá phục hồi vào cuối năm, kết thúc ở mức dương
4\. Cách chia BODY

→ Chia theo mức độ biến động (high vs stable)

BODY 1 – Nickel & Zinc (biến động mạnh)
  • Nickel:

→ bắt đầu rất cao (\~6% Jan), giảm liên tục

→ rơi mạnh xuống \-3% (Jun) – mức thấp nhất

→ sau đó phục hồi dần, kết thúc khoảng \+1% (Dec)

  • Zinc:

→ tăng từ 1% lên 3% (Feb)

→ giảm dần và xuống mức âm khoảng \-1% (Jun–Oct)

→ phục hồi mạnh cuối năm, đạt gần 2% (Dec)

→ Key idea:

  • Cả hai đều biến động lớn, đặc biệt nickel có biên độ thay đổi mạnh nhất
BODY 2 – Copper (ổn định hơn)
  • Copper:

→ dao động nhẹ quanh mức 1–2% đầu năm

→ giảm xuống khoảng \-1% (Jun)

→ sau đó tăng lại và duy trì mức \~1% đến cuối năm

→ Key idea:

  • Copper có xu hướng ổn định nhất, với biến động nhỏ hơn hai kim loại còn lại
5\. Từ vựng & cấu trúc ăn điểm
Trend verbs:
  • fluctuate
  • drop sharply
  • recover
  • remain stable
Useful structures:
  • reached a peak of
  • fell to a low of
  • showed a slight fluctuation
  • recovered gradually
So sánh:
  • more volatile than
  • relatively stable compared to
  • in contrast
Ví dụ câu:
  • Nickel experienced the most dramatic fluctuation, falling sharply to a low point in June.
  • By contrast, copper remained relatively stable throughout the year.
  • All three metals saw a recovery towards the end of the year.

The line graph shows the average month-to-month percentage change in the prices of copper, nickel and zinc in 2014\.

Overall, nickel experienced the greatest volatility, with sharp rises and falls, while copper showed the most stable pattern. Zinc fluctuated moderately, with both positive and negative changes during the year.

At the start of the year, all three metals recorded positive growth. Nickel rose most significantly, peaking at around 6% in January before falling rapidly to about 1% by March. Copper increased more modestly, from approximately 2% in January to 1% in February, then declined slightly. Zinc, in contrast, rose to a peak of about 3% in February before gradually decreasing to around 1% in May.

In June, all three metals saw a downturn. Nickel dropped sharply to approximately \-3%, its lowest point of the year, while copper fell to around \-1% and zinc also reached about \-1%. Following this, copper recovered steadily, maintaining a stable increase of around 1% from July to September before easing slightly in October and rising again towards the end of the year.

Nickel remained negative from June to October, fluctuating between \-1% and \-2%, before rebounding to positive territory in November and December. Similarly, zinc stayed slightly below zero from June to October but then recovered, ending the year at around 2%, the highest among the three metals in December.

TYPE: line graph
TITLE: Average monthly change in prices of copper, nickel and zinc (2014)
UNITS/AXES: Y-axis: % change in price compared with previous month, scale from -4 to 7 in increments of 1. X-axis: Months from Jan to Dec.
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Copper, Nickel, Zinc
DATA:
Copper: Jan 2, Feb 1, Mar 0.5, Apr 0.5, May 0.5, Jun 0.5, Jul 1, Aug 1, Sep 1, Oct 0.5, Nov 1.5, Dec 2
Nickel: Jan 6, Feb 4, Mar 1, Apr 0.5, May -0.5, Jun -3, Jul -1, Aug -1, Sep -1, Oct -2, Nov 0.5, Dec 1
Zinc: Jan 1, Feb 3, Mar 2, Apr 1.5, May 1, Jun -1, Jul -1, Aug -1, Sep -1, Oct -1, Nov 2, Dec 2.5
KEY FEATURES:
* Nickel experienced the highest initial change in January at 6%, and the lowest change in June at -3%.
* Copper's price change remained relatively stable, mostly between 0.5% and 2% throughout the year.
* Zinc showed a significant drop from February to June, then remained stable before a sharp increase at the end of the year.
* All three metals experienced a decrease in price change around the middle of the year (May-June).
* Copper and Zinc showed an upward trend in price change towards the end of the year (November-December).
* Nickel had the most volatile changes, starting high, dropping significantly, and then recovering partially.

title: Line Graph: The graph below shows how elderly people in the United States spent their free tim...
description: The graph below shows how elderly people in the United States spent their free time between 1980 and 2010. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Free Time Activities of US Elders (1980–2010)
1\. Giải thích đề

Biểu đồ đường cho thấy tỷ lệ người cao tuổi ở Mỹ tham gia các hoạt động giải trí gồm:

  • Reading
  • Theatre
  • Online
  • Hiking
  • Watching TV

trong giai đoạn 1980–2010

→ Dạng: line graph (multiple categories over time)

2\. Introduction

The line graph illustrates the percentages of US elderly people engaging in five different leisure activities between 1980 and 2010\.

3\. Overview
  • Watching TV luôn cao nhất, dù giảm nhẹ cuối kỳ
  • Hiking tăng mạnh nhất, trở thành cao nhất vào năm 2010
  • Online tăng nhanh về cuối kỳ
  • Reading dao động mạnh
  • Theatre giảm rồi tăng lại nhẹ

→ Xu hướng chính:

  • shift từ passive → active/modern activities
4\. Cách chia BODY

→ Chia hợp lý:

  • Body 1: Watching TV \+ Hiking (dominant \+ strong trend)
  • Body 2: Remaining activities (Reading, Theatre, Online)
BODY 1
Watching TV:
  • bắt đầu \~60% (1980)
  • tăng lên 70% (2000)
  • giảm nhẹ còn \~65% (2010)

→ stable \+ slight decline

Hiking:
  • tăng mạnh từ 20% → 80%
  • vượt tất cả vào cuối kỳ

→ strongest growth

BODY 2
Reading:
  • 30 → 40 → giảm mạnh xuống 20 (2000)
  • sau đó tăng mạnh lên 60 (2010)

→ highly fluctuating

Theatre:
  • giảm từ 50 → 30 (1990)
  • tăng lại dần lên \~45 (2010)

→ decline then recovery

Online:
  • rất thấp ban đầu (5%)
  • tăng nhẹ → tăng mạnh cuối kỳ (50%)

→ late but rapid growth

5\. Từ vựng ăn điểm
Trend:
  • rise sharply
  • fluctuate significantly
  • decline slightly
  • recover gradually
  • overtake
Structure:
  • remained the most popular activity
  • saw the most dramatic increase
  • experienced considerable fluctuations
  • ended the period at

The line graph compares the percentages of elderly people in the US who engaged in five different leisure activities—reading, theatre, online activities, hiking, and watching TV—between 1980 and 2010\.

Overall, watching TV remained one of the most popular activities throughout the period, although it declined slightly at the end. Hiking and online activities showed the most significant increases, while theatre attendance fluctuated moderately. Reading, by contrast, experienced notable variation before ending at a relatively high level.

In 1980, watching TV was the dominant activity at around 60%, followed by theatre at 50%. Reading accounted for 30%, while hiking and online activities were much less common at 20% and 5% respectively. By 1990, reading and hiking had both risen to 40%, while TV viewing increased to 65%. Theatre participation dropped sharply to 30%, and online activity remained low at 10%.

In 2000, TV peaked at approximately 70%, whereas hiking climbed to 60%. Theatre attendance recovered to 40%, but reading declined significantly to 20%. Online activity grew modestly to about 15%. By 2010, hiking became the most popular activity at 80%, while reading rebounded sharply to 60%. Online participation rose dramatically to 50%, overtaking theatre, which increased slightly to 45%. Meanwhile, TV viewing declined to around 65%.

Theatre: 1980: 50%; 1990: 30%; 2000: 40%; 2010: 45%

* Hiking showed a consistent and significant increase, becoming the most popular activity by 2010.
* Online activity experienced the most dramatic growth, especially between 2000 and 2010.
* Reading fluctuated, decreasing between 1990 and 2000, then sharply increasing by 2010.
* Theatre activity generally declined from 1980 to 1990, then saw a gradual increase.
* Hiking and Online activities showed strong upward trends, while Watching TV remained high but stable or slightly decreasing.

title: Bar Chart: The expenditure on three categories among different age groups of residents in the...
description: The chart below shows the expenditure on three categories among different age groups of residents in the UK in 2004. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Expenditure by age groups (UK, 2004)

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ chi tiêu cho 3 hạng mục: Food; Housing; Transport, ở 4 nhóm tuổi: Under 30; 30–49; 50–64; 65+ tại UK năm 2004

Dạng này: so sánh giữa các nhóm (không có yếu tố thời gian) nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase với:

  • the proportion of expenditure
  • three categories
  • different age groups in the UK

3. Cách viết Overview

  • Housing chiếm tỷ lệ cao nhất ở tất cả các nhóm
  • Food tăng dần theo độ tuổi
  • Transport khá ổn định, dao động nhẹ
  • Người trẻ chi nhiều cho Housing hơn người già

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Under 30 & 30–49

  • Under 30: Housing 38% (cao nhất); Food 12% (thấp nhất); Transport 15%
  • 30–49: Housing 34%; Food 16%; Transport 20% (cao nhất trong 3 nhóm transport)

→ Housing giảm nhẹ theo tuổi, Food & Transport tăng

BODY 2 – 50–64 & 65+

  • 50–64: Housing 28%; Food 18%; Transport 18%
  • 65+: Housing 25%; Food 22% (cao nhất); Transport 15%

→ Food tăng rõ khi về già; Housing tiếp tục giảm

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • the proportion of spending
  • accounted for the largest share
  • increased with age
  • remained relatively stable
  • saw a slight decline

Ví dụ:

Spending on food increased steadily with age, reaching 22% among those aged 65 and over.

The bar chart compares how residents in the UK allocated their spending on food, housing and transport across four age groups in 2004.

Overall, housing accounted for the largest share of expenditure in all age groups, although its proportion declined with age. In contrast, spending on food increased steadily among older people, while transport remained relatively stable with minor fluctuations.

Among those under 30, housing dominated at 38%, followed by transport at 15% and food at 12%. A similar pattern is seen in the 30–49 group, where housing made up 34%, while transport and food accounted for 20% and 16%, respectively.

For older groups, the share of housing expenditure decreased to 28% for those aged 50–64 and further to 25% among those aged 65 and over. Meanwhile, food spending rose gradually from 18% to 22% across these two groups. Transport expenditure remained unchanged at 18% for the 50–64 group before dropping slightly to 15% in the oldest category.

title: Bar Chart: The amount of money given to developing countries from five organizations from 200...

guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – International tourism spending (2011 vs 2012)

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng bar chart nhiều quốc gia \+ 2 năm theo cách gọn, dễ nhìn ra xu hướng nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy mức chi tiêu cho du lịch quốc tế (tỷ đô) của 7 quốc gia:

  • China
  • Germany
  • US
  • UK
  • Russia
  • France
  • Canada

trong năm 2011 và 2012.

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này cần:

  • so sánh giữa các quốc gia
  • nhận diện nước tăng/giảm
  • tìm nước cao nhất / thấp nhất

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề, giữ:

  • spending on international tourism
  • các quốc gia
  • 2 năm
  • đơn vị

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý overview:

  • Hầu hết các quốc gia tăng chi tiêu vào năm 2012
  • China có mức chi tiêu cao nhất và tăng mạnh nhất
  • Canada là nước chi tiêu thấp nhất trong cả hai năm

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm chi tiêu cao (China, Germany, US)
  • China:

\~72 → \~105 (tăng mạnh nhất, cao nhất)

  • Germany:

\~82 → \~79 (giảm nhẹ)

  • US:

\~77 → \~80 (tăng nhẹ)

TID chốt:

→ nhóm này luôn có mức chi tiêu cao nhất

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại (UK, Russia, France, Canada)
  • UK:

45 → 49 (tăng)

  • Russia:

27 → 40 (tăng đáng kể)

  • France:

40 → 37 (giảm nhẹ)

  • Canada:

18 → 19 (gần như không đổi, thấp nhất)

TID chốt:

→ phần lớn tăng, nhưng có Germany & France giảm nhẹ

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • tourism expenditure
  • rose significantly
  • experienced a slight decline
  • remained the lowest
  • recorded the highest figure

Ví dụ:

China recorded the highest tourism expenditure and saw a significant increase nha.

By contrast, spending in Germany and France experienced slight declines.

The bar chart compares international tourism expenditure in seven countries in 2011 and 2012, measured in billions of dollars.

Overall, spending increased in most countries, with China recording the most significant growth and becoming the largest spender in 2012. In contrast, Germany and France experienced slight declines, while Canada remained stable at the lowest level.

In 2011, Germany had the highest expenditure at around 82 billion dollars, followed by the US and China at approximately 77 and 72 billion respectively. By 2012, China’s spending rose sharply to about 105 billion, overtaking all other countries. The US and the UK also saw moderate increases, reaching roughly 80 and 49 billion.

Russia recorded a notable rise from around 27 to 40 billion dollars. Meanwhile, Germany’s spending decreased slightly to just under 80 billion, and France fell marginally from 40 to about 37 billion. Canada showed no significant change, remaining at approximately 19 billion in both years.

title: Bar Chart: The chart below compares the number of people per household in the UK in 1981 and ...
description: The chart below compares the number of people per household in the UK in 1981 and 2001. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Household size (1981 vs 2001)

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ hộ gia đình theo số người: 1-person; 2-person; 3-person; 4-person; 5-person; 6-person, ở hai năm 1981 và 2001

👉 Dạng này: so sánh giữa hai năm \+ phân bố (distribution) nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase với:

  • the proportion of households
  • by household size
  • in two different years

3. Cách viết Overview

  • Hộ ít người (1–2 người) tăng
  • Hộ đông người (4–6 người) giảm
  • Hộ 2 người luôn chiếm tỷ lệ cao nhất
  • Hộ 6 người thấp nhất và giảm mạnh

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm hộ nhỏ (1–3 người)

  • 1-person: 17% → 26% (tăng mạnh)
  • 2-person: 31% → 34% (cao nhất, tăng nhẹ)
  • 3-person: 20% → 17% (giảm nhẹ)

→ xu hướng chung: hộ nhỏ tăng, đặc biệt 1-person

BODY 2 – Nhóm hộ lớn (4–6 người)

  • 4-person: 18% → 15% (giảm)
  • 5-person: 8% → 6% (giảm)
  • 6-person: 6% → 2% (giảm mạnh nhất)

→ tất cả đều giảm, đặc biệt hộ rất đông

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • household size distribution
  • accounted for the largest proportion
  • increased significantly / declined steadily
  • made up a smaller share

Ví dụ:

One-person households increased significantly from 17% to 26%.

he bar chart compares the distribution of households by size in 1981 and 2001.

Overall, smaller households became more common over time, while larger households declined. In particular, one- and two-person households increased, whereas households with five or six members decreased noticeably.

In 1981, two-person households accounted for the largest share at 31%, followed by three-person households at 20%. One-person households made up 17%, while four-, five-, and six-person households represented 18%, 8%, and 6%, respectively.

By 2001, the proportion of one-person households had risen significantly to 26%, and two-person households also increased slightly to 34%, remaining the most common type. In contrast, three-person households fell to 17%, and four-person households declined to 15%.

The most notable decreases were seen in larger households. Five-person households dropped from 8% to 6%, while six-person households fell sharply from 6% to just 2%.

title: Bar Chart: The results of a survey conducted by a personnel department at a major company
description: The bar chart below shows the results of a survey conducted by a personnel department at a major company. The survey was carried out on two groups of workers: those aged from 18-30 and those aged 45-60, and shows factors affecting their work performance. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Factors affecting work performance

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ so sánh mức độ ảnh hưởng của các yếu tố đến hiệu suất làm việc giữa hai nhóm tuổi: 18–30; 45–60

Dạng này: so sánh giữa 2 nhóm \+ ranking (mức độ quan trọng)

2. Introduction

Paraphrase:

The bar chart compares how different factors influence work performance among two age groups, namely younger (18–30) and older employees (45–60).

3. Overview

  • Người trẻ (18–30) coi trọng development \+ môi trường hơn
  • Người lớn tuổi (45–60) ưu tiên stability \+ relationships
  • Money quan trọng với cả hai nhóm
  • Một số yếu tố có sự khác biệt rõ (development, relaxed environment, respect)

4. Body 1 – Nhóm người trẻ (18–30)

  • Chance for personal development: cao nhất (\~90%)
  • Relaxed working environment: \~75%
  • Promotion prospects: \~70%
  • Money: \~70%
  • Team spirit: \~60%
  • Thấp hơn:
  • Work environment (\~25%)
  • Job security (\~40%)

→ xu hướng: ưu tiên growth \+ môi trường làm việc

5. Body 2 – Nhóm lớn tuổi (45–60)

  • Money: cao (\~65%)
  • Promotion prospects / team spirit / respect: \~50–55%
  • Competent boss: \~50%
  • Thấp hơn rõ:
  • Chance for personal development (\~35%)
  • Relaxed environment (\~30%)

→ xu hướng: ưu tiên ổn định, mối quan hệ, quản lý

The bar chart compares factors affecting work performance among two age groups (18–30 and 45–60).

Overall, younger workers prioritise career development and working conditions, while older employees value stability and relationships more. Money is important for both groups.

For the 18–30 group, the most significant factor is personal development (about 90%), followed by a relaxed environment and promotion prospects (around 70–75%). In contrast, job security and respect are less important.

For those aged 45–60, money ranks highest (around 65%), along with team spirit and respect (just over 50%). However, personal development and working environment are less valued compared to younger workers.

title: Bar Chart: The proportion of the population aged 65 and over of three countries in 1980 and 2...
description: The bar chart below shows the proportion of the population aged 65 and over of three countries in 1980 and 2000 and prediction in 2030. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make a comparison where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Population aged 65+ (1980–2030)

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ dân số từ 65 tuổi trở lên ở 3 quốc gia: Canada; Germany; UK, qua 3 năm: 1980; 2000; 2030

Dạng này: xu hướng theo thời gian \+ so sánh giữa các nước nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase với:

  • percentage of elderly population
  • three countries
  • three time points

3. Cách viết Overview

  • Tất cả các nước đều tăng theo thời gian
  • Germany luôn cao nhất
  • Canada tăng mạnh nhất
  • UK tăng chậm hơn và thấp hơn hai nước còn lại

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – 1980 → 2000

  • Canada: 10 → 15 (tăng đều)
  • Germany: 15 → 20 (cao nhất, tăng rõ)
  • UK: 14 → 15 (tăng nhẹ)

→ Germany dẫn đầu, UK gần như ổn định

BODY 2 – 2000 → 2030

  • Canada: 15 → 22 (tăng mạnh)
  • Germany: 20 → 25 (vẫn cao nhất)
  • UK: 15 → 19 (tăng nhưng thấp hơn)

→ khoảng cách giữa Germany và các nước khác vẫn giữ

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • the proportion of people aged 65 and over
  • increased steadily
  • saw a significant rise
  • remained the highest
  • grew more slowly

Ví dụ:

The proportion of elderly people in Canada increased significantly from 10% to 22%.

The bar chart compares the proportion of people aged 65 and over in Canada, Germany and the UK in 1980 and 2000, with projections for 2030.

Overall, all three countries experienced, or are expected to experience, an increase in the elderly population. Germany consistently recorded the highest percentages, while Canada had the lowest figures throughout.

In 1980, the proportion of older people was 15% in Germany, compared to 14% in the UK and 10% in Canada. By 2000, these figures had risen in all countries, with Germany reaching 20%, while both Canada and the UK stood at 15%.

The upward trend is predicted to continue by 2030. Germany is expected to reach 25%, maintaining its position as the country with the largest elderly population. Canada is projected to increase significantly to 22%, while the UK is anticipated to rise more moderately to 19%.
