title: Bar Chart: The amount of money invested in each category from five organisations
description: The bar chart below shows the amount of money invested in each category from five organisations. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Investment by Organisations

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy số tiền (tỷ euro) được 5 tổ chức đầu tư vào 4 hạng mục:

  • machinery
  • building
  • staff training
  • research

Dạng này cần:

  • so sánh giữa các tổ chức
  • so sánh giữa các hạng mục nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề, giữ:

  • amount of money invested
  • 5 organisations
  • 4 categories

→ viết 1 câu là đủ nha

3. Cách viết Overview

  • Organisation B đầu tư nhiều nhất tổng thể
  • Building và research thường là hạng mục cao
  • Staff training nhìn chung thấp hơn các hạng mục khác

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Organisation có mức đầu tư cao

(Organisation B & A)

  • Organisation B:
  • cao nhất ở hầu hết hạng mục
  • đặc biệt staff training (1.9) và research (1.6)
  • Organisation A:
  • building cao nhất (1.5)
  • các hạng mục còn lại ở mức trung bình

→ đây là 2 tổ chức chi mạnh nhất nha

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại

(Organisation C, D, E)

  • Organisation C:
  • research cao nhất (1.3)
  • staff training thấp nhất (0.8)
  • Organisation D:
  • đầu tư thấp nhất overall
  • research thấp nhất (0.6)
  • Organisation E:
  • mức đầu tư trung bình
  • building cao nhất (1.0)

→ nhóm này thấp hơn và khá đồng đều nha

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • the amount of money allocated to
  • investment in
  • spent on
  • highest / lowest figures
  • comparatively lower / higher

The bar chart compares how much five organisations invested in four categories: machinery, buildings, staff training, and research, measured in billions of euros.

Overall, Organisation B invested the most across most categories, particularly in staff training and research, while Organisation D consistently spent the least. Buildings attracted relatively high investment across several organisations, whereas machinery and research showed more variation.

Looking at Organisation A, the largest share went to buildings (1.5 billion euros), followed by staff training (1.2) and research (1.1), while machinery received the least (1.0). A similar pattern can be seen in Organisation E, where buildings were also the top category (1.0), and research the lowest (0.7).

Organisation B stood out as the biggest investor overall. It allocated 1.9 billion euros to staff training, the highest single figure on the chart, along with 1.6 for research and 1.4 for buildings. Machinery was slightly lower at 0.9.

In contrast, Organisation D recorded the lowest spending levels in most areas, with 0.6 billion euros for research and 0.7 for staff training. Its investment in machinery (0.9) and buildings (1.0) was modest compared to others.

Organisation C showed a different pattern, prioritising research (1.3) and machinery (1.3), while spending less on staff training (0.8) and buildings (1.0).

UNITS/AXES: Y-axis: Billion Euros, X-axis: Organisation A, Organisation B, Organisation C, Organisation D, Organisation E
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Machinery, Building, Staff Training, Research
DATA:
Organisation A - Machinery: 1.0, Building: 1.5, Staff Training: 1.2, Research: 1.1
Organisation B - Machinery: 0.9, Building: 1.4, Staff Training: 1.9, Research: 1.6
Organisation C - Machinery: 1.3, Building: 1.0, Staff Training: 0.8, Research: 1.3
Organisation D - Machinery: 0.9, Building: 1.0, Staff Training: 0.7, Research: 0.6
Organisation E - Machinery: 0.8, Building: 1.0, Staff Training: 0.9, Research: 0.7
KEY FEATURES:
* Organisation B invested the most in Staff Training (1.9 Billion Euros) and Research (1.6 Billion Euros).
* Organisation A invested the most in Building (1.5 Billion Euros).
* Organisation C invested the most in Machinery (1.3 Billion Euros), tied with Research (1.3 Billion Euros).
* Organisation D had the lowest investment in Research (0.6 Billion Euros).
* Organisation E had the lowest investment in Machinery (0.8 Billion Euros).
* Building investment was consistently around 1.0 Billion Euros for Organisations C, D, and E.

title: Bar Chart: The amount of energy generated from wind in four countries from 1985 to 2000
description: The chart below shows the amount of energy generated from wind in four countries from 1985 to 2000. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Wind energy in four countries (1985–2000)

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy lượng điện năng từ gió (megawatts) ở 4 quốc gia:

  • India
  • Denmark
  • Germany
  • USA

qua 4 mốc thời gian: 1985, 1990, 1995, 2000

Dạng này là:

  • thay đổi theo thời gian
  • so sánh giữa các quốc gia nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề, giữ:

  • amount of energy generated
  • wind
  • four countries
  • 1985–2000

3. Cách viết Overview

  • Tất cả các nước đều tăng theo thời gian
  • USA luôn cao nhất, nhưng giảm nhẹ vào cuối kỳ
  • Denmark và India tăng mạnh nhất

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm tăng mạnh

(India & Denmark)

  • India:

200 → 400 → 800 → 1200

→ tăng đều và khá nhanh

  • Denmark:

250 → 450 → 1200 → 1650

→ tăng rất mạnh, đặc biệt sau 1990

→ đây là 2 nước tăng rõ nhất nha

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại

(Germany & USA)

  • Germany:

400 → 650 → 800 → 900

→ tăng ổn định nhưng chậm hơn

  • USA:

1200 → 1650 → 1600 → 1500

→ cao nhất toàn bài nhưng giảm nhẹ sau 1990

→ USA luôn dẫn đầu, nhưng không tăng liên tục nha

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • the amount of energy produced
  • rose significantly / steadily
  • reached a peak at
  • declined slightly
  • remained the highest

The bar chart compares the amount of wind-generated energy (in megawatts) in India, Denmark, Germany and the United States between 1985 and 2000.

Overall, all four countries experienced substantial growth in wind energy production over the period. The United States consistently produced the highest amounts until 1995, while Denmark overtook all others by 2000. India showed the fastest proportional increase, although it remained below Denmark and the US at the end.

In 1985, the United States led by a wide margin at 1,200 megawatts, followed by Germany (400 MW), Denmark (250 MW) and India (200 MW). By 1990, output had risen in all countries, with the US increasing to 1,650 MW, Germany to 650 MW, Denmark to 450 MW, and India doubling to 400 MW.

Growth continued in 1995, when the US remained dominant at 1,600 MW, while Denmark reached 1,200 MW and India climbed to 800 MW, overtaking Germany (800 MW), which showed more moderate growth.

By 2000, Denmark became the leading producer at 1,650 MW, surpassing the United States, whose output slightly declined to 1,500 MW. India continued its strong upward trend to 1,200 MW, while Germany rose more gradually to 900 MW.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: The bar chart shows the amount of energy generated by wind in four countries from 1985 to 2000
UNITS/AXES: Energy generated in megawatts (Y-axis), Years (X-axis: 1985, 1990, 1995, 2000)
SERIES/CATEGORIES: India, Denmark, Germany, United States
DATA:
India: 1985: 200, 1990: 400, 1995: 800, 2000: 1200
Denmark: 1985: 250, 1990: 450, 1995: 1200, 2000: 1650
Germany: 1985: 400, 1990: 650, 1995: 800, 2000: 900
United States: 1985: 1200, 1990: 1650, 1995: 1600, 2000: 1500
KEY FEATURES:
* The United States consistently generated the highest amount of wind energy in 1985, 1990, and 1995, but Denmark surpassed it in 2000.
* Denmark showed the most significant increase in wind energy generation over the period, from 250 megawatts in 1985 to 1650 megawatts in 2000.
* India and Germany also experienced steady growth in wind energy generation, with India's output quadrupling and Germany's more than doubling.
* The United States' wind energy generation peaked in 1990 at 1650 megawatts and then slightly decreased by 2000.
* In 2000, Denmark had the highest wind energy generation at 1650 megawatts, while India had the lowest at 1200 megawatts among the four countries.

title: Bar Chart: The percentage of adults of different age groups in the UK who used the Internet e...
description: The chart below shows the percentage of adults of different age groups in the UK who used the Internet every day from 2003–2006. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Fruit & Vegetable Intake in the UK

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng bar chart theo thời gian này sao cho rõ ràng, dễ viết và không bị lan man nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ người ở Anh ăn đủ trái cây và rau theo khuyến nghị, chia theo 3 nhóm:

  • Men
  • Women
  • Children

qua 3 năm: 2002, 2006 và 2010.

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này là time \+ group comparison, nên bạn cần:

  • so sánh giữa các nhóm
  • theo dõi sự thay đổi theo thời gian

2. Cách viết Introduction

Bạn chỉ cần paraphrase đề bài thôi nha.

Giữ đủ:

  • tỷ lệ tiêu thụ trái cây và rau
  • 3 nhóm đối tượng
  • 3 mốc thời gian

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý bạn các ý chính:

  • Women luôn có tỷ lệ cao nhất, trong khi Children thấp nhất
  • Tất cả các nhóm đều tăng từ 2002 đến 2006, sau đó giảm nhẹ vào 2010
  • 2006 là năm đạt đỉnh cho cả ba nhóm

Chỉ cần 2–3 câu như vậy là đủ nha.

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Women & Men
  • Women:

Luôn cao nhất

24.5 → 32 → 27

  • Men:

Thấp hơn women nhưng cùng xu hướng

22 → 28 → 24

TID gợi ý:

Bạn nên highlight là hai nhóm này có xu hướng giống nhau nha.

BODY 2 – Children
  • Children:

Luôn thấp nhất

11 → 16 → 13.5

  • Xu hướng:

Tăng đến 2006 rồi giảm

TID lưu ý:

Bạn có thể thêm là khoảng cách giữa children và adults vẫn khá lớn nha.

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

TID gợi ý bạn một số cách diễn đạt:

  • proportion / percentage
  • consume / intake
  • meet the recommended amount
  • peaked at / declined slightly

Ví dụ:

The proportion of women meeting the recommended intake was consistently the highest across the period nha.

All groups peaked in 2006 before experiencing a slight decline in 2010.

The bar chart compares the proportions of men, women and children in the UK who consumed fruit and vegetables in 2002, 2006 and 2010.

Overall, women consistently recorded the highest intake, while children had the lowest figures throughout. All three groups saw an increase from 2002 to 2006, followed by a slight decline in 2010, although levels remained above those at the beginning of the period.

In 2002, 24.5 percent of women met the intake level, compared to 22 percent of men and only 11 percent of children. By 2006, consumption rose across all groups, reaching a peak of 32 percent for women, 28 percent for men and 16 percent for children.

However, in 2010, the proportions fell moderately. Women declined to 27 percent and men to 24 percent, while children dropped to 13.5 percent. Despite this decrease, each group maintained higher levels than in 2002, indicating an overall improvement over the period.

* The 65+ age group had the lowest internet usage across all years, with only a slight increase from 18% to 20%.

* The 25-44 and 45-54 age groups showed significant growth, with the 25-44 group increasing from 50% to 80% and the 45-54 group from 60% to 80%.
* The largest percentage point increase was observed in the 25-44 age group (30 percentage points) and the 55-64 age group (20 percentage points).

title: Bar Chart: The chart below gives information about the age of women in Australia when they ga...
description: The chart below gives information about the age of women in Australia when they gave birth to their first child in 1966, 1986, and 2006. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Internet use by age group

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng bar chart so sánh 2 nhóm tuổi across countries sao cho rõ ràng và dễ viết nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ so sánh tỷ lệ sử dụng Internet của 2 nhóm tuổi:

  • 55–64
  • 25–34

ở 6 quốc gia:

Germany, USA, Russia, South Korea, Brazil, China

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này cần:

  • so sánh giữa 2 nhóm tuổi
  • so sánh giữa các quốc gia
  • tìm pattern chung

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề bài, giữ đủ:

  • tỷ lệ (%)
  • 2 nhóm tuổi
  • các quốc gia

Viết gọn là được nha.

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý bạn các ý chính:

  • Nhóm 25–34 luôn có tỷ lệ cao hơn nhóm 55–64 ở hầu hết các quốc gia
  • South Korea và Germany có tỷ lệ cao nhất ở nhóm trẻ
  • China và Brazil có mức thấp nhất ở cả hai nhóm

Bạn cũng có thể thêm:

Khoảng cách giữa hai nhóm tuổi đặc biệt lớn ở South Korea

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm cao (Germany, USA, South Korea)
  • Germany:

\~85% (55–64) vs \~95% (25–34)

  • USA:

\~90% vs \~82%

(đây là nước hiếm hoi nhóm lớn tuổi cao hơn nha)

  • South Korea:

\~40% vs \~98%

(chênh lệch rất lớn)

TID gợi ý:

Bạn nên highlight South Korea vì gap rất rõ nha.

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại (Russia, Brazil, China)
  • Russia:

\~70% vs \~85%

  • Brazil:

\~25% vs \~55%

  • China:

\~15% vs \~22%

TID lưu ý:

Các nước này đều có mức thấp hơn và vẫn giữ pattern “trẻ cao hơn già” nha.

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

TID gợi ý bạn một số cách diễn đạt:

  • age group
  • proportion / percentage
  • internet users
  • higher than / lower than
  • gap / difference

Ví dụ:

Younger adults generally had higher rates of Internet use than older people across most countries nha.

The largest gap was observed in South Korea, where usage among younger people was significantly higher.

The bar chart compares the percentages of people in two age groups, 25–34 and 55–64, across six countries.

Overall, younger adults recorded higher proportions than older people in most countries, with the largest gap observed in South Korea. The USA is the only country where the older group slightly exceeded the younger group.

Germany and the USA showed the highest figures overall. In Germany, about 90 percent of those aged 25–34 were represented, compared to roughly 85 percent among 55–64 year olds. A similar pattern is seen in Russia, where the younger group stood at around 85 percent, exceeding the older group at approximately 70 percent. In contrast, the USA showed the reverse trend, with about 90 percent for older people compared to around 82 percent for younger adults.

The most pronounced difference appears in South Korea, where nearly 100 percent of the younger group was recorded, while the figure for the older group was only about 40 percent. Brazil and China had considerably lower levels overall, although the same pattern persisted, with younger people outnumbering older individuals, at roughly 55 versus 25 percent in Brazil and around 22 versus 15 percent in China.

title: Bar Chart: The percentage of government spending on roads and transport in 4 countries in the...
description: The bar chart below shows the percentage of government spending on roads and transport in 4 countries in the years 1990, 1995, 2000, 2005. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – World Population Distribution

TID sẽ giúp bạn xử lý dạng bar chart theo thời gian này sao cho gọn, dễ viết và không bị lặp ý nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ dân số thế giới sống ở 4 quốc gia (India, China, USA, Japan) vào 3 năm: 1950, 2002 và dự đoán 2050.

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này là time \+ comparison, nên bạn cần:

  • nhìn xu hướng theo thời gian
  • so sánh giữa các quốc gia

Không cần viết hết số, chỉ chọn số tiêu biểu thôi nha.

2. Cách viết Introduction

Bạn chỉ cần paraphrase đề bài thôi nha.

Giữ đủ:

  • tỷ lệ dân số thế giới
  • 4 quốc gia
  • 3 mốc thời gian

Viết ngắn gọn là đủ.

3. Cách viết Overview

TID sẽ giúp bạn chọn ý “ăn điểm” nha:

  • China có tỷ lệ cao nhất ở đầu kỳ nhưng giảm mạnh theo thời gian
  • India tăng đều và dự kiến vượt China vào 2050
  • USA và Japan chiếm tỷ lệ nhỏ và nhìn chung giảm

Chỉ cần 2–3 câu như vậy là đủ overview rồi nha.

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – India & China (2 nước chính)
  • India:

Tăng đều qua các năm

15% (1950) → 17% (2002) → 19% (2050)

  • China:

Giảm rõ rệt

23% (1950) → 20% (2002) → 15% (2050)

TID gợi ý:

Bạn nên nhấn mạnh việc India sẽ vượt China ở cuối kỳ nha.

BODY 2 – USA & Japan (nhóm nhỏ)
  • USA:

Giảm nhẹ

7% → 5% → 5%

  • Japan:

Giảm mạnh hơn

4% → 3% → 1%

TID lưu ý:

Japan là nước có tỷ lệ thấp nhất vào 2050, đây là detail khá hay để thêm vào.

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

TID gợi ý bạn vài cách viết để tránh lặp từ nha:

  • percentage / proportion / share
  • accounted for / made up / represented
  • is expected to / is projected to

Ví dụ:

China accounted for the largest share of the global population in 1950, but this figure is expected to decline significantly by 2050.

India, by contrast, is projected to increase steadily and become the most populous country in terms of global share nha.

—-----------------------\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_-

The bar chart compares the proportions of the world’s population living in India, China, the USA and Japan in 1950 and 2002, with projections for 2050.

Overall, China had the largest share in the earlier years but is expected to decline significantly, while India shows a steady increase and is projected to become the largest contributor by 2050. In contrast, the USA and Japan account for relatively small proportions and both are predicted to decrease over time.

In 1950, China represented the highest percentage at 23 percent, followed by India at 15 percent. By 2002, China’s share had fallen to 20 percent, whereas India’s rose to 17 percent. This trend is expected to continue, with India reaching 19 percent in 2050, overtaking China, which is forecast to drop sharply to 15 percent.

The USA experienced a modest decline from 7 percent in 1950 to 5 percent in 2002, and this figure is projected to remain stable at 5 percent in 2050. Japan, meanwhile, shows the most pronounced reduction, decreasing from 4 percent to 3 percent and is expected to fall further to just 1 percent by 2050.

KEY FEATURES:
* Portugal consistently had the highest percentage of government spending on roads and transport across all years.
* The UK generally had the lowest percentage of spending, particularly in 2000 and 2005.
* Italy and Portugal showed a general downward trend in spending percentage from 1990 to 2005.
* The USA's spending percentage remained relatively stable, fluctuating between 12% and 14%.
* The largest decrease in spending occurred in Portugal from 1990 (27%) to 2005 (16%).
* The UK experienced a significant drop in spending from 1995 (13%) to 2000 (7%).

title: Bar Chart: The graph shows Internet usage in Taiwan by Age Group, 1998-2000
description: The graph shows Internet usage in Taiwan by Age Group, 1998-2000. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Percentage of adults by age group (1998–2000)

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ người theo 4 nhóm tuổi: \<15; 16–30; 31–50; 50+, qua 3 năm: 1998, 1999, 2000

Dạng này: nhiều năm \+ nhiều nhóm → so sánh song song nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề, giữ:

  • percentage
  • age groups
  • 3 năm

3. Cách viết Overview

  • Nhóm 16–30 luôn cao nhất
  • Nhóm dưới 15 và 50+ luôn thấp nhất
  • Nhìn chung, các nhóm lớn tuổi hơn tăng nhẹ theo thời gian

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm chính (dominant)

  • 16–30:

53 → 45 → 44

→ cao nhất nhưng giảm nhẹ

  • 31–50:

41 → 39 → 37

→ giảm dần, đứng thứ hai

→ đây là 2 nhóm chiếm tỷ lệ lớn nha

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại

  • \<15:

2 → 8 → 9

→ tăng rõ nhưng vẫn thấp

  • 50+:

4 → 8 → 10

→ tăng đều

→ nhóm thấp nhưng có xu hướng tăng nha

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • the proportion of people
  • accounted for the largest share
  • declined slightly
  • increased steadily
  • remained relatively low

The bar chart compares the proportions of people in four age groups—under 15, 16–30, 31–50, and 50+—over the period from 1998 to 2000.

Overall, individuals aged 16–30 consistently accounted for the largest share, although their proportion declined over time. In contrast, the other three groups all experienced gradual increases, particularly the youngest and oldest cohorts.

In 1998, the 16–30 group made up 53%, the highest figure on the chart. This was followed by those aged 31–50 at 41%, while the under-15 and 50+ groups were much smaller, at 2% and 4% respectively. By 1999, the proportion of 16–30-year-olds had fallen to 45%, and it decreased slightly further to 44% in 2000.

Meanwhile, the 31–50 group saw a modest decline from 41% in 1998 to 39% in 1999 and 37% in 2000. In contrast, the youngest group rose markedly from 2% to 8%, then to 9% by 2000. A similar upward trend was observed among those aged 50 and above, increasing steadily from 4% to 8% and then 10%.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: Percentage of adults by age group from 1998 to 2000
UNITS/AXES: Percentage (%), Years (1998, 1999, 2000)
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Less than 15, 16-30 years, 31-50 years, 50 or more
DATA:
Less than 15: 1998: 2%, 1999: 8%, 2000: 9%
16-30 years: 1998: 53%, 1999: 45%, 2000: 44%
31-50 years: 1998: 41%, 1999: 39%, 2000: 37%
50 or more: 1998: 4%, 1999: 8%, 2000: 10%
KEY FEATURES:
* The 16-30 years age group consistently had the highest percentage across all three years.
* The "Less than 15" age group had the lowest percentage in 1998.
* The "50 or more" age group had the lowest percentage in 1998.
* The percentage of adults aged 16-30 years and 31-50 years showed a decreasing trend.
* The percentage of adults aged "Less than 15" and "50 or more" showed an increasing trend.
* The "Less than 15" and "50 or more" age groups had the same percentage in 1999 (8%).

title: Bar Chart: The percentage of households with cars in a European country between 1971 and 2001
description: The bar chart shows the percentage of households with cars in a European country between 1971 and 2001. Summarise the information by selecting reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Car ownership (1971–2001)

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ hộ gia đình theo số lượng xe: no car; 1 car; 2+ cars, qua 4 năm: 1971, 1981, 1991, 2001

Dạng này: xu hướng theo thời gian \+ phân bố nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề, giữ:

  • percentage of households
  • number of cars
  • 1971–2001

3. Cách viết Overview

  • Số hộ có xe tăng rõ rệt theo thời gian
  • “No car” giảm liên tục
  • “1 car” trở thành nhóm phổ biến nhất
  • “2+ cars” tăng dần

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Xu hướng chính

  • No car:

45 → 40 → 35 → 25

→ giảm đều

  • 1 car:

35 → 43 → 38 → 52

→ tăng và trở thành cao nhất năm 2001

→ chuyển từ không có xe → có 1 xe nha

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại

  • 2+ cars:

25 → 35 → 25 → 38

→ tăng overall nhưng có dao động

→ sở hữu nhiều xe ngày càng phổ biến hơn nha

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • the proportion of households owning
  • increased steadily
  • declined gradually
  • became the dominant category
  • showed some fluctuation

The bar chart illustrates the proportions of households owning no car, one car, or more than two cars in a European country between 1971 and 2001.

Overall, car ownership increased over the period. The percentage of households without a car declined steadily, while ownership of one car became the dominant category. Households with multiple cars also grew, though more moderately.

In 1971, the largest group consisted of households with no car at 45%, compared to 35% owning one car and 25% having more than two cars. By 1981, one-car households had overtaken the others, rising to 43%, while those without a car fell to 40%. The figure for multiple-car ownership also increased to 35%.

This trend continued in 1991, with one-car households climbing slightly to 38%, while the proportion without a car declined further to 35%. The percentage of households owning more than two cars dropped back to 25%, indicating a temporary fluctuation.

By 2001, the shift was more pronounced. A majority of households owned one car (52%), while those without a car decreased significantly to 25%. Meanwhile, households with more than two cars rose to 38%, reaching their highest level.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: The percentage of households with cars in a European country between 1971 and 2001

SERIES/CATEGORIES: NO CAR, 1 CAR, MORE THAN 2 CARS
DATA:
NO CAR: 1971: 45%, 1981: 40%, 1991: 35%, 2001: 25%
1 CAR: 1971: 35%, 1981: 43%, 1991: 38%, 2001: 52%
MORE THAN 2 CARS: 1971: 25%, 1981: 35%, 1991: 25%, 2001: 38%
KEY FEATURES:
* The percentage of households with no car steadily decreased over the period.
* The percentage of households with one car generally increased, becoming the highest category by 2001.
* The percentage of households with more than two cars fluctuated, ending higher than its starting point.
* In 1971, "NO CAR" was the largest category, while in 2001, "1 CAR" was the largest.
* The largest increase was seen in households with one car, from 35% in 1971 to 52% in 2001.
* The largest decrease was in households with no car, from 45% in 1971 to 25% in 2001.

title: Bar Chart: The number of international applicants to the universities of one European country
description: The chart below shows the number of international applicants to the universities of one European country. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – International applicants (2004–2008)

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy số lượng sinh viên quốc tế từ 4 quốc gia: China; Japan; USA; Russia đăng ký vào các trường đại học ở một nước châu Âu, qua 5 năm: 2004–2008

Dạng này: xu hướng theo thời gian \+ so sánh giữa các quốc gia nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề, giữ:

  • number of applicants
  • four countries
  • 2004–2008

3. Cách viết Overview

  • USA và Japan tăng đều qua các năm
  • China giảm dần
  • Russia luôn thấp nhất và tăng nhẹ

Đến cuối kỳ, USA trở thành nhóm cao nhất nha

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm tăng

  • USA:

13,000 → 15,000 → 18,000 → 22,000 → 27,000

→ tăng mạnh và liên tục

  • Japan:

7,000 → 7,000 → 7,500 → 8,500 → 10,000

→ tăng nhẹ nhưng ổn định

  • Russia:

2,500 → 2,000 → 2,500 → 2,500 → 3,000

→ dao động nhẹ nhưng nhìn chung tăng

BODY 2 – Nhóm giảm

  • China:

27,000 → 22,000 → 18,000 → 18,000 → 15,500

→ giảm đáng kể theo thời gian

→ từ cao nhất ban đầu xuống thấp hơn USA vào cuối kỳ nha

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • the number of applicants
  • increased steadily
  • declined gradually
  • remained relatively stable
  • overtook

The bar chart shows the number of international applicants from China, Japan, the USA and Russia to universities in a European country between 2004 and 2008.

Overall, applications from the USA and Japan increased steadily over the period, while those from China declined. Russia remained the smallest contributor, with only slight growth.

In 2004, China had by far the highest number of applicants at 27,000, followed by the USA at 13,000. Japan accounted for 7,000, and Russia had the lowest figure at 2,500. However, Chinese applications fell consistently each year, dropping to 15,500 by 2008.

In contrast, the USA saw a strong upward trend, rising from 13,000 in 2004 to 27,000 in 2008, overtaking China to become the largest source of applicants. Japan also experienced gradual growth, increasing from 7,000 to 10,000 over the same period.

Russia showed only minor fluctuations, dipping slightly to 2,000 in 2005 before climbing to 3,000 in 2008.

China: 2004: 27,000; 2005: 22,000; 2006: 18,000; 2007: 18,000; 2008: 15,500

USA: 2004: 13,000; 2005: 15,000; 2006: 18,000; 2007: 22,000; 2008: 27,000

KEY FEATURES:
* China had the highest number of applicants in 2004 (27,000) and saw a general decline over the period.
* The USA experienced a steady increase in applicants, starting at 13,000 in 2004 and reaching the highest number in 2008 (27,000).
* Japan's applicant numbers showed a gradual increase from 7,000 in 2004 to 10,000 in 2008.
* Russia consistently had the lowest number of applicants throughout the period, fluctuating between 2,000 and 3,000.
* In 2006, China and USA had an equal number of applicants (18,000).
* By 2008, the USA became the country with the most applicants, matching China's 2004 peak.

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ rác thải được tái chế theo 4 loại: plastic; cans; paper; glass, qua 3 năm: 1992, 1997, 2002

Dạng này: xu hướng theo thời gian \+ so sánh giữa các loại nha

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề, giữ:

  • percentage of waste recycled
  • types of waste
  • 1992–2002

3. Cách viết Overview

  • Tất cả các loại rác đều tăng theo thời gian
  • Glass và paper có tỷ lệ cao nhất
  • Plastic luôn thấp nhất

4. Cách chia Body

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • the proportion of waste recycled
  • increased significantly
  • showed a sharp rise

The bar chart compares the proportions of four types of household waste—plastic, cans, paper and glass—recycled in 1992, 1997 and 2002.

Overall, recycling rates increased for most materials over the period, with glass and paper showing the most significant growth. Plastic remained the least recycled material throughout, while glass became the most recycled by 2002.

In 1992, recycling levels were relatively low across all categories. Glass and paper were recycled at 16% and 15% respectively, while cans accounted for 18%, the highest figure that year. Plastic had the lowest rate at just 10%.

By 1997, there were noticeable improvements. Paper recycling rose sharply to 32%, becoming the leading category, followed by glass at 26%. Cans, however, declined slightly to 14%, while plastic increased modestly to 12%.

In 2002, recycling rates climbed further. Glass saw the most dramatic rise, reaching 48%, the highest overall figure. Paper also increased to 38%, while cans rebounded significantly to 24%. In contrast, plastic remained unchanged at 12%, continuing to lag behind other materials.

title: Bar Chart: How frequently people in the USA ate in fast food restaurants between 2003 and 2013
description: The chart below shows how frequently people in the USA ate in fast food restaurants between 2003 and 2013. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and making comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Fast food frequency in the USA (2003–2013)

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng frequency chart (tần suất) theo nhiều năm – dạng này rất hay ra nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tần suất ăn fast food của người Mỹ qua 3 năm:

  • 2003
  • 2006
  • 2013

các mức độ gồm:

  • Every day
  • Several times a week
  • Once a week
  • Once or twice a month
  • A few times a year
  • Never

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này không chỉ là tăng/giảm, mà là phân bố thói quen.

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề, giữ:

  • frequency of eating fast food
  • USA
  • 3 năm

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý overview:

  • Phần lớn người ăn fast food ở mức trung bình (once a week / once or twice a month)
  • Tỷ lệ ăn hàng ngày và không bao giờ ăn luôn rất thấp
  • Xu hướng chuyển nhẹ từ ăn hàng tuần sang ăn theo tháng vào năm 2013

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm phổ biến (main habits)
  • Once a week:

31 → 33 → 27 (cao nhất, nhưng giảm về 2013)

  • Once or twice a month:

30 → 25 → 33 (tăng và trở thành cao nhất năm 2013)

TID chốt:

→ đây là 2 nhóm dominant

BODY 2 – Nhóm còn lại
  • Several times a week:

16 → 19 → 15 (tăng rồi giảm)

  • A few times a year:

12 → 14 → 14 (tăng nhẹ rồi ổn định)

  • Every day:

3 → 2 → 2 (rất thấp)

  • Never:

4 → 3 → 3 (cũng rất thấp)

TID chốt:

→ hai nhóm extreme (every day / never) luôn thấp

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • frequency
  • the majority of people
  • peaked at
  • declined slightly
  • remained low

Ví dụ:

The majority of people consumed fast food either once a week or once or twice a month nha.

The proportion eating fast food every day remained very low throughout the period.

The bar chart compares how frequently people in the USA ate at fast food restaurants in 2003, 2006 and 2013.

Overall, the most common eating habits were once a week and once or twice a month, while eating every day or never was consistently rare. Over time, there was a slight shift away from weekly visits towards monthly visits.

In 2003, the largest proportion of people ate fast food once a week (31%), followed closely by once or twice a month (30%). By 2006, weekly eating became even more dominant, rising to 33%, while monthly visits dropped to 25%. However, in 2013, this pattern reversed: once or twice a month became the most popular frequency at 33%, whereas once a week declined to 27%.

Less frequent habits showed smaller changes. The percentage of people eating fast food several times a week peaked at 19% in 2006 before falling to 15% in 2013. Those eating a few times a year increased gradually from 12% to 14%. Meanwhile, daily consumption remained very low (around 2–3%), and the proportion who never ate fast food stayed minimal at about 3–4% throughout the period.

* The most frequent eating habit across all years was "Once a week" or "Once or twice a month".
* "Every day" and "Never" categories consistently had the lowest percentages of people.
* The percentage of people eating "Once a week" decreased from 31% in 2003 to 27% in 2013, while "Once or twice a month" increased from 30% to 33% over the same period.
* The "Several times a week" category saw a peak in 2006 at 19% before dropping to 15% in 2013.
* The "A few times a year" category remained relatively stable, increasing slightly from 12% in 2003 to 14% in 2006 and 2013.

title: Bar Chart: The charts below show the number of people in Europe who were affected by four typ...
description: The charts below show the number of people in Europe who were affected by four types of noise by day and by night in cities and rural areas in 2007. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Noise pollution (City vs Rural, Day vs Night)

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng 2 charts \+ 2 variables (day/night \+ location) này sao cho không bị rối nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy số người (triệu người) bị ảnh hưởng bởi 4 loại ô nhiễm tiếng ồn:

  • Traffic
  • Train
  • Aircraft
  • Industry

ở khu vực city và rural, vào ban ngày và ban đêm.

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này có nhiều lớp:

  • city vs rural
  • day vs night
  • các loại nguồn tiếng ồn

→ bạn cần chọn lọc thông tin, không viết hết nha.

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề bài, giữ đủ:

  • số người bị ảnh hưởng
  • các loại tiếng ồn
  • city vs rural
  • day vs night

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý bạn các ý chính:

  • Traffic là nguồn gây ảnh hưởng lớn nhất ở mọi trường hợp
  • City luôn có số người bị ảnh hưởng cao hơn rural
  • Số liệu ban ngày cao hơn ban đêm
  • Industry là nguồn ít ảnh hưởng nhất

Chỉ cần 3–4 ý vậy là đủ rõ nha.

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – City
  • Traffic:

Cao nhất

64 (day) → 48 (night)

  • Train:

10 → 8

  • Aircraft:

4 → 1

  • Industry:

1 → 0.25

TID lưu ý:

Tất cả đều giảm vào ban đêm nha.

BODY 2 – Rural
  • Traffic:

34 → 24

  • Train:

8 → 6

  • Aircraft:

2 → 1

  • Industry:

0 → 0

TID gợi ý:

Bạn có thể highlight:

  • số liệu thấp hơn city rõ rệt
  • industry gần như không ảnh hưởng

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

TID gợi ý bạn một số cách diễn đạt:

  • be affected by
  • noise pollution / noise sources
  • figures / numbers
  • significantly higher / lower
  • accounted for

Ví dụ:

Traffic was the dominant source of noise pollution in both areas nha.

The number of people affected was consistently higher in cities than in rural areas.

The charts compare the number of people affected by four types of noise pollution during the day and at night in urban and rural areas, measured in millions.

Overall, traffic was by far the largest source of noise in both settings and at both times of day. Urban areas experienced significantly higher levels of noise exposure than rural areas, while the number of people affected was consistently lower at night.

In cities, 64 million people were affected by traffic noise during the day, falling to 48 million at night. Train noise impacted 10 million people by day and 8 million at night, while aircraft noise dropped from 4 million to just 1 million. Industrial noise was minimal, affecting only 1 million people during the day and 0.25 million at night.

A similar pattern is seen in rural areas, although at much lower levels. Traffic affected 34 million people during the day and 24 million at night. Train noise decreased from 8 to 6 million, and aircraft noise from 2 to 1 million. Notably, industrial noise had no impact in rural areas at either time.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: Number of people who were affected by four types of noise pollution in day and night in city (millions)
UNITS/AXES: Millions of people (y-axis), Traffic, Train, Aircraft, Industry (x-axis)
SERIES/CATEGORIES: City - Day, City - Night, Rural - Day, Rural - Night
DATA:
City - Day: Traffic 64, Train 10, Aircraft 4, Industry 1
City - Night: Traffic 48, Train 8, Aircraft 1, Industry 0.25
Rural - Day: Traffic 34, Train 8, Aircraft 2, Industry 0
Rural - Night: Traffic 24, Train 6, Aircraft 1, Industry 0
KEY FEATURES:
* Traffic noise affects the most people in both city and rural areas, during both day and night.
* In the city, day noise pollution from traffic affects 64 million people, which is the highest figure across all categories.
* Industry noise pollution affects the fewest people in both city and rural areas, with 0 people affected in rural areas during both day and night.
* For all types of noise pollution and in both city and rural areas, more people are affected during the day than at night.
* The number of people affected by noise pollution is consistently higher in the city compared to rural areas for all categories.
* Train noise affects a similar number of people in the city during the day (10 million) as in rural areas during the day (8 million) and night (6 million).

title: Bar Chart: The percentage of the world population in four countries in 1950 and 2002, and pro...

HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – World Population Distribution

TID sẽ giúp bạn xử lý dạng bar chart theo thời gian này sao cho gọn, dễ viết và không bị lặp ý nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ dân số thế giới sống ở 4 quốc gia (India, China, USA, Japan) vào 3 năm: 1950, 2002 và dự đoán 2050.

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này là time \+ comparison, nên bạn cần:

  • nhìn xu hướng theo thời gian
  • so sánh giữa các quốc gia

Không cần viết hết số, chỉ chọn số tiêu biểu thôi nha.

2. Cách viết Introduction

Bạn chỉ cần paraphrase đề bài thôi nha.

Giữ đủ:

  • tỷ lệ dân số thế giới
  • 4 quốc gia
  • 3 mốc thời gian

Viết ngắn gọn là đủ.

3. Cách viết Overview

TID sẽ giúp bạn chọn ý “ăn điểm” nha:

  • China có tỷ lệ cao nhất ở đầu kỳ nhưng giảm mạnh theo thời gian
  • India tăng đều và dự kiến vượt China vào 2050
  • USA và Japan chiếm tỷ lệ nhỏ và nhìn chung giảm

Chỉ cần 2–3 câu như vậy là đủ overview rồi nha.

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – India & China (2 nước chính)
  • India:

Tăng đều qua các năm

15% (1950) → 17% (2002) → 19% (2050)

  • China:

Giảm rõ rệt

23% (1950) → 20% (2002) → 15% (2050)

TID gợi ý:

Bạn nên nhấn mạnh việc India sẽ vượt China ở cuối kỳ nha.

BODY 2 – USA & Japan (nhóm nhỏ)
  • USA:

Giảm nhẹ

7% → 5% → 5%

  • Japan:

Giảm mạnh hơn

4% → 3% → 1%

TID lưu ý:

Japan là nước có tỷ lệ thấp nhất vào 2050, đây là detail khá hay để thêm vào.

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

TID gợi ý bạn vài cách viết để tránh lặp từ nha:

  • percentage / proportion / share
  • accounted for / made up / represented
  • is expected to / is projected to

Ví dụ:

China accounted for the largest share of the global population in 1950, but this figure is expected to decline significantly by 2050.

India, by contrast, is projected to increase steadily and become the most populous country in terms of global share nha.

—-----------------------\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_-

The bar chart compares the proportions of the world’s population living in India, China, the USA and Japan in 1950 and 2002, with projections for 2050.

Overall, China had the largest share in the earlier years but is expected to decline significantly, while India shows a steady increase and is projected to become the largest contributor by 2050. In contrast, the USA and Japan account for relatively small proportions and both are predicted to decrease over time.

In 1950, China represented the highest percentage at 23 percent, followed by India at 15 percent. By 2002, China’s share had fallen to 20 percent, whereas India’s rose to 17 percent. This trend is expected to continue, with India reaching 19 percent in 2050, overtaking China, which is forecast to drop sharply to 15 percent.

The USA experienced a modest decline from 7 percent in 1950 to 5 percent in 2002, and this figure is projected to remain stable at 5 percent in 2050. Japan, meanwhile, shows the most pronounced reduction, decreasing from 4 percent to 3 percent and is expected to fall further to just 1 percent by 2050.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: The percentage of the total world population
UNITS/AXES: Y-axis: Percentage of total world population (%), scale 0 to 25 in increments of 5. X-axis: Countries (India, China, USA, Japan). Years: 1950, 2002, 2050.
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Countries: India, China, USA, Japan. Years: 1950 (blue), 2002 (yellow), 2050 (green).
DATA:
India: 1950: 15, 2002: 17, 2050: 19
China: 1950: 23, 2002: 20, 2050: 15
USA: 1950: 7, 2002: 5, 2050: 5
Japan: 1950: 4, 2002: 3, 2050: 1
KEY FEATURES:
* China had the highest percentage of world population in 1950 (23%).
* Japan is projected to have the lowest percentage of world population in 2050 (1%).
* India's share of the world population is projected to increase steadily from 1950 to 2050.
* China's share of the world population is projected to decrease steadily from 1950 to 2050.
* The USA's share of the world population is projected to remain stable from 2002 to 2050.
* Japan's share of the world population is projected to decrease significantly over the entire period.

title: Bar Chart: The percentage of males and females with higher education qualifications in five c...
description: The chart below shows the percentage of males and females with higher education qualifications in five countries in 2001. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Visitors to five countries (by gender)

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng bar chart so sánh nam vs nữ across countries này sao cho gọn và rõ nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ du khách (nam và nữ) đến 5 quốc gia vào năm 2005:

  • Germany
  • Britain
  • Switzerland
  • United States
  • Japan

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này cần:

  • so sánh nam vs nữ
  • so sánh giữa các quốc gia
  • tìm điểm cao nhất và thấp nhất

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề bài, giữ đủ:

  • tỷ lệ du khách
  • nam và nữ
  • 5 quốc gia
  • năm 2005

Viết ngắn gọn là được nha.

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý bạn các ý chính:

  • Nam chiếm tỷ lệ cao hơn nữ ở hầu hết các quốc gia
  • Germany và Switzerland là những điểm đến phổ biến nhất
  • Japan có tỷ lệ thấp nhất cho cả hai giới

Bạn cũng có thể thêm:

USA là nước hiếm hoi nữ cao hơn nam

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm nam cao hơn
  • Germany:

Nam \~35%, nữ \~45% (ngoại lệ nha, nữ cao hơn)

  • Britain:

Nam \~35%, nữ \~30%

  • Switzerland:

Nam \~45%, nữ \~35%

  • Japan:

Nam \~30%, nữ \~25%

TID lưu ý:

Bạn có thể mention Switzerland là cao nhất ở nam nha.

BODY 2 – Nhóm đặc biệt / so sánh rõ
  • USA:

Nữ \~40%, nam \~35%

→ nữ cao hơn

TID gợi ý:

Bạn nên highlight USA và Germany vì có sự đảo chiều giữa nam và nữ nha.

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

TID gợi ý bạn một số cách diễn đạt:

  • visitors / tourists
  • proportion / percentage
  • male / female visitors
  • higher than / lower than
  • accounted for

Ví dụ:

Male visitors generally accounted for a higher proportion in most countries nha.

However, the opposite pattern was observed in the United States, where female visitors were more prevalent.

The chart compares the percentages of male and female visitors to five countries in 2005.

Overall, males accounted for a higher proportion of visitors in most countries, with the exception of Germany and the United States, where females predominated. Switzerland recorded the highest share of male visitors, while Germany had the highest proportion of females.

In detail, Germany attracted 45 percent female visitors compared to 35 percent males, the largest gender gap in favour of women. A similar but smaller pattern is seen in the United States, where females made up 40 percent, exceeding males at 35 percent. In contrast, Switzerland showed the opposite trend, with males accounting for 45 percent compared to 35 percent females, representing the widest gap favouring men.

Britain and Japan also had higher proportions of male visitors. In Britain, 35 percent of visitors were male compared to 30 percent female. Likewise, Japan recorded 30 percent males and 25 percent females, making it the country with the lowest overall visitor proportions among the five.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: Percentage of visitors to five countries: 2005
UNITS/AXES: Percentage (%) from 0 to 50 in increments of 5. Countries: Japan, United States, Switzerland, Britain, Germany.
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Females, Males
DATA:
Japan - Females: 25, Males: 30
United States - Females: 40, Males: 35
Switzerland - Females: 35, Males: 45
Britain - Females: 30, Males: 35
Germany - Females: 45, Males: 35
KEY FEATURES:
* The highest percentage of female visitors was to Germany (45%).
* The highest percentage of male visitors was to Switzerland (45%).
* Japan had the lowest percentage of female visitors (25%).
* Japan had the lowest percentage of male visitors (30%).
* In Japan and Britain, male visitors outnumbered female visitors.
* In the United States and Germany, female visitors outnumbered male visitors.

title: Bar Chart: The distribution of employment among agriculture, services, industries in three co...
description: The bar chart shows the distribution of employment among agriculture, services, industries in three countries in 1980 and 2020.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Employment by sector (3 countries, 1980 vs 2020)

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng 3 charts \+ cùng 1 structure (agriculture / industry / services) sao cho gọn và logic nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ lao động trong 3 ngành:

  • Agriculture
  • Industry
  • Services

ở 3 quốc gia (A, B, C) vào năm 1980 và 2020.

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này trọng tâm là:

  • sự chuyển dịch cơ cấu lao động
  • so sánh giữa các nước

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề bài, giữ đủ:

  • tỷ lệ lao động
  • 3 ngành
  • 3 quốc gia
  • 2 năm

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý version overview “chuẩn bài”:

  • Services tăng và trở thành ngành lớn nhất ở Country A và C
  • Agriculture giảm mạnh ở A và C, nhưng vẫn cao ở B
  • Country B có xu hướng ngược lại, với agriculture vẫn chiếm tỷ lệ lớn

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Country A & C (xu hướng giống nhau)

Country A:

  • Agriculture: 20 → 12 (giảm)
  • Industry: 30 → 28 (giảm nhẹ)
  • Services: 45 → 55 (tăng)

Country C:

  • Agriculture: 5 → 2 (giảm)
  • Industry: 35 → 25 (giảm)
  • Services: 65 → 80 (tăng mạnh)

TID chốt:

→ cả hai nước đều chuyển dịch sang services nha.

BODY 2 – Country B (ngoại lệ)
  • Agriculture: 55 → 48 (giảm nhưng vẫn cao)
  • Industry: 20 → 40 (tăng mạnh)
  • Services: 25 → 42 (tăng)

TID chốt:

→ Country B vẫn phụ thuộc vào agriculture nhiều hơn so với A và C

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • workforce / employment
  • sectors
  • shift towards
  • remained dominant
  • increased / decreased significantly

Ví dụ:

There was a clear shift towards the service sector in Countries A and C nha.

By contrast, agriculture remained the dominant sector in Country B despite a decline.

The charts compare the proportions of employment in agriculture, industry and services in three countries in 1980 and 2020.

Overall, all three countries experienced a decline in agricultural employment and a corresponding rise in the service sector. Industry showed mixed trends, decreasing in Countries A and C but increasing markedly in Country B.

In Country A, agriculture fell from 20 percent in 1980 to 12 percent in 2020, while industry declined slightly from 30 to 28 percent. In contrast, services grew substantially from 45 to 55 percent, becoming the dominant sector.

Country B showed a different pattern. Agriculture dropped sharply from 55 percent to 48 percent, while industry doubled from 20 to 40 percent. Services also rose, albeit more modestly, from 25 to 42 percent, narrowing the gap with agriculture.

In Country C, agriculture was already minimal at 5 percent in 1980 and declined further to just 2 percent in 2020. Industry also decreased from 35 to 25 percent. Meanwhile, services expanded significantly from 65 to 80 percent, accounting for the vast majority of employment by the end of the period.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: (none)
UNITS/AXES: Y-axis: 0%-100% (Country C), 0%-60% (Country A, Country B); X-axis: 1980, 2020
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Country A, Country B, Country C, Agriculture, Industry, Services
DATA:
Country A - 1980: Agriculture 20%, Industry 30%, Services 45%
Country A - 2020: Agriculture 12%, Industry 28%, Services 55%
Country B - 1980: Agriculture 55%, Industry 20%, Services 25%
Country B - 2020: Agriculture 48%, Industry 40%, Services 42%
Country C - 1980: Agriculture 5%, Industry 35%, Services 65%
Country C - 2020: Agriculture 2%, Industry 25%, Services 80%
KEY FEATURES:
* In 1980, Agriculture was highest in Country B (55%), while Services were highest in Country C (65%).
* By 2020, Services became the dominant sector in all three countries, reaching 80% in Country C.
* Agriculture declined in all three countries between 1980 and 2020.
* Industry saw a decrease in Country A and Country C, but a significant increase in Country B.
* Services increased in all three countries over the period.
* Country C had the lowest percentage in Agriculture in both years (5% and 2%).

title: Bar Chart: The two bar charts show the proportion of 14-16 year-old students studying a moder...
description: The two bar charts show the proportion of 14-16 year-old students studying a modern foreign language in an English Speaking country and the top three popular foreign languages. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Foreign language study

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng 2 charts có liên quan nội dung này sao cho rõ ràng và không bị tách ý nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Hai biểu đồ cho thấy:

  • tỷ lệ học sinh học ngoại ngữ (girls vs boys) vào năm 1984 và 2007
  • top 3 ngôn ngữ được học: French, German, Spanish

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này cần:

  • so sánh theo thời gian
  • so sánh giữa nhóm (girls vs boys)
  • và liên hệ nhẹ sang phần ngôn ngữ

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề bài, giữ đủ:

  • tỷ lệ học ngoại ngữ
  • giới tính
  • các ngôn ngữ
  • 2 năm

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý bạn các ý chính:

  • Tỷ lệ học ngoại ngữ giảm ở cả nam và nữ
  • Girls luôn cao hơn boys
  • French vẫn là ngôn ngữ phổ biến nhất nhưng giảm mạnh
  • Spanish tăng đáng kể theo thời gian

Chỉ cần 2–3 câu vậy là đủ nha.

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Percentage of students
  • Girls:

Giảm từ 48% → 40%

  • Boys:

Giảm từ 30% → 25%

TID lưu ý:

Khoảng cách giữa girls và boys vẫn giữ khá ổn định nha.

BODY 2 – Languages studied
  • French:

Giảm mạnh

50% → 25%

  • German:

Giảm nhẹ

20% → 15%

  • Spanish:

Tăng

5% → 10%

TID gợi ý:

Bạn nên highlight Spanish là ngôn ngữ duy nhất tăng nha.

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

TID gợi ý bạn một số cách diễn đạt:

  • foreign languages
  • proportion of students
  • remained higher than
  • declined / increased significantly
  • most popular / least popular

Ví dụ:

The proportion of girls studying a foreign language remained higher than that of boys in both years nha.

French was the most widely studied language, although its popularity declined considerably over time.

The charts compare the percentages of students studying a foreign language in 1984 and 2007, along with the three most commonly studied languages in those years.

Overall, participation in foreign language study declined for both boys and girls over time, although girls consistently had higher rates. French remained the most popular language despite a significant decrease, while Spanish gained popularity.

In 1984, 48 percent of girls studied a foreign language compared to 30 percent of boys. By 2007, these figures had fallen to 40 percent and 25 percent respectively, indicating a general decline across both groups.

Regarding specific languages, French dominated in 1984 at 50 percent but dropped sharply to 25 percent in 2007. German also saw a slight decrease, from 20 percent to 15 percent. In contrast, Spanish increased from 5 percent to 10 percent, becoming more widely studied, although it remained the least popular among the three.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: Percentage of students who studied a foreign language; Top 3 languages studied by students
UNITS/AXES: Y-axis: 0% to 60% in 10% increments; X-axis: 1984, 2007
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Girls, Boys, French, German, Spanish
DATA:
Percentage of students who studied a foreign language:
Girls: 1984: 48%; 2007: 40%
Boys: 1984: 30%; 2007: 25%

Top 3 languages studied by students:
French: 1984: 50%; 2007: 25%
German: 1984: 20%; 2007: 15%
Spanish: 1984: 5%; 2007: 10%
KEY FEATURES:
* In both 1984 and 2007, a higher percentage of girls studied a foreign language than boys.
* The percentage of both girls and boys studying a foreign language decreased from 1984 to 2007.
* French was the most studied language in 1984, but its popularity significantly declined by 2007.
* German was the second most popular language in both years, with a slight decrease in popularity.
* Spanish saw an increase in popularity, becoming the third most studied language in 2007.
* All categories (Girls, Boys, French, German) showed a decrease in percentage from 1984 to 2007, except for Spanish which increased.

title: Bar Chart: The chart below gives information about the growth of the urban population in cert...
description: The chart below gives information about the growth of the urban population in certain parts of the world, including the prediction of the future. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Population (1950, 2000, 2030)

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng bar chart có 3 mốc thời gian \+ nhiều khu vực sao cho dễ nhìn ra xu hướng nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy dân số (triệu người) ở:

  • Whole World
  • Africa
  • Asia
  • Latin America

qua 3 năm: 1950, 2000 và 2030 (dự đoán).

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này trọng tâm là:

  • xu hướng tăng/giảm theo thời gian
  • so sánh giữa các khu vực

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề bài, giữ đủ:

  • dân số
  • các khu vực
  • 3 mốc thời gian

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý overview:

  • Dân số tăng ở tất cả các khu vực
  • Latin America có mức tăng mạnh nhất
  • Africa và Asia cũng tăng đáng kể, trong khi tổng dân số thế giới tăng ổn định

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Whole World \+ Latin America (mức cao)
  • Whole World:

30 → 48 → 60 (tăng đều)

  • Latin America:

42 → 70 → 80 (cao nhất, tăng mạnh nhất)

TID chốt:

→ đây là nhóm có mức số liệu cao \+ tăng rõ nha

BODY 2 – Africa \+ Asia (mức thấp hơn)
  • Africa:

12 → 39 → 51 (tăng mạnh)

  • Asia:

14 → 38 → 56 (tăng mạnh, cao hơn Africa về cuối)

TID chốt:

→ cả hai đều tăng nhanh nhưng xuất phát thấp hơn

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

  • population figures
  • experienced growth
  • rose steadily
  • saw a significant increase
  • remained lower than

Ví dụ:

All regions experienced considerable population growth over the period nha.

Latin America recorded the highest figures, while Africa remained comparatively lower despite rapid growth.

The bar chart compares the number of people living in urban areas in the whole world, Africa, Asia and Latin America in 1950 and 2000, with projections for 2030, measured in millions.

Overall, urban populations increased substantially in all regions and are expected to continue rising. Latin America consistently recorded the highest figures, while Africa remained the lowest despite steady growth.

In 1950, the global urban population stood at 30 million, rising to 48 million in 2000 and projected to reach 60 million by 2030. A similar upward trend is evident in Africa, where figures grew from 12 to 39 million and are expected to climb further to 51 million.

Asia also experienced significant growth, increasing from 14 million in 1950 to 38 million in 2000, with a projected figure of 56 million in 2030. Latin America, however, had the largest urban population throughout, rising from 42 million to 70 million and expected to reach 80 million by 2030.
chart_description:
TYPE: bar chart
TITLE: none
UNITS/AXES: Y-axis: Millions of people, from 0 to 90 in increments of 10. X-axis: Whole World, Africa, Asia, Latin America. Years: 1950, 2000, 2030.
SERIES/CATEGORIES: Whole World, Africa, Asia, Latin America. Years: 1950, 2000, 2030.
DATA:
Whole World:
  1950: 30
  2000: 48
  2030: 60
Africa:
  1950: 12
  2000: 39
  2030: 51
Asia:
  1950: 14
  2000: 38
  2030: 56
Latin America:
  1950: 42
  2000: 70
  2030: 80
KEY FEATURES:
*   All regions and the whole world show a projected increase in population from 1950 to 2030.
*   Latin America consistently has the highest population figures across all three years.
*   Africa has the lowest population in 1950 (12 million) and Asia has the lowest in 2000 (38 million).
*   The largest absolute increase from 1950 to 2030 is in Latin America (from 42 million to 80 million).
*   The smallest population in 2030 is projected for Africa (51 million).

title: Bar Chart: The main reasons why students chose to study at a particular university in the UK ...
description: The chart below shows the main reasons why students chose to study at a particular university in the UK in 1995 and 2005. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide_html:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 – Factors affecting university choice

TID sẽ chỉ bạn cách xử lý dạng bar chart so sánh 2 năm \+ nhiều yếu tố này sao cho gọn và rõ nha.

1. Hiểu đề bài

Biểu đồ cho thấy tỷ lệ sinh viên lựa chọn trường đại học dựa trên 5 yếu tố vào năm 1995 và 2005:

  • Quality of resources
  • Suitable degree courses
  • Close to parental home
  • Quality of teaching
  • Good sport and social activities

TID nhắc bạn:

Dạng này là comparison over time, nên bạn cần:

  • so sánh giữa 2 năm
  • tìm yếu tố tăng/giảm rõ nhất

2. Cách viết Introduction

Paraphrase đề bài, giữ đủ:

  • các yếu tố ảnh hưởng
  • tỷ lệ (%)
  • 2 năm

Viết gọn là được nha.

3. Cách viết Overview

TID gợi ý bạn các ý chính:

  • Suitable degree courses là yếu tố quan trọng nhất ở cả hai năm
  • Một số yếu tố tăng (close to home, quality of teaching), trong khi một số giảm (resources, sports/social)
  • Close to parental home tăng mạnh nhất

Chỉ cần 2–3 câu như vậy là đủ nha.

4. Cách chia Body

BODY 1 – Nhóm tăng
  • Suitable degree courses:

Tăng nhẹ

35% → 37%

  • Close to parental home:

Tăng mạnh

9% → 22%

  • Quality of teaching:

Tăng

15% → 18%

TID gợi ý:

Bạn nên highlight “close to home” là yếu tố tăng mạnh nhất nha.

BODY 2 – Nhóm giảm
  • Quality of resources:

Giảm

21% → 16%

  • Good sport and social activities:

Giảm mạnh

19% → 6%

TID lưu ý:

“Sport and social” là yếu tố giảm mạnh nhất, nên rất đáng mention nha.

5. Gợi ý paraphrase

TID gợi ý bạn một số cách diễn đạt:

  • factors / aspects
  • influence / affect decisions
  • proportion of students
  • increased / decreased significantly

Ví dụ:

Suitable degree courses remained the most important factor in both years nha.

The proportion of students choosing universities based on proximity to home rose significantly over the period.

The bar chart compares the percentages of students citing five factors influencing their choice of higher education institution in 1995 and 2005.

Overall, suitable degree courses remained the most important factor in both years, while the importance of proximity to parental home increased markedly. In contrast, good sport and social activities became significantly less influential over time.

In 1995, suitable degree courses accounted for the largest share at 35 percent, rising slightly to 37 percent in 2005. The quality of teaching and resources were also notable considerations, although both declined over the period, from 15 to 18 percent for teaching and from 21 to 16 percent for resources.

A substantial change can be seen in the importance of location. The proportion of students choosing institutions close to their parental home more than doubled, increasing from 9 percent in 1995 to 22 percent in 2005, making it the second most cited factor. By contrast, interest in sport and social activities dropped sharply from 19 percent to just 6 percent, the lowest figure among all categories in 2005.
